title: Maa Inti Bangaram
overview: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

title: Black Panther
overview: King T'Challa returns home to the reclusive, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to serve as his country's new leader. However, T'Challa soon finds that he is challenged for the throne by factions within his own country as well as without. Using powers reserved to Wakandan kings, T'Challa assumes the Black Panther mantle to join with ex-girlfriend Nakia, the queen-mother, his princess-kid sister, members of the Dora Milaje (the Wakandan 'special forces') and an American secret agent, to prevent Wakanda from being dragged into a world war.

title: Black Sheeps
overview: A young scientist who is convinced that a dangerous new pathogen threatens the population and tracks it back to her hometown – which is located in the shadow of the remote sheep station where the macabre events of the original Black Sheep unfolded.

title: Detective Conan: Fallen Angel of the Highway
original_title: 名探偵コナン ハイウェイの堕天使
overview: When a string of deadly highway incidents begin, Conan Edogawa's investigations point towards an orchestrated plot rather than mere accidents. As he uncovers a conspiracy involving hidden identities and advanced technology, the case escalates into a high-speed race against time to stop a calculating mastermind before more lives are lost.

title: Drive Through Fire
overview: The story follows an addict war veteran turned rideshare driver who helps a terrified passenger escape a human trafficking ring serving wealthy clients.

title: Sunshine Women's Choir
overview: Inside a women's prison, four inmates form an unlikely bond with a newborn baby girl and create a choir to give her one final beautiful memory after she is diagnosed with an eye disease.

title: Balcanica
overview: Music has been banned in Afghanistan, and now an orchestra conductor and his son, a tuba player, attempt to start over by emigrating along the Balkan route. During their flight, seemingly endless, they cross paths with an Italian woman, a doctor. This encounter will change the two refugees’ lives and that of the young woman as well.

title: The Conjuring
overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse. Forced to confront a powerful entity, the Warrens find themselves caught in the most terrifying case of their lives.

title: Raakaasa
overview: Returning home after a decade, an NRI chasing romance inadvertently awakens an ancient darkness long feared by his village. As the threat intensifies, love turns deadly and life hangs in the balance.

title: The Hostage's Hero
overview: Ship hijackings in the Malacca Strait are on the rise and attracting global attention. Lieutenant Colonel Taufiq is reassigned to Indonesia to lead a maritime patrol aboard the KRI Karel Satsuitubun. While on their mission, they face the hijacking of the MT Pematang tanker by a group of pirates. Amidst the dangerous task, the soldiers are faced with a dilemma between national responsibility and family.

title: Vaazha II
overview: Four friends – Hashir, Alan, Ajin and Vinayak – are considered losers and troublemakers by parents, family and the school management. They face immense social pressure as they reach adulthood, embarking them on an emotional journey of self discovery and acceptance, where they finally learn to take up their responsibilities and find success.

title: Captain America: The First Avenger
overview: During World War II, Steve Rogers is a sickly man from Brooklyn who's transformed into super-soldier Captain America to aid in the war effort. Rogers must stop the Red Skull – Adolf Hitler's ruthless head of weaponry, and the leader of an organization that intends to use a mysterious device of untold powers for world domination.

title: From Inside Out: The Architecture of Peter Zumthor
original_title: From Inside Out - Die Architektur von Peter Zumthor
overview: We all come from houses in which we live, dream, love and die. This long-term documentary project explores the significance of architecture in our everyday lives and takes its audience on a journey to the most impressive places designed by Swiss architect Peter Zumthor.

title: Tangles
overview: When Alzheimer's disease begins to strip away her mother's vibrant personality, a headstrong young woman is forced to return to her oddball family in the conservative small town she recently fled in order to care for her. She quickly realizes she must accept the cruel and warped reality of the disease, and the imperfect beauty of her family, in order to become the daughter they need.

title: The Christophers
overview: The estranged children of a once-famous artist hire a forger to complete his unfinished works so they can be "discovered" and sold after his death.

title: Blue Moon
overview: On the evening of March 31, 1943, legendary lyricist Lorenz Hart confronts his shattered self-confidence in Sardi’s bar as his former collaborator, Richard Rodgers, celebrates the opening night of his ground-breaking hit musical, “Oklahoma!”

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

title: Jurassic World
overview: Twenty-two years after the events of Jurassic Park, Isla Nublar now features a fully functioning dinosaur theme park, Jurassic World, as originally envisioned by John Hammond.

title: The Journey to Gyeong-ju
overview: Eight years ago, the youngest daughter, Gyeong-ju, disappeared during a school field trip to Gyeongju and never came home alive.  On what would have been her birthday, her mother Ok-sil and her three daughters—Jang-ju, Young-ju, and Dong-ju—put on matching family T-shirts and set off for Gyeongju, the place where Gyeong-ju vanished, in what appears to be a family trip to honor her memory. But beneath the cheerful façade lies a deadly secret. In the trunk of their van is a bound and unconscious man zipped inside a plastic bag.

title: Breach
overview: Five haunting visions of the future collide in this gripping sci-fi anthology where technology spirals out of control, society begins to collapse, and humanity is pushed to its limits.

title: The Man with the Bag
overview: After Santa’s magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a thief, to help him get it back. Along with his daughter, Santa, and a group of misfits, Vance will have to pull off the greatest heist of his life to save Christmas.

title: The Merchants of Joy
overview: In the city that never sleeps, five families hustle each winter to turn sidewalks into holiday outposts.

title: Cats in the Museum 2: Treasures of Egypt
overview: The main characters of the film, the mouse Maurice and the cats Vincent and Cleopatra, will travel from St. Petersburg to Egypt, where they will make new friends, visit the pyramids and open secret dungeons in search of the Genie, who grants one wish once every thousand years. Guests of the presentation were shown a short excerpt in which the characters discover an ancient papyrus with a map and begin to compete with each other.

title: The Christmas Ornament Library
overview: The meticulous librarian Alice Montgomery and newspaper reporter Noah Conrad discover a forgotten room hidden beneath their town's historic library, filled with hundreds of Christmas ornaments containing handwritten memories from generations past. As they set out to reunite each treasured keepsake with its rightful family, the pair rekindles a cherished Christmas tradition, strengthen an entire community, and discover that the greatest gifts of the season are the stories – and people – we carry in our hearts.

title: Gema Senandika
overview: Dika, a vocational high school graduate, has been the sole breadwinner for his family since his mother’s passing, as his father—despite being physically capable—has never provided any financial support. Now of marriageable age, Dika faces a dilemma: marry and force his younger sibling to take over the burden of supporting the family, or break the "sandwich generation" cycle at the cost of his own future and love life. Ultimately, Dika chooses to continue supporting his family, letting go of his girlfriend so she can marry another man.

title: Mantis
overview: The secret society of contract killers falls into chaos, unleashing a new breed of assassins. With old rules in ruins, who dares claim the shadows?

title: Tangled
overview: The live-action adaptation of Disney's Tangled. Plot TBA.

title: Bambi: The Reckoning
overview: After a mother and son get in a car wreck, they soon become hunted by Bambi, a mutated grief-stricken deer on a deadly rampage seeking revenge for the death of his mother and wife.

title: War of the Worlds
overview: Will Radford is a top analyst for Homeland Security who tracks potential threats through a mass surveillance program, until one day an attack by an unknown entity leads him to question whether the government is hiding something from him... and from the rest of the world.

title: Iron Man 3
overview: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bills Love Story
original_title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bills Love Story
overview: The Quinns and DeLucas have lived next door to each other for decades in the shadow of Highmark Stadium – the home of their beloved Buffalo Bills. With their longtime friendship rooted in being proud members of Bills Mafia, the two clans have enjoyed cherished traditions that revolve around cheering for their favorite team – especially at the holidays when they celebrate the last home game before Christmas.

title: Captain America: Civil War
overview: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.

title: Tow
overview: Amanda Ogle is a woman living in her aging Toyota Camry on the streets of Seattle. When her car is stolen and impounded, she’s thrust into a relentless legal battle against an indifferent system. What begins as a fight to reclaim her car evolves into a deeply human story of resilience, dignity, and the power of one woman’s voice in the face of systemic failure.

title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
overview: After surviving the Quarter Quell, Katniss finds herself in the hidden stronghold of District 13, where the rebellion against the Capitol is gaining momentum. Struggling with the weight of becoming the symbol of resistance, she must navigate fragile alliances while trying to protect those she loves. As propaganda battles rage and Panem moves closer to full-scale war, Katniss is forced to confront the true cost of revolution.

title: Wizard of Oz: Dead Walk
overview: Dorothy is tricked into unleashing Tinman and Scarecrow into the real world only to learn their blood thirsty cravings.

title: The Testament of Ann Lee
overview: The extraordinary true legend of Ann Lee, founder of the devotional sect known as the Shakers, who preached gender and social equality and was revered by her followers as the female Christ.

title: The Evil Dead
overview: In 1979, a group of college students find a Sumerian Book of the Dead in an old wilderness cabin they've rented for a weekend getaway.

title: Torrente for President
overview: Years have passed since his last adventure, but José Luis Torrente, the most politically incorrect former cop in Spain, still sees himself as a national hero.

title: Bodycam
overview: A call to a quiet suburban home unleashes unthinkable carnage when two officers mistakenly shoot a man and his infant child, spiraling the tragedy into a fierce, unrelenting fall into the unknown.

title: The Honest Realtor
overview: An elite real estate agent who lost the ability to lie due to a curse must navigate the cutthroat industry using only the honest truth.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
overview: Ten years after the events of the original, a reprogrammed T-800 is sent back in time to protect young John Connor from the shape-shifting T-1000. Together with his mother Sarah, he fights to stop Skynet from triggering a nuclear apocalypse.

title: End of August, Sexual Awakening Mio Ishikawa
original_title: 八月の終わり、性の目覚め 石川澪
overview: Blue skies, shining sunshine and mountains brimming with greenery... Enjoy your summer vacation with the slender and absolutely beautiful Mio Ishikawa. We bring you the most emotional time spent in a sparsely populated mountain village, doing something cute and a little naughty.

title: Soulmate
overview: 2035. Anna, a lonely computer coder, has been nurturing an illegal romance with an AI in a computer simulation for the past six months. When her company uncovers the affair, she's forced into a desperate battle to save her precious relationship.

title: She's Making a List
overview: Naughty or Nice inspector Isabel Haynes doesn’t anticipate anything out of the ordinary when she’s assigned to evaluate 11-year-old Charlie Duncan. However, soon, Isabel falls for Charlie’s widowed father Jason, which makes her question the rigid rules of her job. As Christmas approaches, Isabel must choose between following the holiday algorithm or following her heart.

title: Caja Rápida.
overview: Two years after being released from prison, a former advertising director is struggling to rebuild his life in a city that does not offer second chances. Desperate for his situation, he agrees to participate as a driver of the vehicle in what appears to be a simple bank robbery.

title: Eternity
overview: In an afterlife where souls have one week to decide where to spend eternity, Joan is faced with the impossible choice between the man she spent her life with and her first love, who died young and has waited decades for her to arrive.

title: Troll 2
overview: When a dangerous new troll unleashes devastation across their homeland, Nora, Andreas and Major Kris embark on their most perilous mission yet.

title: Friday the 13th
overview: Camp counselors are stalked and murdered by an unknown assailant while trying to reopen a summer camp that was the site of a child's drowning.

title: Afterlight
overview: In a future shaped by war, AI, and fractured timelines, five sci-fi stories explore humanity’s fight for connection, survival, and meaning across time and space.

title: Hen
overview: Escaping from a chicken farm, a hen finds refuge in the courtyard of a crumbling restaurant. There, she discovers love, confronts the pecking order, and fights to protect her eggs from a greedy owner. Her droll yet touching quest for motherhood mirrors the messy compromises and silent struggles of human lives.

title: Anniversary
overview: When Ellen and Paul’s son Josh introduces his new girlfriend at their 25th anniversary party, no one suspects that it is the beginning of the end for this happy family. The new girlfriend is Liz, Ellen’s former student, who left the university, some years before, after Ellen called her out in class for her radical ideology.

title: The Isolate Thief
overview: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from a group of violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost.

title: Once We Were Us
overview: Seoul, 2008. On a bus heading to their hometown, fate brings Eun-ho and Jeong-won together, sparking an unlikely friendship. While battling  a bustling and weary city life, they find themselves sharing lofty dreams and a love that comes to feel extraordinary. But, eventually, the harsh realities of life lead them to part ways. Over a decade after the separation, the two unexpectedly reunite on a flight back to Korea, where they reflect on their lost time.

title: Kathleen Madigan: The Family Thread
overview: Comedian Kathleen Madigan is back with her latest stand up comedy special focusing on teaching kids math through gambling and Fantasy Football, celebrating Midwest pioneers, raising 4 "feral" cats, managing aging parents and modern ideas for the Catholic Church to compete with Megachurches.

title: Hana Korea
overview: A young North Korean refugee fights to rebuild her life in fast-paced, hyper-modern South Korea, forcing her to confront the price of freedom and the past she left behind.

title: The Bluff
overview: When her tranquil life on a remote island is shattered by the return of her vengeful former captain, a skilled ex-pirate must confront her bloody past and unleash her deadly talents to save her family from a ruthless siege.

title: Captain America: Civil War
overview: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.

title: Animal Friends
overview: Two fugitive animals embark on an adventure across America to find the ranch that was once their home, healing their friendship while pursued by an equally "odd-couple" DEA agent and Fish and Wildlife ranger with something to prove.

title: Haunted House
overview: Song Hui secretly takes shelter in a haunted house, encountering a series of supernatural phenomena. As she uncovers the terrifying truth of the house, she embarks on a thrilling journey intertwined with trauma and protection.

title: Satluj
overview: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

title: Baby Do Die Do
overview: A deaf and mute serial killer in Mumbai can only hear her dead sister's voice as she commits murders for mysterious reasons.

title: Alpha
overview: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

title: Montreal, My Beautiful
overview: At 53 years old, Feng Xia, a Chinese immigrant in Montreal, finally confronts her repressed desire for women and begins a secret affair with a young Québécoise.

title: Kissing Is the Easy Part
overview: Sean's gunning for MIT. Flora's ditching the SAT. A secret deal with her tenured parents sparks a romance that challenges everything they believe in.

title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
overview: Teenagers in a small town are dropping like flies, apparently in the grip of mass hysteria causing their suicides. A cop's daughter, Nancy Thompson, traces the cause to child molester Fred Krueger, who was burned alive by angry parents many years before. Krueger has now come back in the dreams of his killers' children, claiming their lives as his revenge. Nancy and her boyfriend, Glen, must devise a plan to lure the monster out of the realm of nightmares and into the real world...

title: Vision Quest
overview: Filmed in the California high desert, four individuals on a challenging retreat, guided by facilitator Mark Tollefson, journey deep into solitude, nature, and their own souls in pursuit of clarity and purpose.

title: Berlusconi: Condemned to Win
overview: Three-part series for ESPN capturing the rise of Silvio Berlusconi from his humble beginnings to the very top – from cruise ship crooner to AC Milan owner to Prime Minister of Italy.

title: The legend of Qingcheng
overview: After the Spirit-Flower that guards the human realm exhausts its power and requires a new flower soul, the sinister Lord Hanlin seizes the opportunity to help the ancient demon Yu Beast invade. With a great calamity imminent, Jiang Chen and Qing Luan embark on a desperate quest to find the missing flower soul. Through shared trials and life-and-death tribulations, love blossoms between them—only for Qing Luan to discover that Jiang Chen himself is the very flower soul they seek. In a final act of sacrifice, Jiang Chen offers his life to reignite the Spirit-Flower, defeating the forces of evil. In the aftermath, Qing Luan keeps eternal watch over the reborn flower, guarding the realm they saved together.

title: 1000 Men and Me: The Bonnie Blue Story
original_title: 1000 Men and Me: The Bonnie Blue Story
overview: Adult content creator Bonnie Blue announced that she’d slept with 1057 men in 12 hours. Exploring the polarising debate around Bonnie and the pornification of our society, the film follows her over the most eye-opening six months of her life.

title: Dead to Rights
overview: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, a postman poses as a photo developer, helping Japanese forces while secretly sheltering Chinese refugees. He later risks his life evacuating them and revealing evidence of the atrocities.

title: You Drive Me Crazy
overview: Alisa moves into a spacious apartment in St. Petersburg, where the mirror starts to malfunction, showing the young lodger a parallel reality of the same apartment. Only it is not Alisa who lives in this parallel reality, but the party animal Ivan. Will the young people be able to recognize true love and will they be able to unite their worlds in order to meet in reality and simply touch each other?

title: The Luminous Life
overview: It’s springtime in Lisbon and Nicolau turns 24, but he’s not celebrating. Living in his parents’ house, hostage to a dream of being a musician that never comes true and plagued by the ideal image of an ex-girlfriend who left him a year ago and never came back, Nicolau feels incapable of moving forward and inventing a life of his own. He takes odd jobs until the day he discovers that his mother is just as dissatisfied with life as he is. Nicolau is shaken, but he doesn’t stumble.

title: Samawa
overview: Yura grew up in a strong Javanese family and sought spiritual growth as she matured. After marrying Andy, darkness emerged in their home due to his sins, turning her life into a small hell. Holding onto the belief that a wife must always obey her husband, can Yura still achieve Samawa while his sins remain unforgiven?

title: Love Untangled
overview: A lovestruck teen plans to win the school heartthrob by going from curly to straight hair — until a new transfer student changes everything.

title: River of Blood
overview: Four kayakers take the wrong river into a jungle inhabited by a tribe of merciless cannibals.

title: Sirāt
overview: A man and his son arrive at a rave lost in the mountains of Morocco. They are looking for Marina, their daughter and sister, who disappeared months ago at another rave. Driven by fate, they decide to follow a group of ravers in search of one last party, in hopes Marina will be there.

Inspired by Chris Marker's iconic 1962 featurette La Jetée; the year is 2073—a not-so-distant dystopian future—and the setting is New San Francisco, the scorched-earth tech-dominant police state where democracy and personal freedom have been well and truly obliterated.

title: Nobody 2
overview: Former assassin Hutch Mansell takes his family on a nostalgic vacation to a small-town theme park, only to be pulled back into violence when they clash with a corrupt operator, a crooked sheriff, and a ruthless crime boss.

title: Vultures
overview: Samuel, a journalist, and Ava, his intern and daughter, cover the murder of a young girl for their magazine. Through their investigation, they discover disturbing similarities with the murder of another woman.

title: Aztec Batman: Clash of Empires
overview: In the time of the Aztec empire, tragedy strikes Yohualli Coatl when his father is murdered by Spanish conquistadors. To warn King Moctezuma and his high priest, Yoka, of imminent danger, Yohualli escapes to Tenochtitlán. There, he trains in the temple of the bat god Tzinacan with his mentor, developing equipment and weaponry to confront the Spanish invasion and avenge his father’s death. Along the way, he encounters key figures like the fierce Jaguar Woman and the conquistador Hernán Cortés.

title: Beating Hearts
overview: Local rebellious teenager Clotaire falls for his schoolmate Jackie, but gang violence leads him to a darker destructive path. After years apart, the star-crossed lovers discover that every path they've taken leads them back together.

title: The Mysterious Gaze of the Flamingo
overview: As an unknown and deadly disease begins to spread, legend has it that it is transmitted between two men, through a simple glance, when they fall in love. While people are accusing her family, Lidia must find out whether this myth is real or not.

title: Holy Night: Demon Hunters
overview: When a devil-worshipping criminal network plunges Seoul into chaos, the police turn to Holy Night—a trio of supernatural demon hunters—to restore order and defeat the rising evil.

title: Magazine Dreams
overview: Aspiring bodybuilder Killian Maddox struggles to find human connection in an exploration of celebrity and violence. Nothing deters him from his fiercely protected dream of superstardom, not even the doctors who warn him of the permanent damage he causes to himself with his quest.

title: Paddington in Peru
overview: Paddington travels to Peru to visit his beloved Aunt Lucy, who now resides at the Home for Retired Bears. With the Brown Family in tow, a thrilling adventure ensues when a mystery plunges them into an unexpected journey through the Amazon rainforest and up to the mountain peaks of Peru.

title: In the Lost Lands
overview: A queen sends the powerful and feared sorceress Gray Alys to the ghostly wilderness of the Lost Lands in search of a magical power, where she and her guide, the drifter Boyce, must outwit and outfight both man and demon.

title: Linka Linka
overview: Samgyi returns to Lhasa to shoot a film about her childhood. Struggling with creative uncertainty, she finds herself in an endless cycle of arguments with her father. At a chance party, she meets Lhamo, the girl who inspired the character in her story. As the night quietly slips away, the summer that once lingered in fragments of memory gradually comes into full view...

title: Idol
overview: A new drama by hamid nematollah

title: Pee Mak
overview: Mak, a soldier returning home from war, invites four of his comrades to meet his wife and newborn child. However, suspicion soon grows among his friends as they uncover a terrifying secret: Mak’s family is no longer among the living.

title: Youri
overview: Amsterdam, 1982. When journalist Jan Brokken meets Youri Egorov – the world-famous Soviet pianist who fled his homeland because of his sexuality – an unexpected friendship begins. Jan, quiet and guarded, is drawn to Youri’s brilliance, excess and freedom; Youri, in turn, recognizes in Jan a kindred outsider. As their bond deepens, Youri inspires Jan the courage to pursue the life he has always postponed: becoming a writer.

title: Everyone's Sorry Nowadays
overview: On a sweltering summer day, Bianca feels unseen by her parents. Then an unexpected encounter with her favourite female actor, Billie King, helps her to find herself. A tender, imaginative tale about dreams and carving out a space for yourself in life.

title: The Suitcase
overview: During a gala, three friends stumble upon a suitcase filled with money and a dead body. Before they know it, they find themselves caught up in an unexpected and dangerous manhunt.

title: London
overview: Bobby drives back and forth between Vienna and Salzburg, giving lifts to strangers on the way, sharing conversations that drift from the mundane to the deeply personal. In this tender portrait of today’s Europe, anonymity and warmth still go hand in hand.

title: Dendam Arwah Penari
overview: The bankruptcy of Mr. Kusuma’s business forced Harum and her family to move into an old family home. There, Harum discovered a mysterious shawl that turned out to harbor the grudge of a dancer from the past. Since then, a series of terrifying and strange events has begun to haunt Harum and her family. To put an end to this deadly terror, Harum must uncover the mystery behind the dancer’s unjust death.

title: Bapak Paling Jujur
overview: A highly calculated gubernatorial candidate finds his meticulously engineered political campaign and public persona thrown into absolute disarray when a maternal curse renders him entirely incapable of deception, forcing him to navigate the political arena with unfiltered, absolute honesty.

title: Šipkaři
overview: The Darts Players combine black humour, action and a crime plot with a healthy dose of absurdity. Their world is full of characters who have their own agendas, are hiding something and are convinced that they, of all people, have everything under control. The main character, Pepé, believes that this time it will finally work out. All he needs to do is make a few right decisions, find the right people, not panic and, above all, not mess anything up. But his life has never quite gone to plan. When he meets Milánek again after a year, a series of events unfolds that nobody could have foreseen.

title: Wirbel
overview: A dilapidated house stands among the fields in the rolling landscape of the Czech Central Mountains. Its new and only inhabitant is Martin, who left the city to rediscover his lost sense of direction here. But when the mysterious Agnes appears on his doorstep, his secluded world begins to crumble. As the landscape resists and an ancient danger hidden in the soil comes to life, Martin must restore the lost memory of the place to save Agnes, the land, and himself.

title: The Sorry Generation
overview: A messy, uproarious, thoroughly chaotic family comes rushing in. With an Intangible Cultural Heritage inscription review looming, the House of Lord Ongpyeong, Gwangpyeong Kim Clan—a name that’s a tongue-twister in itself— is presided over by Yong-byeong, the 46th-generation head of this distinguished family. When nothing seems to go his way, he visits a shaman and, upon hearing that "the ancestors are furious," decides to hold a shamanic ritual. Meanwhile, Bong-deok, the 47th-generation heir, has failed the civil service exam seven times. Crushed by responsibilities he never wanted and convinced that his ancestors have ruined his life, he decides to exorcise them altogether.

title: Run Terry Run
overview: The extraordinary story of Canadian icon Terry Fox will be told like never before in Run Terry Run, a new feature-length documentary directed by acclaimed filmmaker Sean Menard. The film offers an intimate, behind-the-scenes look at Terry’s legendary 1980 Marathon of Hope, drawing from 96 reels of never-before-seen footage and unheard audio interviews that have remained untouched for 45 years.

title: Lügen über meine Mutter
overview: In the 1980s, the life of a family in a small village is determined by just one issue: the mother's body weight. Her husband Werner decides that she needs to lose weight, Cornelia suffers as a result and their daughter Ela is caught in the middle.

title: The Fish Don't Care When It Rains
original_title: The Fish Don't Care When It Rains
overview: How far would you go to change a child the world can’t understand? One autistic artist survives a hidden system of abuse built to correct her.

title: The First Taste of Loneliness
overview: A single mother has the idea of restarting her marriage life. During the process of contacting different men around her, she felt confused and did not know where to go. Until the emotions buried in her past memories were awakened, she finally found her own answer.

title: All About Corinne
overview: Corinne Maclou is a background actor who dreams of one day being more than an extra. Confident her breakthrough is right around the corner, she befriends famous actor Sandrine Kiberlain, hoping it will help her achieve her goal.

title: The Table: Day and Night
overview: From the brief encounter between Yoo-jin and Hyeon-oh, who find themselves at the same cafe at different times, to the sudden reunion of middle-school friends Sang-mi and Young-min; from the electric first meeting of web novelist Hye-jin and film director Dong-nam to the tender moment shared by idol trainee Na-kyung and her boyfriend Jong-su - The Table: Day and Night is a film of delightful, unpretentious, and lovely conversations shared by four couples at a single cafe, somewhere between summer and autumn.

title: Le Roi du Game
overview: In conflict with his daughter Isaure, Alexandre discovers that she has been selected for the oral exam of a prestigious business school—her greatest dream. However, Isaure is nowhere to be found, lost in a weekend of medieval fantasy role-playing. To find her, Alexandre enters the game, taking on the role of a devious Game Master. But as the adventure unfolds, he realizes that he himself has been lost for years. Under the guise of "Renard Chafouin," he gets a chance to reconnect with his values—and to avoid losing his daughter forever.

title: Pirunduk
overview: A wronged wife in a remote village on the Tanah Banjar river, South Kalimantan. When she becomes a wandering spirit, she seeks revenge on those who have hurt her and collects debts that have not been paid off during her lifetime.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
overview: Ten years after the events of the original, a reprogrammed T-800 is sent back in time to protect young John Connor from the shape-shifting T-1000. Together with his mother Sarah, he fights to stop Skynet from triggering a nuclear apocalypse.

title: Regulars
overview: On Halloween night in a Brooklyn dive bar, where a group of misfit regulars — led by a Dominican-American bar owner — get trapped and uncover a murder, spiraling into a chaotic, culture-soaked whodunnit where everyone’s got secrets… and everyone’s a suspect.

title: Silver Bells at Christmas
overview: In Comfort, Kentucky, Ginny Nolan tries to keep her family's Christmas shop afloat as coffee-chain owner Nick Day offers to buy it. Meanwhile, Ginny's ex-flame and former songwriting partner Tyler Benton returns to town, seeking her help.

title: Signs Of Fatigue
overview: A young music teacher named Ivan falls ill with a condition that seems indistinguishable from an ordinary flu. He tries to continue his everyday life but the symptoms do not subside and only intensify, gradually distorting his perception of the world and of himself.

title: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry
original_title: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry
overview: On the verge of his record-extending 4,000th career three-pointer, four-time NBA champion and two-time MVP Stephen Curry reflects on the upbringing, mindset, and work ethic that made him one of the most legendary artists of his time.

title: A Clockwork Orange
overview: In a near-future Britain, young Alexander DeLarge and his pals get their kicks beating and raping anyone they please. When not destroying the lives of others, Alex swoons to the music of Beethoven. The state, eager to crack down on juvenile crime, gives an incarcerated Alex the option to undergo an invasive procedure that'll rob him of all personal agency. In a time when conscience is a commodity, can Alex change his tune?

title: This Is I
overview: Bullied for wanting to be an idol, Kenji finds belonging in a cabaret and help from a trailblazing doctor, emerging onstage as her true self, Ai Haruna.

title: To You in the Beyond
original_title: どこよりも遠い場所にいる君へ
overview: Kazuki Tsukigase is a high school boy who carries a certain secret. In search of a place where no one knows him, he enrolls at Sakijima High School on a remote island.  On Sakijima, there is a place known as the "Cove of Spiriting Away." One early summer day, Kazuki finds a girl lying unconscious in the cove. The girl—Nanao, 16 years old—later regains consciousness in the hospital, but her identity remains unknown. What is the meaning behind the word "1974" that she murmured?

title: Arriba Tutto
overview: A seven-year-old boy's magical childhood with his street performer father ends tragically. Years later, he struggles with anger and bitterness, having lost the joy and wonder he once knew.

title: Treasure Trekkers
overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

title: The Almost Perfect Murder
overview: Trinh, a viral TikToker known for her romantic content, wakes up on a cold film set with a splitting headache and amnesia, only to discover the body of Yến—an actress and romantic rival suspected of having a shady connection with Khang, Trinh’s fiancé. Đại, a detective hired by Trinh to investigate the suspected affair, sneaks in to help but accidentally leaves fingerprints on the corpse and is caught red-handed by security. From that moment on, this mismatched duo faces a series of bizarre predicaments: fleeing from police hot on their heels and a lurking assassin, all while bickering fiercely as they try to solve the case. Amidst the chaos, they inadvertently expose a shocking showbiz secret.

title: Split Rock
overview: A team of geologists uncover a strange anomaly buried deep in the remote badlands and fall prey to a sinister force of destruction.

title: Brother Joseph Again
overview: Brother Joseph Again is a rigorous, faith-filled investigation into one of the most fascinating questions in Church history: what did Joseph Smith really look like?

title: Scala Milan AC
overview: Some teenagers sign up for the contest: "Describe your neighborhood", whose first prize is a trip to Milan. As the youngsters are football fans and fans of Milan AC, they decide to describe the neighbourhood with a rap song, and record a video. Archie Shepp, who also lives in the neighbourhood, watches them and decides to give them a hand.

title: Race to Monte Carlo
overview: This is the story of the visionaries behind Russia's first mass-produced automobile. In 1908, automotive enthusiast Andrey Nagel and engineer Dmitry Bondarev gather a team of like-minded individuals and begin developing a car. When the viability of their endeavor looks uncertain, Andrey Nagel makes the risky decision to enter their car in the Monaco Rally - a move that could make or break the budding automobile manufacturer's future.

title: Çatlı 2
overview: The film continues the story of Abdullah Çatlı, who is imprisoned in France.

title: Kill. Bury. Print.
overview: When the McCurtain Gazette, a small family-run newspaper, begins reporting on alleged sex, drugs, and violence within the county sheriff's office, they find themselves the target of the sheriff's retaliation. Tensions escalate when the paper obtains a secret recording revealing the sheriff and local officials allegedly discussing having the family killed, turning a local investigation into international news.

title: The Blood Countess
overview: The Blood Countess and her maid embark on a quest for the red elixir of life and a book that threatens the vampire realm. Hot on their heels are a police inspector, two vampirologists, a vegetarian nephew and his therapist.

title: BTS World Tour 'Arirang' In São Paulo: Live Viewing
original_title: BTS World Tour 'Arirang' In São Paulo: Live Viewing
overview: The Latin American leg of BTS WORLD TOUR ‘ARIRANG’ reaches the big screen through a delayed presentation of the São Paulo concert. It brings the scale and excitement of BTS’s stadium performance into the cinema, offering fans a communal live-viewing experience shaped by the energy of a packed Brazilian venue.

title: Scrooge: A Christmas Carol Horror
overview: A horror take on the classic tale. When cruel businessman Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by ghosts on Christmas Eve, he will have to decide whether to heed their warning to change for the better or remain cold-hearted and merciless.

title: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
original_title: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
overview: Through intimate interviews with surviving members of its legendary cast and an emotional reunion in Toronto, the film explores the creative partnership that transformed a small Canadian television production into a cultural phenomenon that launched some of comedy’s most celebrated icons.

title: The Ocean Between Them
overview: A family vacation in Belize turns into a nightmare when a sudden storm strands a young kayaker named Miranda at sea, prompting her mother, Joan, to launch a desperate search.

title: AEW All Out 2026
overview: The 2026 All Out was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on September 26, 2026, at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, USA. The show was headlined by an AEW World Title match between current Champion Will Ospreay and challenger Jon Moxley.

title: Who's Coming for Christmas?
overview: Having recently relocated, Julie is setting up her new home using pieces she inherited from her late grandmother, including a beautiful dining room table she plans to use on Christmas Eve when she hosts dinner for the first time. Though she doesn't have her guest list set just yet Julie takes inspiration from her grandmother and has faith that her holiday table for eight will be filled. Julie's warm, friendly nature leads her to quickly become part of the community and make friends, including her neighbor Mark and his young daughter Vanessa. Mark suggests that he and his family could join her, making Julie's dream of dinner for eight come true. But when bad weather keeps them from making the trip it looks like it will be a silent night with just the three of them unless a small Christmas miracle – or series of miracles – fills her holiday table.

title: Alter Yellow - Inspecteur Moutarde
overview: Alter Yellow is a series produced by CAV Brequigny. The concept is simple: Each episode has a cinematic genre (comedy, drama, thriller, etc.) but with one common element: the presence of a yellow camcorder in each episode. In this second episode, the yellow camera filmed a murder, Inspector Noé Morcati, also known as Inspector Moutarde, needs this evidence to solve the investigation

title: Paging Hezbollah
overview: Paging Hezbollah is the extraordinary true story behind an intelligence operation that seemed impossible—how it was conceived, engineered and carried out, as well as the profound geopolitical consequences that followed.

title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
overview: When Peppa learned that her family wouldn't be going on vacation this year, she was very disappointed. However, a sudden storm transported her to faraway China! Peppa embarked on a wonderful adventure until she was reunited with her family, and Peppa had the perfect vacation ever.

title: Karaokill
overview: One night, Mrs. Thuy’s ear-splitting karaoke pushes the entire neighborhood to the brink of insanity. But when she is suddenly murdered during a mountain pilgrimage, everyone becomes a suspect. Enter Tam - a young woman with a shady past - who is forced to take matters into her own hands. A rollercoaster of clues and tragicomic situations soon exposes the town's hidden secrets, from blind superstitions and bitter grudges to hilariously conflicting testimonies. As the elusive killer prepares to strike again, Tam must race against time to unmask the culprit before she becomes the next victim.

title: A Very Arctic Christmas
overview: Single dad Jim and his spirited, science-minded 20-year-old daughter, Isla, share a tradition of alternating who decides how they spend Christmas each year. Jim, a former major league baseball player turned broadcaster, never misses hosting his annual Christmas Eve show from Times Square – until Isla persuades him to take a once-in-a-lifetime Arctic cruise, promising they will return in time for his broadcast.

title: Queens for a Day
overview: A controversial talk show host wakes up and finds herself back in the 1950s forced to live not her own life, but that of her mother’s. What might be an amusing trip down Memory Lane, turns into a dark and horrifying nightmare. And to make matters worse, she ends up having to raise herself as a child.

title: Tutt Paini English Ne
overview: Blending comedy with heartfelt family moments, this movie explores the clash between cultural pride and modern aspirations through characters every Punjabi household will recognise.

title: Dhoomakethu
overview: On the morning of his wedding, 36 year old Kuttan wakes from a disturbing dream about his own death. As the day unfolds, familiar moments begin to repeat and reality becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish from memory. Realizing that something is terribly wrong, Kuttan races to uncover the truth before the day repeats itself again.

title: Seven Pirates
overview: Late 1970s. Dinmukhamed Kunaev brings together seven Kazakhs — criminals and homeless youths — and entrusts them with a secret mission against the Soviet regime. Their goal is to stop nuclear weapons testing at the Semipalatinsk Test Site, which threatens humanity.

title: Smile 2
overview: About to embark on a new world tour, global pop sensation Skye Riley begins experiencing increasingly terrifying and inexplicable events. Overwhelmed by the escalating horrors and the pressures of fame, Skye is forced to face her dark past to regain control of her life before it spirals out of control.

title: Fountain of Youth
overview: A treasure-hunting mastermind assembles a team for a life-changing adventure. But to outwit and outrun threats at every turn, he'll need someone even smarter than he is: his estranged sister.

title: Misericordia
overview: Jérémie returns to his hometown for the funeral of his former boss, the village baker. He decides to stay for a few days with Martine, the man's widow. A mysterious disappearance, a threatening neighbor and a priest with strange intentions make Jérémie's short stay in the village take an unexpected turn.

title: Another Simple Favor
overview: Stephanie and Emily reunite on the beautiful island of Capri, Italy for Emily's extravagant wedding to a rich Italian businessman. Along with the glamorous guests, expect murder and betrayal to RSVP for a wedding with more twists and turns than the road from the Marina Grande to the Capri town square.

title: Hidden Face
overview: Su-yeon, a cellist in an orchestra led by her fiancé and conductor Sung-jin, disappears one day, leaving behind only a video recording. Sung-jin is devasted over the loss of Su-yeon, but feels a strong attraction to Mi-ju, a cellist who fills in for his fiancée. Then one rainy night, Sung-jin and Mi-ju get swept away by their mutual desires for each other and commit an unforgivable act at Su-yeon's house.

title: Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl
overview: Gromit’s concern that Wallace is becoming too dependent on his inventions proves justified, when Wallace invents a “smart” gnome that seems to develop a mind of its own. When it emerges that a vengeful figure from the past might be masterminding things, it falls to Gromit to battle sinister forces and save his master… or Wallace may never be able to invent again!

title: Pushpa 2 - The Rule
overview: As his smuggling empire grows, a brazen Pushpa longs for power and respect on his vengeful journey, while facing old rivals and new.

title: Mufasa: The Lion King
overview: Mufasa, a cub lost and alone, meets a sympathetic lion named Taka, the heir to a royal bloodline. The chance meeting sets in motion an expansive journey of a group of misfits searching for their destiny.

title: Brianza
overview: Set against the backdrop of the 2009 economic crisis, Brianza follows Giorgio Farina, the heir to a historic gun shop who faces ruin after a failed luxury investment in Switzerland. Desperate to save his social standing, he enters into a dangerous partnership with eccentric businessman Alberto Fumagalli. What begins as an illicit scheme quickly plunges Giorgio into a downward spiral of debt, crime, and peril, threatening his family, his reputation, and his life.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

title: Nando Between Two Worlds - A Sintonia Film
original_title: Nando Entre Dois Mundos: Um Filme Sintonia
overview: Caught between family life and his obligations to the criminal underworld, Nando faces an impossible choice about where his true loyalties lie.

title: The Pout-Pout Fish
overview: Living on a rundown shipwreck, Mr. Fish one day discovers a hyperactive young sea dragon Pip – who had mistaken his home for a junkyard – pilfering his belongings. The heated argument that ensues leaves both their houses in ruin. But there is hope! Embarking on a seemingly impossible quest in search of the mythical 'Shimmer' to grant them a wish, there’s only one problem: someone else is on the hunt...

title: Spirited Away
overview: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.

title: Iron Man 3
overview: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.

title: Shutter Island
overview: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane, but his efforts are compromised by troubling visions and a mysterious doctor.

title: Ohh My Dog
overview: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

title: G.D.N
overview: G.D. Naidu overcomes challenges and defies a repressive colonial regime to become one of India's greatest innovators.

title: Jurassic Rampage
overview: Dinosaurs transported by armored truck escape into a nearby neighborhood. A family trapped there must survive the deadly onslaught.

title: The Last Warrior: Kolobok
overview: Kolobok decides to change his fate and unwittingly becomes the partner of the humble baker Tikhon.

title: GROTESQQQUE
overview: Anthology film made up of three separate segments:  A(E)LIENS, YOROSHIKU★Girl, and NOCTURNE: NUIT GROTESQUE.

title: The Harvester
overview: Álava, late 19th century. As the Third Carlist War rages, several women are found strangled to death on the outskirts of Vitoria.

title: Twenty Years of the Met in Cinemas: An Anniversary Celebration
original_title: Twenty Years of the Met in Cinemas: An Anniversary Celebration

title: Fly Train
overview: Like a bee tracing the windows of an endless train, thoughts on an ordinary journey drift between scenery and fragmented memories. Through experimental shadow play, everyday silhouettes transform into the surreal, slipping into a hypnotic stream of consciousness. As the wheels turn, the search for memory's meaning fades, leaving us to immerse ourselves in the ephemeral, flickering flow of frames.

title: Unprotected: Murder in Galicia
overview: Documentary film that tells the story of Isabel Fuentes. In April 2015, alleged burglars left her on the brink of death in her own home, in the village of Pazos, in Verín. From the very beginning, the Guardia Civil sergeant in charge of the case suspected that the account of what had happened did not add up and tried to protect Isabel from further attack.

title: You Had to Be There: How the Toronto Godspell Ignited the Comedy Revolution...
original_title: You Had to Be There: How the Toronto Godspell Ignited the Comedy Revolution...
overview: Martin Short, Eugene Levy, Gilda Radner, Victor Garber, Paul Shaffer, and other entertainment icons got their start in a 1972 Toronto production of the musical Godspell. Featuring interviews with the surviving cast members, Lin-Manuel Miranda, Mike Myers, and more, the film recounts a pivotal moment in comedy history, in hilarious, moving, and inspiring detail.

title: Pacific
overview: A group of young travelers are stranded on an island in the Pacific where they struggle to escape an evil presence kept hidden from mankind for centuries.

title: Paris Cafe
overview: Olivizhiyaal, from the u.s., dreams of introducing her soulmate kavinSamson, a phd scholar, to the two people she admires most — her parents inIndia. She wants to share a happy news to them. But her smile fades when she learns that her parents, dr. Gautam raja, aSurgeon, and thara, an architect, a fiery social activist, have separated. A buried secret. A shattered trust. A photograph in a paris café that brings thePast crashing back. What did dr. Gautam do? Why did thara, a woman of unshakable ideals, walk away? As oli and kavin dive into the mystery, they uncover a hidden sin, a cry forJustice, and a chance for redemption. A family broken by truth... A daughter determined to heal it. In the end, will forgiveness light the way?

title: An Ozark Mountain Christmas
overview: When a dedicated young designer at a crossroads reluctantly follows her sister home to the nostalgic heart of the Ozarks for Christmas, she finds herself rediscovering not only her family’s legacy for commitment to craft, but also the quiet faith and purpose she has lost in the rush of modern life. With the help of Paul, Clara will reconnect with work rooted in care and community.

title: 9 Temples to Heaven
original_title: 9 วัด สู่สวรรค์
overview: A man takes his sick mother and nine family members on a single-day temple pilgrimage after his boss predicts she may die soon.

title: Bára - Diary of a Rockstar
overview: Bára Basiková is an icon of Czech rock and other music genres. To what extent can her public, media-distorted image differ from the person she really is? The answer comes in the form of the latest long-term documentary study from Helena Třeštíková, whose empathy, coupled with admirable self-reflection and openness on the part of the protagonist, gives rise to a fascinating film portrait: over the course of fifty years we follow a woman who demonstrates remarkable strength as she faces the challenges of both her professional and private lives.​

title: Kin
overview: After many years of actively avoiding her family, Mariia finally decides to pay them a visit, seemingly to celebrate her grandmother's jubilee. However, her intentions might not be as wholesome as it seems, as the true nature of her visit lies in the fact that the birthday girl decided to grant Mariia the ownership over her home. Mariia's uncle Grygorii learns of this and decides to engage in a turf war with his niece, hoping that this will result in the latter changing her mind. However, the young entrepeneur is a tougher nut to crack than it initially looks.

title: Onwards and Sideways
overview: Tony Evans is the deputy head of a local primary school. Emma Dretzin is a pianist, composer and single mother of two daughters. Neither knows the other until a startling encounter changes the course of their lives: on the same morning, they are both confronted with a diagnosis of Parkinson’s.

title: The Punisher
overview: In the coastal city of South Australia, undercurrents surge beneath the neon glow. Hot-blooded cop Zheng Yi witnessed his partner Zhang Mingzhi die shielding him. The corrupt police department even framed Zhang as a mole. With his faith shattered, Zheng Yi quit the force and took violent revenge on drug lord Qian Jiu. Just as he was about to kill his enemy, he found that Zhang Mingzhi was actually alive, having long been bought off by Qian Jiu and faked his death. The once life-and-death brothers now stand across an abyss of betrayal. Hunted by drug traffickers, abandoned by the police, and with their loved ones dead, the estranged pair are forced to put aside grievances, launch a solemn counterattack against darkness with their broken bodies, fulfill the final redemption of brotherhood with their lives, and tear apart the drug web shrouding the whole city.

title: 70 Up
overview: Across seven decades, British viewers watched 14 children grow into adults in films broadcast every seven years. In the series' final installment – with all surviving participants now in their seventies – what do their lives tell us about Britain?

title: Birds of War
overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man
overview: A teenage Peter Parker grapples with both high school and amazing super-human crises as his alter-ego Spider-Man.

title: Safe House
overview: Trapped in a high-security safe house after a terrorist attack in downtown Los Angeles, six government agents realize they must survive not just the enemy outside, but the potential traitor among them.

title: Il rumore delle cose nuove
overview: A vividly interwoven tale of secrets and connections, Il rumore delle cose nuove centers on three families whose lives have quietly overlapped in the streets of Milan—unaware of each other—for years. Andrea, a photographer, and Andreina, a nurse, share a haunting truth: Andreina has given a part of herself to keep Andrea alive. Umberto finds solace in alleviating others’ pain at work, yet at home he inflicts suffering upon Alba, once hopeful, now dreamless. In another household, Ralph, who crafts sounds, and Viola, an actress who yearns to live as freely as she performs, are quietly struggling—alongside Mirko, a ten‑year‑old whose presence echoes loudly. As the story unfolds, their ordinary routines unravel under the weight of these “noisy” secrets—some seemingly trivial, others utterly unbearable. Chaos tumbles over the fragile bonds holding them together, forcing confrontations with truths they can no longer ignore.

title: Spit Or Swallow
overview: A story of sexual discovery. After a playboy breaks a virgin’s heart, her sexy professor ignites her world. But now they must choose: Spit on the filthy demand, or swallow the degradation?

title: Let Us Through, Dear Ancestors
overview: 1617, Las Islas Filipinas. The Spanish friar, Father Enciso, the encomendero of one of the islands, rules with unrelenting toughness and an insatiable libido to tame the savages.

title: Closure
overview: After his teenage son goes missing, Daniel scours the depths of the Vistula River, torn between the dread of a fatal leap and the hope that his son may still be alive.

title: Tah Houdini Prime: part Ⅰ
overview: An evening with friends was interrupted by a new attack of narcolepsy by Louis, after which a strange event will upset the evening.

title: The Echo Chamber
overview: Leo and Ava chase each other—coming close, drifting apart, and searching for their way back. They cannot let go, nor break free. Through the rooms, Ava’s voice echoes across time, carrying to the surface what endures—and what can no longer be held back.

title: Love, Ngo
overview: Ngongo volunteers at a cleft lip foundation and works at his mother's burger stand. He falls for a woman, but her family rejects him due to his condition and social status, leading him to face challenges with love and acceptance.

title: Red Flag
overview: The story follows the pilot Ahmed and his wife, an advertising company manager, highlighting the challenges of love, hesitation, trust, and infidelity in young couples’ relationships.

title: Letters from the Silenced Country
overview: A hybrid documentary portraying contemporary Belarus through the individuals who have endured imprisonment, repression, and exile — voices from a silenced country, suffocated by the regime.

title: Goodbye Cruel World
overview: Fourteen-year-old Otto writes a suicide letter to his family and classmates, but his attempt fails. Too ashamed to go back home, he hides. As night falls, he roams the city streets like a ghost—until a girl from his high school, Léna, recognizes him.

title: Panic Carefully
overview: Described as a paranoid thriller about a hunt for a cyber-terrorist in the vein of Mr. Robot and The Silence of the Lambs.

title: POV: Pasilip On VMX
overview: Seductresses Lea Bernabe and Rhian Rivera invite you to spy on their wild, secret encounters. From hot hidden moments to shameless private acts, this is the ultimate VMX voyeur compilation for your viewing pleasure.

title: Jupiter
overview: Freshly elected, President Paul Archambault must face an unprecedented crisis: his Russian counterpart, the target of an attack, brandishes a nuclear ultimatum threatening an ally of France. Faced with the risk of military escalation, the president gathers his staff in the bunker of the Elysée. In the secrecy of the command post Jupiter, Paul will have to make a dizzying decision.

title: Inception
overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

title: Beast Race
overview: In future Rio de Janeiro, a young leader of the resistance must enter a deadly parkour-inspired competition in order to save his sister's life.

title: A Place to Heal
overview: In a French public hospital, the adolescent psychiatry unit moves to the erratic rhythm of teenagers coming and going - many carrying heavy past baggage - while Etienne and his medical team navigate the relentless cycle of treating, listening, and confronting the raw edges of suffering. Young Lucia knows the ward too well. After being brought back yet again by the police, she reunites with her friend Eloïse and encounters a constellation of young patients, each wrestling with their own storms. At times, there is laughter, small breakthroughs, moments of fragile hope. But the balance is shaky, and the arrival of a new patient will shatter it entirely.

title: Life of Jorge Luis Borges
overview: A biography of Jorge Luis Borges working from an exhaustive review of the papers he left, the books he read, the places he went to. And with this, an attempt to decipher a very peculiar life: someone who lived like a hidden, underground warrior, whose cause was literature, literature conceived as a kingdom and as a landscape. If Cold War spies fought from their desks or from an uninhabited house to defend their half of the world, Borges strove from a library to elevate and broaden the territories of his own tribe: the people for whom the most important part of the universe is books, plots and words. This film is devoted to that secret pilgrim (to borrow from Le Carré, the king of all spies).

title: Agata the Writer
overview: Agata travels from Sydney to Sarajevo to write a war novel, but as she gathers material, she is challenged by locals who question her motives. Her creative uncertainty growing, she sees a startling mystery unfold: some provocative and obscene artworks inexplicably vanish. As Agata reads the first chapters of her new novel, it becomes clear that the story is not about the war itself, but about the quiet, very human moments of resilience that persist in its shadow. During her stay in Sarajevo, Agata has developed a deeper understanding of the act of storytelling and the profound responsibilities that come with being a storyteller.

title: Alpha Gang
overview: Alien invaders, in the form of a 1950’s biker gang, are sent on a mission to conquer Earth.

title: Himalayan Gold
overview: A young village girl's journey to collect the rare Himalayan herb Yarsagumba turns into a desperate fight for survival when she encounters a ruthless gang of robbers in the mountains.

overview: A rogue band of resistance fighters unite for a mission to steal the Death Star plans and bring a new hope to the galaxy.

title: Letters from the Silenced Country
overview: A hybrid documentary portraying contemporary Belarus through the individuals who have endured imprisonment, repression, and exile — voices from a silenced country, suffocated by the regime.

title: Goodbye Cruel World
overview: Fourteen-year-old Otto writes a suicide letter to his family and classmates, but his attempt fails. Too ashamed to go back home, he hides. As night falls, he roams the city streets like a ghost—until a girl from his high school, Léna, recognizes him.

title: Panic Carefully
overview: Described as a paranoid thriller about a hunt for a cyber-terrorist in the vein of Mr. Robot and The Silence of the Lambs.

title: POV: Pasilip On VMX
overview: Seductresses Lea Bernabe and Rhian Rivera invite you to spy on their wild, secret encounters. From hot hidden moments to shameless private acts, this is the ultimate VMX voyeur compilation for your viewing pleasure.

title: Jupiter
overview: Freshly elected, President Paul Archambault must face an unprecedented crisis: his Russian counterpart, the target of an attack, brandishes a nuclear ultimatum threatening an ally of France. Faced with the risk of military escalation, the president gathers his staff in the bunker of the Elysée. In the secrecy of the command post Jupiter, Paul will have to make a dizzying decision.

title: A Place to Heal
overview: In a French public hospital, the adolescent psychiatry unit moves to the erratic rhythm of teenagers coming and going - many carrying heavy past baggage - while Etienne and his medical team navigate the relentless cycle of treating, listening, and confronting the raw edges of suffering. Young Lucia knows the ward too well. After being brought back yet again by the police, she reunites with her friend Eloïse and encounters a constellation of young patients, each wrestling with their own storms. At times, there is laughter, small breakthroughs, moments of fragile hope. But the balance is shaky, and the arrival of a new patient will shatter it entirely.

title: Life of Jorge Luis Borges
overview: A biography of Jorge Luis Borges working from an exhaustive review of the papers he left, the books he read, the places he went to. And with this, an attempt to decipher a very peculiar life: someone who lived like a hidden, underground warrior, whose cause was literature, literature conceived as a kingdom and as a landscape. If Cold War spies fought from their desks or from an uninhabited house to defend their half of the world, Borges strove from a library to elevate and broaden the territories of his own tribe: the people for whom the most important part of the universe is books, plots and words. This film is devoted to that secret pilgrim (to borrow from Le Carré, the king of all spies).

title: Agata the Writer
overview: Agata travels from Sydney to Sarajevo to write a war novel, but as she gathers material, she is challenged by locals who question her motives. Her creative uncertainty growing, she sees a startling mystery unfold: some provocative and obscene artworks inexplicably vanish. As Agata reads the first chapters of her new novel, it becomes clear that the story is not about the war itself, but about the quiet, very human moments of resilience that persist in its shadow. During her stay in Sarajevo, Agata has developed a deeper understanding of the act of storytelling and the profound responsibilities that come with being a storyteller.

title: Alpha Gang
overview: Alien invaders, in the form of a 1950’s biker gang, are sent on a mission to conquer Earth.

title: Himalayan Gold
overview: A young village girl's journey to collect the rare Himalayan herb Yarsagumba turns into a desperate fight for survival when she encounters a ruthless gang of robbers in the mountains.

title: Josephine
overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault in Golden Gate Park, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice, and a way to feel safe again.

title: Burgundy
overview: The story of Burgundy’s most extraordinary characters and a celebration of the pleasure that defines their lives.

title: Akira
overview: A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath that only two teenagers and a group of psychics can stop.

title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
overview: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
overview: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

title: Tell Me Everything
overview: Amid the late ’80s pop craze and rising HIV epidemic, 12-year-old Boaz uncovers a devastating secret about the father he idolizes that threatens to tear his family apart. Across a yearslong journey, Boaz seeks to heal the wound and reclaim the father-son bond he never stopped yearning for.

title: Gatto
overview: After years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, a scrappy black cat named Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, a ruthless local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose — unless Venice gets the better of him first.

title: Tristes Tropiques
overview: A group of young assassins, trained by the rainforest's absolute ruler known as 'Master' and affiliated with the organization 'Tristes Tropiques,' struggle with mutual distrust as they vow to exact bloody revenge.

title: The Room Below
overview: After losing her son to cancer, a grieving mother living with a mysterious creature in her home befriends another boy to replace her dead son. But when a retired detective begins investigating the child's disappearance, her carefully constructed world starts to unravel.

title: A Good Little Soldier
overview: Follows Carla, a 43-year-old high-performing executive newly recruited as HR manager of a major insurer, tasked with rebuilding its brand in a corporate environment where vulnerability is not an asset.

title: Silence of the Estuaries
overview: A meditative documentary set in Ukraine’s Tuzly Estuaries National Nature Park during a full-scale war. Across four seasons, scientist Ivan, park director Iryna, and their team document war crimes against nature, rescue birds, fight poaching, and restore fragile ecosystems. A reflection on life and death, the film reveals the fragility of nature and the quiet strength of those who defend it.

title: Anxious People
overview: On the day before Christmas Eve, investment banker Zara begrudgingly finds herself mingling with a group of strangers at an open house. When a reluctant bank robber inadvertently takes the group hostage, chaos and oversharing ensues, secrets are revealed and literally nothing goes according to plan

title: "There's A Killer Among Us"
overview: When they discover their friends corpse, four friends have to put their house party on hold and figure who the killer is among them.

title: A Christmas Rescue
overview: Set in the charming town of Cedar Ridge, A Christmas Rescue follows dedicated physician Emma Ross who along with her dog, Shep, is determined to make her beloved community’s annual Christmas Cares celebration the most meaningful yet. When traveling veterinarian, Dr. Matthew McGuire arrives to temporarily take over the local animal clinic, he proposes adding a Christmas pet adoption event to the festivities. As they work side by side to bring people – and rescue animals – together for the holidays, Emma and Matthew discover that the greatest Christmas miracle may be finding a place where both hearts and shelter pets finally belong.

title: Still Afloat
overview: José Antonio, 89, is losing his memory. Although his family forbids him from doing so, he convinces his friend Mindo to go out fishing on the boat. Together, they are left adrift at sea, forcing them to confront old age and the passing of time.

title: Boorman and the Devil
overview: Featuring commentary from surviving participants, as well as other filmmakers and critics, this documentary chronicles the career of director John Boorman and the tumultuous production of his film Exorcist II: The Heretic, exploring its critical and commercial failure, how it changed the industry, and the importance of risk-taking in art.

title: Echoes from the Void
overview: An enigmatic drifter, suspected of kidnapping a young girl, takes the psychiatrist who is assigned to his case, on a mind-bending journey, filled with mystery, mayhem and other-worldly horror.

title: MYSTERY ARENA
original_title: ミステリー・アリーナ
overview: Six contestants compete in a high-stakes live TV quiz show to solve a complex "closed-circle" murder mystery for a 10 billion yen jackpot.

title: The Greatest Christmas Gift
overview: When an unexpected setback threatens their Christmas wedding, Emma and Caleb discover that the greatest gifts are found in faith, selfless love and a community that reminds them to keep believing.

title: Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity VS Raiya
original_title: 超宇宙刑事ギャバン インフィニティVSライヤ
overview: Seeking the truth behind the "Biscatonic Cluster  Incident", which claimed an unprecedented number of victims and turned Death Gavan evil, Gavan Infinity —Reiji Doki— sets out for Planet Alkam, one of the planets where the incident took place. There, Gavan Raiya —Kunai Kazanami— who was tracking Death Gavan’s whereabouts, also appears from across dimensions…

title: Making Christmas Bright
overview: ​In Making Christmas Bright, Kay, is a devoted middle school teacher in the close-knit Kentucky town of White Grove who believes God has opened the door to an exciting new career and a new life in the city. With Christmas approaching, Kay is preparing to leave behind her father, lifelong friends, students and the community she has always called home. But when she volunteers for her small-town church’s “Christmas Angel Tree” project, and is paired with Joshua, a newly arrived police officer looking for a fresh start of his own, an act of service begins changing both of their lives.

title: Evel
overview: Trapped inside an autonomous electric vehicle on an isolated highway, a young woman must survive as a malevolent force systematically erases her digital footprint before delivering her to a ruthless billionaire predator.

title: American Doctor
overview: United by a shared oath to save lives, three American doctors—Palestinian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian—work in a besieged hospital in Gaza and return to the United States to fight for the patients and colleagues they left behind.

title: Magudam
overview: Peaceful medical representative and shipping harbor worker Linga's life changes because of betrayal and conflict in a coastal community.

title: The Wrong Girls
overview: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

title: Nibba Nibbi
overview: A stolen hard drive drags a ruthless couple into a deadly game of power and survival.

title: Insidious Possession
overview: A former A-student begins lashing out in school and at home. Her parents reach out to their priest for help. Only to realize that the girl is possessed by the devil. Now the unexperienced priest must fight for the girl’s soul and the souls of the entire town.

overview: During the prosperous Tang Dynasty, Detective Di Renjie and his allies Li Sicheng and Qing Ci unravel a web of deceit as they investigate a series of murders, only to discover a long-buried conspiracy.

title: Influencers
overview: In the picturesque landscapes of Southern France, a young woman's chilling fascination with murder and identity theft sends her life into a whirlwind of chaos.

title: Wick Is Pain
overview: Witness the never-before-seen footage and true story behind the John Wick phenomenon – from independent film to billion-dollar franchise.
