title: Mudborn
overview: Hsu-Chuan, who works at a game company, accidentally brings home a broken clay doll from a haunted house while developing a new horror VR game. Unexpectedly, his pregnant wife, Mu-Hua, a cultural relic restorer, develops an obsession with the doll and relentlessly tries to repair it. As strange things begin to happen in the house, Mu-Hua's condition deteriorates, and Hsu-Chuan, at his wits' end, seeks help from a spiritual medium, Ah-Sheng. Meanwhile, the horrifying secret hidden behind the clay doll begins to surface.

title: Gnome Alone 2: Game of Gnomes
overview: Chloë and Liam travel back in time to save mankind from warring families and the dreaded Troggs, with their gnome allies Quicksilver, Zook and Zamfeer at their side.

title: Fireworks in the Deep
original_title: PHÁO HOA DƯỚI LÒNG ĐẠI DƯƠNG
overview: This romantic short film is about two boys who carry their own loneliness and wounds. When a seemingly forgotten memory takes them to Phu Quy Island, a chance encounter opens up an opportunity for both of them to heal, understand and find a reason to stay.

title: Mom, Again
overview: Burned out by life in Seoul, Su-bin returns home and joins her mom's traditional Makgeolli brewery. Living together only deepens the tension between them until mom's sudden death. The next morning, Su-bin wakes up to find the same day beginning all over again. Trapped in a time loop where her mother dies every night, can Su-bin finally mend their relationship and save mom's life?

title: The Two-Body Problem
overview: Plot TBA; sequel to The Love Hypothesis.

title: Gak Masuk Akal
overview: Plot under wraps.

title: Spider-Man: Lotus
overview: Peter Parker, who is struggling to recover from the loss of Gwen Stacy and contemplating hanging up the suit for good, until he receives a letter from a terminally ill child, requesting that Spider-Man pay a visit before he passes away.

title: Insidious Rewind
overview: Searching for her missing brother, a young woman traces his final signal to an abandoned warehouse, where she discovers a collection of cursed VHS tapes. Captured and forced to watch, she endures four found-footage nightmares that may reveal what happened to him—and what now awaits her.

title: Don't Feed The Muse
overview: Alex Bale, a SpongeBob conspiracy theorist on YouTube, has an alien called his "muse" living with him that gives him all of his video ideas.

title: Raindrops
overview: Two water droplets – a boy and a girl – set out on a journey across the world, shifting through different states of matter. When a lightning strike shatters the boy into scattered fragments, the girl searches desperately to restore him.

title: Parie 6
overview: Parie 6 stages incarnations of our humanity that meet and dance together until the psychotic epiphaneia. The film explores the search for a supple spirituality at the heart of chaos and existential violence.

title: ماجراجویی در جزیره جیمز باند
overview: The James Bond film, directed by Bahman Goodarzi, is co-produced by Hamid Pandashte and Ehsan Zalipour.

title: Red Cry
overview: A new and explosive documentary on the US genocide against the Lakota Native American nations.

title: The Cuckoo Clock
overview: A young woman falls in love with the home-health-care nurse sent to care for her Grandmother with dementia. When the nurse mysteriously disappears, Grandma’s cuckoo clock speaks to her with a warning… Grandma might be responsible.

title: Tenet: Uninverted
overview: This is the movie Tenet, but the film has been re-edited to fit a chronological timeline. Everything you see has been rearranged to be seen in realtime.

title: Survive
overview: While participating in the reality competition show 'Survive', Clayton Gibbons quickly discovers he's not alone in the woods.

title: Suckers
overview: When five teenage girls in the mid-1980s spend a summer night trying a mysterious new strain of hallucinogenic lollipops, they soon discover that these "suckers" come with a deadly price. As the drug's effects set in, the group's bond is tested by bloody twists that no amount of hairspray could fix.

title: Pigstown
overview: The pigs are everywhere. A descent into a man’s private hell.

title: Untitled Jurassic World Rebirth Sequel
overview: Eighth installment in the Jurassic franchise, set to shoot in 2027. Plot details TBA.

title: Parasomnia
overview: After playing a guided meditation to induce lucid dreaming, the protagonist begin to experience strange phenomena inside his home. As the dream deepens, the boundaries of reality blur, leading him toward a terrifying encounter with an unknown entity.

title: Parasomnia
overview: After her friend vanishes, Riley must confront the demon from her night terrors that may have crossed into reality, while facing her own tragic past.

title: Udaipur Files: Kanhaiya Lal Tailor Murder
original_title: Udaipur Files: Kanhaiya Lal Tailor Murder
overview: In June 2022, Kanhaiya Lal Sahu, a tailor in Udaipur, India, was brutally murdered. The events surrounding the murder are explored, delving into the conspiracy and the deeper issues of religious extremism, digital radicalization, and intelligence failures that led to the tragic event.

title: Wendehorn
overview: Tara is lead to a sacred forest after reading the Necronomicon. It it there that she is stalked by a creature that roams the woods and protects it's land and property.

title: I Am a Plaything
overview: Hyo-min, who became a prostitute by choice, undergoes sex training to serve clients under the supervision of Kyeong-seop, the manager of the establishment. She services countless men and even learns advanced techniques directly from Kyeong-mi, who works with her. Meanwhile, Kyeong-seop gradually opens his heart as he discovers the reason behind Hyo-min's decision to enter prostitution.

title: The Last Jiangshi
overview: In Chinese folklore, the corpse-herding rituals of Xiangxi gave birth to the myth of the jiangshi, or hopping vampire. In 1985, Mr. Vampire brought the jiangshi to the big screen, making it a cultural icon. Over thirty years later, as the genre fades into memory, The Last Jiangshi (original title: China’s Last Vampire) finds the only known jiangshi still existing in the modern world—Old Li.

title: The Treatment
overview: Trapped in a sterile labyrinth, a patient fights to reclaim her fragmented identity as the lines between guidance, manipulation, and reality blur.

title: To Kill a War Machine
overview: Through real-time bodycam and phone footage, frontline activists take audiences along on their audacious raids to tear down arms factories around the UK. Since 2020, direct action group Palestine Action have documented their operations to dismantle the companies and infrastructure supplying weapons to the ongoing genocide in Gaza.

title: Dog Alone
overview: A dog was abandoned in its home at the same time my grandfather became a widower, and I was returning from London, a place where I felt lonelier than ever.

title: Netflix Tudum 2025
overview: Celebrate your favorite shows and movies at this star-studded, live global fan event with special performances and exclusive reveals.

title: Sam Nzima: A Journey Through His Lens
original_title: Sam Nzima: A Journey Through His Lens
overview: Going behind the lens, Sam Nzima’s life unfolds against one of history’s most recognised photographs, the haunting image of Hector Pieterson during the 1976 Soweto Uprising. Through the events surrounding June 16, 1976, the film chronicles Nzima’s life, from his early days in rural Transvaal to his rise as a key figure in South African journalism, at the frontlines of media that forever changed the political landscape of South Africa.

title: Girl in the Attic
overview: Kelsey honors her late mother by training for a marathon and sharing her journey online. Her posts attract Billy, a grocery worker caring for his disabled mother, Debbie. Obsessed, Billy kidnaps Kelsey and hides her in their attic, controlling her for years. When Debbie discovers the truth, she and Kelsey must fight for survival.

title: Sacrifice
overview: In the 1940s, a prison warden attempts to discipline a defiant inmate within a brutal correctional system. As tensions rise, their relationship evolves into a psychological duel.

title: Drug Bust Storm
overview: Border drug lords thrive as anti-narcotics police fight fiercely. Vice Captain Xiao Ruolan falls into a trap during a raid, missing, while an impostor infiltrates the force. Drug lord Chen Qiang plots a major deal. Conflicts erupt: real vs. fake Xiao, cartel infighting, and gunfights. Who survives when the truth emerges?

title: Neues Land
overview: After many years, geologist Ina Sedlitz returns to her home village of Neukirch - a place that has been transformed from a former brown coal mining area into a popular tourist destination. Ina only wants one thing: to transfer her inheritance of the family hotel to her niece Mara and finally put the past behind her. But when she is asked to draw up a geological report for the man-made lake, she comes across dangerous instabilities - and the shadows of a long-suppressed family secret.

title: Hold the Fort
overview: A HOA turns out to be more troublesome than usual in this wildly amusing, FX-heavy freak-out about newly minted suburbanites unexpectedly forced to take part in a struggle against monstrous forces.

title: Curious Tales of a Temple
overview: An epic animated fantasy anthology film intertwining six storylines from China's classic supernatural story collection "Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio" by Pu Songling. The six stories center on Lanruo Temple, an ancient ruin haunted by spirits. Weaving in classic tales like "Taoist from Laoshan Mountain," "Princess Lotus," "Nie Xiaoqian," "The Painted Skin" and "The Daughter of Magistrate Lu." These stories — spanning humans, ghosts and demons — explore love, death and morality against shifting time. The film merges six distinct styles into one anthology. For example, "Taoist from Laoshan Mountain" uses felt-textured animation, while "The Painted Skin" mirrors Song dynasty painting aesthetics.

title: Miles & Juliette
overview: 22-year-old Miles Davis embarks on a transformative trip to Paris in 1949, where he falls into a passionate romance with Juliette Gréco, the French singer, actress, and Left Bank icon. What begins as an intimate affair blossoms into a profound connection between two young artists—just before they became cultural legends.

title: Terrestrial
overview: A reunion weekend spirals out of control for four college friends when the host - a science fiction writer on the verge of newfound success - fights to maintain his sense of reality in the face of sudden, uncanny dangers.

overview: Antwerp, 2003. A gang of thieves rob the impenetrable Diamond Center. Who was behind one of the world's biggest heists - and how did they pull it off?

title: Parasomnia
overview: After playing a guided meditation to induce lucid dreaming, the protagonist begin to experience strange phenomena inside his home. As the dream deepens, the boundaries of reality blur, leading him toward a terrifying encounter with an unknown entity.

title: Parasomnia
overview: After her friend vanishes, Riley must confront the demon from her night terrors that may have crossed into reality, while facing her own tragic past.

title: Udaipur Files: Kanhaiya Lal Tailor Murder
original_title: Udaipur Files: Kanhaiya Lal Tailor Murder
overview: In June 2022, Kanhaiya Lal Sahu, a tailor in Udaipur, India, was brutally murdered. The events surrounding the murder are explored, delving into the conspiracy and the deeper issues of religious extremism, digital radicalization, and intelligence failures that led to the tragic event.

title: Wendehorn
overview: Tara is lead to a sacred forest after reading the Necronomicon. It it there that she is stalked by a creature that roams the woods and protects it's land and property.

title: I Am a Plaything
overview: Hyo-min, who became a prostitute by choice, undergoes sex training to serve clients under the supervision of Kyeong-seop, the manager of the establishment. She services countless men and even learns advanced techniques directly from Kyeong-mi, who works with her. Meanwhile, Kyeong-seop gradually opens his heart as he discovers the reason behind Hyo-min's decision to enter prostitution.

title: The Last Jiangshi
overview: In Chinese folklore, the corpse-herding rituals of Xiangxi gave birth to the myth of the jiangshi, or hopping vampire. In 1985, Mr. Vampire brought the jiangshi to the big screen, making it a cultural icon. Over thirty years later, as the genre fades into memory, The Last Jiangshi (original title: China’s Last Vampire) finds the only known jiangshi still existing in the modern world—Old Li.

title: The Treatment
overview: Trapped in a sterile labyrinth, a patient fights to reclaim her fragmented identity as the lines between guidance, manipulation, and reality blur.

title: To Kill a War Machine
overview: Through real-time bodycam and phone footage, frontline activists take audiences along on their audacious raids to tear down arms factories around the UK. Since 2020, direct action group Palestine Action have documented their operations to dismantle the companies and infrastructure supplying weapons to the ongoing genocide in Gaza.

title: Journey to You
overview: After missing out on a promotion, Monica reluctantly walks the Camino de Santiago. She's surprised when along the way she finds inner peace and a potential romance.

title: Tafiti: Across the Desert
overview: Tafiti, a young meerkat, initially rejects friendship with Bristles, a bush pig. When his grandpa is bitten by a snake, Tafiti sets off to find the flower for the cure. Bristles wants to prove that adventures are always better with friends.

title: Sugar Baby
overview: When her boyfriend lands in prison, Jade struggles financially and becomes a sugar baby to a wealthy older man. Upon her boyfriend's release, she must choose between her past love and her new lifestyle.

title: The Truce
overview: Karlag, short for Karaganda Corrective Labor Camp, was one of the largest labor camps within the Soviet Gulag system. Established in 1931, it was located in the Karagandy Region of Kazakhstan. The film will explore the hardships faced by people during the 1930s-1950s and the resilience of human dignity despite the daily struggle for survival. The atmosphere of Karlag will be conveyed through costumes, props, and sets created after extensive research in archives and museums.

title: My Father's Shadow
overview: Two young brothers explore Lagos with their estranged father during the 1993 Nigerian election crisis, witnessing both the city's magnitude and their father's daily struggles as political unrest threatens their journey home.

title: L'Enfant Seul
overview: Tony, a young unemployed father, lives with his wife and son in a shabby apartment building in Marseille. As the frustrations of daily life threaten the couple's equilibrium, a mysterious neighbor and his cat move into the apartment next door...

title: GIRLS BAND CRY The Movie: Youth Rhapsody
original_title: 劇場版総集編 ガールズバンドクライ 【前編】 青春狂走曲
overview: After she drops out of school and moves to Tokyo by herself, Nina Iseri meets Momoka Kawaragi, the vocalist of her favourite band, and discovers the allure of music. Together with Subaru Awa, who always hides her true intentions, Tomo Ebizuka, who was ignored by her parents, and Rupa who has no relatives, Nina starts the rock band Togenashi Togeari. The five girls who all have their own worries confront the absurdities of the world and search for their place to belong.

title: Oh My Sweetheart
overview: Joaquin, a lonely homeless kid finds a life friend in a little puppy, just to later find out the dog is lost and has an owner after Joaquin's older brother refuses to keep the puppy with them and Joaquin must find the owner to bring the puppy back home and finally finding a true friendship.

title: Ziam
original_title: ปากกัด ตีนถีบ
overview: In a fight for survival against a horrifying army of zombies, a former Muay Thai fighter must use skill, speed and grit to save his girlfriend.

title: Brick
overview: When a mysterious brick wall encloses their apartment building overnight, Tim and Olivia must unite with their wary neighbors to get out alive.

title: The Prank
overview: When 12-year-old Chinese exchange student Xi Zhou's April Fools' prank goes disastrously wrong, it drags his host family, their son Lucas, and his crush Charlotte (Charly) into a tumultuous adventure full of gangsters, cash and chaos. With the mafia, a crew of rapper-thugs, and a bumbling police duo in pursuit, Lucas and Xi must team up to fix the mess they’ve created. Their only hope? Pulling off one final, genius prank.

title: ChaO
overview: In a futuristic world where humans and mermaids coexist, the life of mild-mannered office worker Stephan is upended when he is suddenly proposed to by Chao — a princess from the mermaid kingdom. With no time to make sense of what's happening, Stephan soon finds himself living with the unpredictable, wholehearted Chao, and her sincere love begins to break down his emotional barriers.

title: Mountainhead
overview: A group of billionaire friends get together against the backdrop of a rolling international crisis.

title: I Joined a Cult
overview: For her journalism thesis project, Sam joins a cult to film an exposé with hidden cameras. As Sam dives deeper into the cult's rituals, she uncovers their darkest secrets and confronts the affliction of her past.

title: Skin on Skin
overview: An industrial slaughterhouse somewhere in Germany. Jakob is a security guard, while Boris from Bosnia does the slaughtering. Amid the cold and the violence, a silent bond develops between the two, as does an unspoken longing for freedom.

title: Fortune Teller
overview: Zhao Dachun is a well-known local "psychic" in the Northeast. In order to popularize fortune telling, he engages in metaphysics on the surface, but privately joins forces with his younger brother Biao to help fortune tellers truly solve practical problems, leading to many amusing situations. Later, he becomes obsessed with money and gets involved in the feudal magic scam. When he comes to his senses, he exposes the criminals’ conspiracy.

title: Helldivers
overview: A live-action film based on the video game. Plot TBA.

title: Sniper: The Last Stand
overview: To stop an arms dealer from unleashing a deadly superweapon, Ace sniper Brandon Beckett and Agent Zero are deployed to Costa Verde to lead a group of elite soldiers against an unrelenting militia. Taking an untested sniper under his wing, Beckett faces his newest challenge: giving orders instead of receiving them. With both time and ammo running low in a race to save humanity, the team must overcome all odds just to survive.

title: The Shadows Of The Web
overview: An educational resource that explores tech companies' role in protecting young people online, the rising threat of online child exploitation and abuse, the nation’s response, and the challenges in safeguarding young people in the digital age.

title: Miss Valentine
overview: Samantha carries the baggage of having had an onstage meltdown after winning her hometown’s Miss Valentine pageant as a teen. Years later, she returns home following a painful breakup and finds that things are much different this time around.

title: A Kill for a Kill
overview: A deceptive motivational speaker becomes entangled in a deadly game with a fan who suggests they kill each other's spouses.

title: Demon City
overview: Framed for his family's murder and left for dead, an ex-hitman will stop at nothing to exact revenge on the masked "demons" who have taken over his city.

title: Paradise Man (ii)
overview: Paradise Man searches for meaning in an unknowable universe.

title: In the Sea of Strange Thoughts
overview: A 21-year chronicle exploring the strange life and the cosmic thinking about death and life of Kim Uchang, one of Korea's foremost thinkers, who leads a life in complete agreement with his philosophy. What meaning do things and a house have to the scholar who cannot throw away his parents' belongings and cannot leave the house he has lived in for 40 years? Can he ever complete his final book?

title: Bayang-Bayang Anak Jahanam
overview: Gina and Gani's lives changed drastically when they discovered their son Agni drew his energy from unknown sources. As fear spread, they uncovered the truth: Agni was no ordinary child—he was the Child of Damnation.

title: Maspalomas
overview: After breaking up with his partner, 76 year-old Vicente leads life the way he likes it in Maspalomas: he spends his days lying in the sun, partying, and looking for pleasure. An unexpected accident obliges him to return to San Sebastián and to the daughter he abandoned years ago. Vicente will have to live in a retirement home where he finds himself driven back into the closet and to conceal a part of himself that he thought was long resolved. In this new environment, Vicente must ask himself if he has enough time left to make his peace with others… and with himself.

title: Bachhala Malli
overview: The story is set in the 1990s and follows the emotional and action-filled journey of Bachhala Malli, a rural hero. The narrative combines intense drama with romance, focusing on the protagonist’s challenges and personal growth in a rustic backdrop.

title: The Adventure
overview: Because of a meteor shower, 43-year-old Huang Yuqi (Jia Bing) and 18-year-old himself (Wang Hao) exchanged souls, and the man and the sophomore boy accidentally fell into a burst of dual-time laughter.

title: Cameron Esposito: Four Pills
overview: In a 1-hour long stand-up special, Cameron Esposito guides the audience through the ups and downs of her bipolar disorder diagnosis, with detours to talk about her extremely unlucky dog, a near-deadly bacterial infection, and the things she learned during a stint in (virtual) divinity school.

title: The Non-Actor
overview: Elliot is staying with her ex’s new girlfriend while attending a medical trial for her recent, unexplained loss of hearing. As she reconfigures her relationship with her (sonic) environment and herself, an intimate connection sparks between the two women.

title: Second Victims
overview: During a hectic shift in the neurological department, skilled doctor Alexandra takes on extra responsibility. But a misjudgment ends in tragedy.

title: Ingest
overview: Whilst clearing through his dead dad's apartment, David discovers an unmarked videotape. Which, upon playing, draws him to a sinister self-reflection.

title: A Christmas Dream
overview: Ashley and her mother Susan are two New Yorkers coming to Italy to sell the grandparents ranch. Once there Ashley falls in love with one of the potential buyers and decides to spend her life with him.

title: Forbidden Planet
overview: Remake of the 1956 sci-fi classic Forbidden Planet. Plot TBA.

title: Marvel Studios Assembled: The Making of Deadpool & Wolverine
original_title: Marvel Studios Assembled: The Making of Deadpool & Wolverine
overview: Hugh Jackman, Ryan Reynolds, and director Shawn Levy sit down and spill the proverbial beans about how "Deadpool & Wolverine" was conceived, carried to term, and then birthed.

title: Wonka 2
overview: The sequel to the 2023 film. Plot TBA.

title: Bloody Mary
overview: The film tells the story of Moira and Letizia, two modern witches who hide a dark secret. Every Blood Moon they perform a ritual with a different man, a fundamental piece of their magic. However, on this occasion, the chosen one threatens to alter the course of events. With their powers and lives at stake, the protagonists are forced to face their inner demons. The relationship between them could be stronger than any spell, perhaps destined to last for eternity.

title: Three Loves
overview: Lena, a 40-year-old actress freshly divorced, is determined to rebuild her life. Embracing change, she quickly plunges into the vibrant nightlife of Warsaw—and into the arms of Kundel, a young, charismatic student. Their relationship is a passionate explosion where the boundaries between intimacy and desire begin to blur. Meanwhile, Lena’s ex-husband Jan, a respected lawyer, struggles to accept the end of their marriage.

title: Sea of Hope
overview: Josef is a successful violin maker. He enjoys seeing the instruments he makes bring joy to people all over the world. He himself prefers to spend his time in his workshop in the courtyard of a tenement house. He has never been to the sea; his sea is a puddle in the courtyard, which he protects from drying out so that the birds have something to drink. He has no wife or children, only his dog Pampeliška, who accompanies him everywhere. Josef secretly loves his beautiful neighbor Anežka and looks forward to Wednesday chess games with his best friend Václav, a charismatic piano tuner.

However, his uncle quickly makes himself at home and shows no sign of leaving anytime soon. Torn between his sense of familial duty and growing tension in the flat, Akam begins to suspect there's more to his uncle's visit than just a casual trip. What follows is a series of revelations and unexpected events that could have life changing consequences for them both.

overview: Angelika's seemingly perfect life conceals a lack of fulfillment. While arranging her best friend's wedding, she meets Simon, her friend's daring and passionate brother who challenges Angelika's deeply held principles and life beliefs.

title: La patasola
overview: A remote and lonely hotel holds a dark secret. La Patasola, a vengeful being marked by the loss of her son and her leg, seeks to punish the unfaithful. Rodrigo, an investigator, and Susana, his young lover, arrive at the hotel under the pretext of investigating an unsolved disappearance, but they will soon discover that they are locked in a deadly trap. La Patasola, thirsty for revenge, will unleash all her fury against the infidels and make them pay the price for their deceit, transforming their visit into a nightmare with no escape.

title: Ghamasaan
overview: Set in the Hindi heartland, the story follows a cat and mouse chase against a ruthless dacoit. An honest IPS officer is determined to hunt him down, corrupt politicians notwithstanding.

title: Sing: Thriller
overview: Buster Moon dreams up a star-studded spectacle set to Michael Jackson's "Thriller" in this animated short featuring characters from the hit "Sing" films.

title: iHostage
overview: When a gunman enters an Apple Store in the heart of Amsterdam, the police face a delicate challenge to resolve the standoff.

title: Ruth & Boaz
overview: A talented singer leaves the Atlanta music scene and starts over in small-town Tennessee, where she finds love and new purpose but can't escape the past.

title: Princess Goldenhair
overview: The royal squire George tastes a bite of a magical snake and understands the language of animals. However, he is guilty of violating his king's order, and so he faces either the death penalty or an uncertain and dangerous journey to find Goldilocks, a princess from a mysterious kingdom in the middle of a lake. He therefore sets off on a journey accompanied by Stephen, with whom he grew up since childhood, and a small dog named Lucky, whose life George saved. George is faced with a whole series of adventures and surprises along the way. He has no idea that Stephen is jealous and is not as sincere a friend as he seemed. Fortunately, George has brave allies, the animals he has helped.

title: The Spiritualization of Jeff Boyd
overview: Jeff, a mental health patient in a clinic high in the Swiss Alps, escapes to his only friend Morton, while Prisha, the daughter of Indian guru Majula, mysteriously enters Jeff’s life. After an argument with Morton at his bakery where the fugitive wanted to start over, Jeff moves on and visits a monk who gives workshops for enlightenment in the Balkan mountains, in search and full of hope for redemption. Still haunted by his past, Jeff must run again and travels with Prisha, who secretly followed him, to India to find a new life and to get her father’s blessing for the two now in love. Can he fulfil his dream?

title: The Fires
overview: Top volcanologist Anna Arnardóttir faces two disasters at once: a volcanic eruption that threatens the safety of the capital city and a love affair that could destroy her marriage.

title: My Oxford Year
overview: An ambitious American fulfilling her dream of studying at Oxford falls for a charming Brit hiding a secret that may upend her perfectly planned life.

title: Jaat
overview: A mysterious stranger journeys to a remote town controlled by a callous crime lord, with one violent mission — restoring justice to its people.

title: Adult
overview: Fourteen-year-old Antonio was living with his father when suddenly one day his father didn't come home and didn't respond to his messages or phone calls. Antonio learns from a neighbor that his father has been hospitalized due to a motorcycle accident, and since then he has had to cope with life on his own; in addition to studying for schoolwork and feeding himself, he also has to spend money on fixing his car....... It is not easy to get through to the day when his father is released from the hospital, and Antonio discovers that his father has gone to the police station, and it turns out that the car accident has another hidden agenda...

title: Watchmen: Chapter II
overview: Suspicious of the events ensnaring their former colleagues, Nite Owl and Silk Spectre are spurred out of retirement to investigate. As they grapple with personal ethics, inner demons and a society turned against them, they race the clock to uncover a deepening plot that might trigger global nuclear war.

title: Diamonds
overview: In 1970s Rome, a filmmaker gathers actresses for a new project, which triggers memories of his past working in a Roman costume shop, run by Alberta and Gabriella, navigating personal and professional challenges while creating costumes for a major film.

title: Paying for It
overview: In the late 1990s, when Sonny seeks to redefine his long-term relationship with Chester, the painfully introverted cartoonist begins sleeping with sex workers and discovers an unexpected new form of intimacy.

title: The Last Viking
overview: After serving fourteen years for robbery, Anker is released from prison and reunites with his mentally ill brother Manfred, who alone knows where the stolen money is hidden but has forgotten its location, sending them on a journey to recover the loot and confront who they are.

title: The Last Blossom
overview: An elderly inmate serving a life sentence awaits a lonely death in solitary—until a voice calls out to him. It belongs to a balsam flower, Housenka, that speaks like a human. Through their 'conversation', the old man reflects on the life he's led.

title: Secret Delivery
overview: In the snowy Giant Mountains at the end of the German occupation, a group of child heroes rescue a downed French pilot. Their actions resemble the principle of the well-known 'telephone game' – the pilot is passed between mountain villages like a secret message – secret delivery – at school. But the children play a highly risky game. They are confronted by deadly soldiers of the occupying army, they must outwit traitors and informers and, last but not least, survive in the harsh conditions of winter in the mountains.

title: The Tasters
overview: In autumn 1943, in Gross-Partsch, 26-year-old Rosa, who had come from Berlin to stay with the parents of her husband Gregor, who was fighting on the Russian front, was taken by the SS to a mysterious place. Forced to taste a dish, she joins the group of tasters responsible for checking that the food destined for Hitler is not poisoned.

title: Margie Claus
overview: When Santa goes missing Christmas Eve, his wife Margie Claus has to assemble a rag-tag team of long-retired reindeer to rescue Santa and save Christmas

title: A Private Life
overview: When renowned psychiatrist Lilian Steiner learns of the sudden death of a patient, she suspects murder.  She mounts a private investigation, enlisting an odd assortment of quirky characters.

title: You Are the Apple of My Eye
overview: A group of close friends who attend a private school all have a debilitating crush on the sunny star pupil, Sun-ah. The only member of the group who claims not to is Jin-woo, but he ends up loving her as well.

title: A House of Dynamite
overview: When a single, unattributed missile is launched at the United States, a race begins to determine who is responsible and how to respond.

title: Mommy
overview: A narrator retells the memory of his relationship with his stepmother amidst the absence of his father during the Christmas season.

title: The Wizard's Endearment - Dark Ages
overview: The Wizard's Endearment "Dark Ages' is a fantasy feature film about a wizard on a perilous journey to find a medical cure that will stop a horrible disease that has stricken an ancient race of wizards known as the Nevolons. Alaric, a very powerful wizard of the Sacornic bloodline sets out on a magical journey to find a cure for his beloved wife Anastasia, and somehow bring his only son back from the land of the dead.

title: Refraction
overview: As time itself nears collapse, a tense conversation between two time travelers reveals the devastating truth behind humanity’s final chance at survival.

title: One of Them Days
overview: Best friends and roommates Dreux and Alyssa are about to have One of Them Days. When they discover Alyssa’s boyfriend has blown their rent money, the duo finds themselves going to extremes in a comical race against the clock to avoid eviction and keep their friendship intact.

title: The Real You
overview: Why had a mother who seemed happy desired to end her own life? Desperate to uncover his mother’s true intentions, Sakuya ventures into uncharted technological territory. He turns to VF (Virtual Figure), a technology that aggregates personal data from one’s life to create a “human” in a virtual space.

title: Daughters of Putien
overview: Between the 1970s and the 1990s, under China's strict one-child policy, an unknown number of baby girls were abandoned by their parents who wanted to have a son. Tens of thousands of these unwanted girls were brought to Putien, Fujian, where they were raised by foster families. But their foster parents didn't do this out of the kindness of their hearts. Instead, they had a clear goal: one day the girls were to marry their sons. Decades later, the women have grown up, and they want answers: where did they came from? And why were they traded like a commodity?

title: The Night Before Christmas in Wonderland
original_title: The Night Before Christmas in Wonderland
overview: It’s St Nick’s turn for an adventure down the rabbit hole. There he meets the Mad Hatter, recast as a high-fashion, reindeer-loving tea party host; the White Rabbit, an endearingly scatty and forgetful character; the Queen of Hearts, a Scrooge-esque tinsel-hater, her antagonistic sidekick, the Cheshire Cat and Alice herself, whose kindness helps St. Nick save Christmas.

title: Poklad
overview: Julie unexpectedly travels to the other side of the world to visit her father Karl, in order to settle their past once and for all. She also wants to find out why he suddenly contacted her out of the blue, asking to borrow a large sum of money. Her journey takes her to the Indonesian island of Bali, where she not only meets her father, but also, thanks to him, becomes part of an expedition in search of a legendary treasure that is said to be lost forever.

title: Mind Cage
overview: A man who tries to break free from his thoughts but instead gets trapped too far because he keeps thinking about it.

title: Grand Prix of Europe
overview: Edda, a young mouse and the daughter of fairground operator Erwin, dreams of becoming a race car driver. Ahead of the 50th anniversary of the European Grand Prix, Edda gets the opportunity to meet her idol, racing star Ed, and to help her father save his failing business. But to do so, she'll have to get behind the wheel herself.

title: Gangstas
overview: On the streets of Antwerp, Badia, Junes and Volt are trying to tear themselves away from their past, but the underworld is inexorably pulling them back in. Adamo has worked his way up to become one of the most influential figures in the Antwerp drug trade. He becomes ever more entangled in a web of power and danger. His friends have to make a choice: stay loyal to Adamo or choose safety.

title: Preparation for the Next Life

Arya and his mother then try to investigate the connection between the embezzlement and the Shiratal Mustaqim bridge. However, their pursuit comes at the cost of their lives.

title: The Fires

title: Watchmen: Chapter II
overview: Suspicious of the events ensnaring their former colleagues, Nite Owl and Silk Spectre are spurred out of retirement to investigate. title: Diamonds
overview: In 1970s Rome, a filmmaker gathers actresses for a new project, which triggers memories of his past working in a Roman costume shop, run by Alberta and Gabriella, navigating personal and professional challenges while creating costumes for a major film.

title: Ed Kemper
overview: The horrifying true story of Ed Kemper, a cunning and sadistic serial killer shaped by childhood abuse, whose charm masked his grotesque obsession with murder, mutilation, and the ultimate act of revenge on his mother.

Based on true events set during WWII in Northeast China, an ordinary man is thrust into a turbulent fate against the backdrop of the inhumane bacterial experiments conducted by the Japanese Imperial Army's notorious Unit 731.

title: The Real You
overview: Why had a mother who seemed happy desired to end her own life? Desperate to uncover his mother’s true intentions, Sakuya ventures into uncharted technological territory. He turns to VF (Virtual Figure), a technology that aggregates personal data from one’s life to create a “human” in a virtual space.

title: Daughters of Putien
overview: Between the 1970s and the 1990s, under China's strict one-child policy, an unknown number of baby girls were abandoned by their parents who wanted to have a son. Tens of thousands of these unwanted girls were brought to Putien, Fujian, where they were raised by foster families. But their foster parents didn't do this out of the kindness of their hearts. Instead, they had a clear goal: one day the girls were to marry their sons. Decades later, the women have grown up, and they want answers: where did they came from? And why were they traded like a commodity?

title: The Night Before Christmas in Wonderland

overview: It’s St Nick’s turn for an adventure down the rabbit hole. title: Poklad
overview: Julie unexpectedly travels to the other side of the world to visit her father Karl, in order to settle their past once and for all. She also wants to find out why he suddenly contacted her out of the blue, asking to borrow a large sum of money. Her journey takes her to the Indonesian island of Bali, where she not only meets her father, but also, thanks to him, becomes part of an expedition in search of a legendary treasure that is said to be lost forever.

title: Mind Cage
overview: A man who tries to break free from his thoughts but instead gets trapped too far because he keeps thinking about it.

title: Grand Prix of Europe
overview: Edda, a young mouse and the daughter of fairground operator Erwin, dreams of becoming a race car driver. Ahead of the 50th anniversary of the European Grand Prix, Edda gets the opportunity to meet her idol, racing star Ed, and to help her father save his failing business. But to do so, she'll have to get behind the wheel herself.

title: Gangstas
overview: On the streets of Antwerp, Badia, Junes and Volt are trying to tear themselves away from their past, but the underworld is inexorably pulling them back in. His friends have to make a choice: stay loyal to Adamo or choose safety.

title: The Ballad of Wallis Island
overview: An eccentric lottery winner who lives alone on a remote island tries to make his fantasies come true by getting his favourite musicians to perform at his home.

title: The Quiet Son
overview: Pierre, a devoted father in his 50s, raises his two sons alone. When Louis, the youngest, leaves home to attend the Sorbonne in Paris, Fus, slightly older and not as successful academically, becomes more and more secretive. Driven by a fascination for violence, he gets entangled in far-right extremist groups, at the very opposite of his father’s values. Between them, there is love and hate, until tragedy happens.

overview: Parthenope, born in the sea near Naples in 1950, is beautiful, enigmatic, and intelligent. She is shamelessly courted by many. However, beauty comes at a cost.

title: Plankton: The Movie
overview: Plankton's tangled love story with his sentient computer wife goes sideways when she takes a stand — and decides to destroy the world without him.

title: Aghathiyaa
overview: Things go awry when a haunted mansion is opened as a tourist attraction by Aghathiyan leading to the unraveling of the dark history behind the mansion's previous occupant.

title: Unstoppable
overview: With the unwavering love and support of his devoted mother Judy and the encouragement of his coaches, Anthony Robles fights through adversity to earn a spot on the Arizona State Wrestling team. But it will demand everything he has, physically and mentally, to achieve his ultimate quest to become an NCAA Champion.

title: Unreachable
overview: Three young women live together in an old house in a corner of Tokyo. They are not related by blood, but they have been bound together by a strong bond for 12 years. They care about each other and spend their own ordinary days together. The matter of unrequited love arises for them that they can't tell anyone.

title: Dear Santa
overview: Likeable 6th grader Liam writes to Santa asking him to prove that he's real. But Liam is dyslexic and accidentally sends his letter to Satan instead, who shows up at Liam's house, excited to have his first fanboy letter and wanting a little of Liam's soul.

overview: After escaping from a mental hospital, a violent sociopath named Paul begins a dangerous rampage targeting Sofia, a world-famous pop star. Obsessed with her, he takes Sofia hostage in her own home, acting under the delusional belief that they are getting married. Paul is desperate to prove his devotion, leading to a tense and unpredictable situation.

overview: A seventeen-year-old girl with sun allergy lives a sheltered life. One night, she ventures out to play guitar, and she meets a guy she admires. As they develop a romance, she hides her condition from him, creating tension in their budding relationship.

title: Ugly Duckling Ms. Maeng
overview: Ms. Maeng, a small-town teacher, unexpectedly joins the team responsible for creating South Korea’s most important exam: the College Scholastic Ability Test. She thought it would be all about academic prestige and scholarly debate but instead finds herself locked away under spy-level security, her phone confiscated and surrounded by office politics. Can this unlikely underdog turn test stress into test success, or just test everyone's patience?

title: The Evil Inside
overview: Once a showbiz icon in Taiwan, Ho Jen-jen—better known as Golden Phoenix—vanished after reckless gambling left her drowning in debt. She abandoned her young daughter, severing all ties. Years later, she collapses and wakes up in a sinister nursing home. Beneath the facility’s eerie calm lurks "Death Bet,” a twisted game where terminal patients' lifespans are gambled away. Desperate to escape and find her daughter, she soon realizes the true horror has yet to unfold, and the most harrowing secret is still waiting to be revealed.

title: We Are Born Good
overview: A dining mishap caused a rift between Ji and Rui, leading to a cycle of revenge. Their already troubled lives only came together to fall apart.

title: The Awakening
overview: An elite military unit ventures into the South American tropical jungle on a mission to eliminate an enemy target. What begins as a tactical operation quickly turns into a nightmare when they encounter supernatural forces emerging from the depths of the jungle. Five hundred years earlier, a Spanish conquistador expedition was consumed by the same relentless force. Separated by centuries but connected by the same hostile territory, both incursions discover something hidden in the jungle: an ancient presence that cannot be controlled.

title: Heil Jupiter!
overview: Amidst crashing waves and monumental rocks on a distant coast, two young couples open up a realm of shifting realities. Unbeknownst to them, a mysterious entity watches from high above with Godlike judgment. Between these spaces exists a world balanced on the edge of the modern and the primitive, the high-tech and the rural, the corporeal and the mythic.

title: Medley
overview: Lola (16) is a lonely girl marked by a trauma that has followed her since childhood: the mysterious absence of her father. A talented swimmer with a vast collection of medals, Lola keeps a curious secret, she cannot swim the butterfly stroke. She has a strained relationship with her mother, and after one of their arguments she decides to spend her vacation alone in her uncle's town. There, the teenager's life changes radically she falls in love with Gabriel, makes new friends, and joins the town's struggling swim team. Now, every time Lola is in the water, these new emotions stir memories from her past. On the eve of an important championship, Lola finds herself facing fears and traumas she never expected, including the truth about her father's death.

title: The Sea Speaks His Name
overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia’s New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

title: Scrooge: A Christmas Carol Horror
overview: A horror take on the classic tale. When cruel businessman Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by ghosts on Christmas Eve, he will have to decide whether to heed their warning to change for the better or remain cold-hearted and merciless.

title: Frau ohne Namen
overview: A psychologist specializing in microexpression, Dr. Marlene Nielsen is called in to assist on an apparently obvious case of self-defence. She is asked to help establish the identity of a woman who fatally wounded an attacker, but who steadfastly refuses to speak. But in the face of the »woman without a name« Marlene sees evidence of an intentional act. When no-one takes her seriously, she begins to investigate on her own and comes across an unpunished crime from the past.

title: Beat Luke Littler
overview: Amateur darts players hope to make history against world champion Luke Littler in a live match hosted by Gary Lineker, with analysis from Richard Osman.

title: Phoenix Fury
overview: When Ewura-Ama, recently widowed, inherits Utopia Valley, a luxury resort tucked in the quiet hills of Ghana, her search for solitude is disrupted by the arrival of a high-profile guest. Their uneasy encounter stirs tensions that awaken secrets buried decades ago.

title: Brother Save Us
overview: A 12-year-old boy in the Midwest befriends an AI farmworker, creating tension with his brother while their father battles illness.

title: A Better Jianghu
overview: Two individuals, the scholar Shen Fang and the knight-errant Luo Han, steal a huge sum of silver from the official Qin Hui to support the anti-Jin rebels, devising a grand deception to combat the imperial guard and rally people from all walks of life to their cause during the Southern Song Dynasty.

title: Eyes on the Street
overview: Eyes on the Street, through three different public spaces in Istanbul, tells the story of who uses and transforms the city and its public spaces, and how these spaces are used. Who truly owns a city's common spaces, and who decides how those spaces will be used?

title: Who's Coming for Christmas?
overview: Having recently relocated, Julie is setting up her new home using pieces she inherited from her late grandmother, including a beautiful dining room table she plans to use on Christmas Eve when she hosts dinner for the first time. Though she doesn't have her guest list set just yet Julie takes inspiration from her grandmother and has faith that her holiday table for eight will be filled. Julie's warm, friendly nature leads her to quickly become part of the community and make friends, including her neighbor Mark and his young daughter Vanessa. Mark suggests that he and his family could join her, making Julie's dream of dinner for eight come true. But when bad weather keeps them from making the trip it looks like it will be a silent night with just the three of them unless a small Christmas miracle – or series of miracles – fills her holiday table.

title: AEW All Out 2026
overview: The 2026 All Out was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on September 26, 2026, at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, USA. The show was headlined by an AEW World Title match between current Champion Will Ospreay and challenger Jon Moxley.

title: The Sixth Sense
overview: Following an unexpected tragedy, child psychologist Malcolm Crowe meets a nine year old boy named Cole Sear, who is hiding a dark secret.

title: Christmas at the Kringles
overview: The Severson family move to a suburban neighborhood where their next-door neighbors, the Kringles, celebrate Christmas year-round. But when their son becomes increasingly attached to the unusual family, Mark and Julie begin to suspect that their neighbors aren't quite what they seem.

title: Felix Motel
overview: Felix Motel (2026)  Kim Martin Thomas  Starring Betty Boop (1930) and Felix the Cat (1931), Felix Motel is a quasimodo remake of The Cobweb Hotel, with a heavy influence from the 1960 classic, Psycho. The Cobweb Hotel is a 1936 animated short film directed by Dave Fleischer and produced by Fleischer Studios. Animated by David Tendlar and William Sturm, the setting is said to be one of Fleischer's desks, which the spider used to open the hoax hotel. Felix Motel, however, will be set in a Bates Motel inspired setting and will feature cameos from various public domain characters that include Tweety Pie, Popeye, Mickey and Minnie Mouse, to name just a few. Felix Hotel will not only pay homage to Psycho, but will have unsubtle nods to Scream, The Texas Chainsaw Massacre, Halloween and American Psycho. Set around the festive season of All Hallows' Eve, Betty will check into Felix's run-down motel, only to discover all is not what it seems.

title: Raid 2
overview: Set seven years after the events of the first film, it follows the return of IRS officer Amay Patnaik, who is attempting to take down a seemingly benevolent politician.

overview: A realtor is pulled back into the life he left behind after his former partner-in-crime resurfaces with an ominous message. With his crime-lord brother also on his trail, he must confront his past and the history he never fully buried.

overview: Yorkshire, 1898. A grieving woman and her son move back to the unoccupied house of her ex husband, recently found dead, but they discover that they are not alone inside the house.

overview: Science teacher Hank’s life changes when he reconnects with his first love and suspects that a new student may be his daughter—all while facing an alien threat in their town.

overview: Wille has always dreamed of becoming a superhero and fight crime alongside his father. This dream is shattered when Wille's brother, Charlie, is born. Charlie gets all the attention, and on top of that – he has superpowers. When a supervillain and an evil scientist enact a plan to overthrow the city, Wille and Charlie must put their differences aside and work together as a team. Can an infant and his envious brother save the city?

title: September 5

title: Revelations
overview: A pastor who believes in divine revelation and a detective haunted by visions pursue a missing person case — exposing their own demons in the process.

title: The Unrighteous

title: 100 Liters of Gold
