Twenty years have passed, and since that day Nicola has lived in Mexico with his uncle Nando, who raised him under a lie: Lucio was dead. A harsh upbringing in a ruthless country shaped him and taught him how to survive. Today, he's an adult working at the family restaurant, having buried the past under the weight of distance. But Nando decides to leave for good. On the eve of his escape, he chooses to reveal the truth: Nicola's father is still alive.

title: About an Intimate Matter
overview: Swarna is a dedicated high school science teacher who relocates to a conservative suburban town with her same-sex partner, Driti. They attempt to build a quiet life together, blending into the community while keeping their relationship private. However, their world is completely upended when one of Swarna's high school students discovers personal, intimate photos of her on social media. The discovery quickly leaks, placing Swarna under intense public and institutional scrutiny.

title: Girls und Panzer das Finale: Part 5
original_title: ガールズ＆パンツァー 最終章 第5話
overview: The fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou film series.

title: Haunted
overview: Mathilde, a troubled teenage girl who moves to the countryside with her family, finds out her new home is haunted by Isabeau, an amnesiac 19th-century ghost. The two form an unexpected friendship and team up to uncover Isabeau's past.

title: Some Detective
overview: Writer Hye-joo is trying her hand at a detective novel for the first time, but things aren’t going as she'd hoped. One day she receives a call from the mother of her ex-husband Tae-jae and sets out, beginning an unfamiliar journey. What follows is a series of encounters, some with people from Hye-joo's past and others arising from relationships in her present. These encounters may have little to do with her original purpose, taking her far off course. On a day she is supposed to meet her boyfriend, for instance, she never sees him and instead finds herself spending time with his son Yul-i and his friend Jong-i.

title: Blue
overview: Narrated by Marco Baliani, Blu takes viewers on a journey along Italy's coastlines and seabeds, blending mythology, history, and marine science. Through breathtaking imagery, the documentary contrasts the sea's timeless beauty with the urgent environmental threats it faces today, issuing a poignant call for ecological awareness and preservation.

title: 771 Days
overview: "Mom made it home alive from the street protest again today!" As soon as Zainab Entezar opens the door to her home and walks in, she is greeted by her young son and embraces him. She goes to the women’s street protests as though heading to work, and every time she leaves home, she fears she may never see her son again.

title: UFC Fight Night 291: Buckley vs. Malott
original_title: UFC Fight Night 291: Buckley vs. Malott

title: Wet Feathers
overview: After developing a phobia of pigeons, the eccentric Brett Trueman escapes to the underground town of Coober Pedy where he recounts experiences from his life.

title: Lesbian Lines
overview: In a silenced Ireland, a community of lesbians builds an underground network of helplines - offering connection, survival, and defiance through the simple act of answering the phone.

title: Hasut
overview: In the wake of their parents' tragic decease, a young woman orchestrates a remote wilderness expedition to rehabilitate her estranged sister, only for the group to be terrorized by manipulative supernatural entities exploiting their communication devices.

title: Disconnected
overview: Centers around the Walker family as they navigate personal loss and the consequences of online manipulation. Set against the backdrop of a school system heavily reliant on technology, the Walker’s and a group of courageous students challenge a corrupt administration as they fight to reclaim their community and their lives.

title: Purple Haze
overview: After a traumatic night, a passive boyfriend is pulled through the nostalgia of music into memories that force him to question whether he should confront the past or be the same in the future.

title: Khoriya
overview: Two Nepali half-brothers run a poultry farm on the outskirts of a city. The older brother wants to expand the farm, while the younger dreams of becoming a soldier and settling down with his girlfriend. When their livelihood is threatened by an outbreak of the avian flu, the older brother turns to the illegal trade of steroids by targeting military recruits, and drags his younger brother into the business. His girlfriend, who works in the beauty industry, decides to leave for Dubai in search of bigger opportunities.

title: Chasing Millions
overview: The Northern Bank chain was owned by the National Australia Bank. Diana, a young Australian police detective in Belfast at the same time, seizes the opportunity to investigate the biggest crime of her career and prove herself to her misogynistic bosses back home who have passed her over for promotion. Diana is teamed with Crawford, a gruff, veteran Northern Irish police detective who does not want her help. As the case takes one more bizarre turn after another, the duo learn to grudgingly respect each other. As they almost give up hope of catching the criminals, Diana comes up with an ingenious plan which will make the stolen millions worthless.

title: Le grand jeu de Jessica Chastain
original_title: Le grand jeu de Jessica Chastain

title: Unmasking the Tylenol Killer
overview: A detective inspired by an episode of "Unsolved Mysteries" takes on the unsolved case of a death by cyanide.

title: 7 Miles Out
overview: After her father's suicide in 1977, 11-year-old Ann struggles with grief, alcoholism, and promiscuity. Exploring her sexuality and self-destruction, she finds solace in art, overcomes family secrets, and achieves acclaim as a filmmaker.

title: AEW WrestleDream 2026
overview: The 2026 WrestleDream was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) and took place on October 17, 2026, at the Addition Financial Arena in Orlando, Florida, USA. Like the previous events, this was a tribute show in honor of New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) founder Antonio Inoki, who passed away on October 1, 2022.

title: Tell Everyone
overview: Amanda Aaltonen refuses to resign herself to the miserable fate of a poor woman and daringly seeks her happiness in the world. As punishment for breaking the rules, society deprives her of the most important thing of all, her freedom, and imprisons her on the island of Seili.

title: Nowruz - New day
overview: In Turin, a group of young Iranian women finds community and freedom through Homa, a women’s football team. As they train and compete in Balon Mundial 2025, they build new lives far from home. When war breaks out in Iran, their joy and sense of belonging are challenged by fear for their families and the pain of a wounded homeland.

title: Soundweave
overview: At the end of a lost village, a lost father, and lost memory, there is a sound that shall not disappear.

title: The Last Fellini
overview: Much has been told about Federico Fellini, but one chapter remains largely unexplored. It is the final decade of his life and artistic career. During the 1980s and 1990s, the film industry celebrated him while struggling to support his visions. The Maestro never stopped creating and fought to continue expressing himself. Sharing his dreams and extraordinary energy were exceptional companions: Roberto Benigni, Martin Scorsese, Nicola Piovani, Vincenzo Mollica, Milo Manara, and his inseparable secretary, Fiammetta Profili. Ultimo Fellini reveals the man behind the icon through three years of research, private archives, and previously unseen footage, beginning with the precious materials of Vincenzo Mollica.

title: The Beast in the Cave
overview: A young security guard enters a forbidden cave after hearing a cry for help, only to discover that something monstrous lurks within its darkness.

title: Dirt in Your Face
overview: In the summer of 1987, Estonia languishes under Soviet rule, stifling free expression. 17-year-old Mihkel, a rebellious musician, and his rival Hendrik learn of a Finnish talent scout visiting Estonia. To impress him, they must journey to a distant rock festival on the other side of the country. They assemble a group, including Mihkel's secret love Liisa. Amid rivalry and chaos, they navigate challenges, discovering their true selves along the way.

title: 144 – Apocalypse Not
overview: After a satirical tweet targeting Bolsonaro and the Universal Church, J.P. Cuenca became the target of 144 lawsuits and thousands of death threats from the evangelical far right. Seeking dialogue, he embarks on an 11,000-kilometer journey through packed churches, rodeos, German festivals, shooting clubs, home worship services, and gospel trucks across every region of Brazil. Amid ecological devastation, religious fervor, and an impending apocalypse, a Brazil in trance reaches an apotheosis of color, music, and faith.

title: Hilol
overview: At twenty-three, Hilol has been raised by her father like a son. Her mother died when she was born, and though she was once a Taekwondo champion, she now has little to do other than caring for her father at home. Her older sisters, each struggling with problems of their own, try to arrange marriage for Hilol. Then, she runs into her childhood friend Doniyor by chance, which stirs feelings she does not quite understand.

title: Clementine Orange
overview: Angelica has fallen in love with John, a prisoner whose letters and photos have sparked fantasies of a dangerous, forbidden love. When John is granted a 24-hour release and they finally meet for the first time, her illusion shatters - John has catfished her. Despite the betrayal, Angelica decides to give him a chance, if only for those fleeting 24 hours.

title: Kim Yun Shin Punches In
overview: Born in Wonsan in 1935, Kim is one of Korea's first-generation female sculptors. At 49, she gave up her professorship and left for Argentina, spending the next 40 years working in South America, following trees, stones, and raw gemstones. Then, at 90, she returned to Korea.

title: Yorushika LIVE: "Tousaku"
overview: A concept live performance by n-buna, combining recitation and musical performance, held from September to October 2025.  This video features footage from Yorushika's LIVE TOUR 2025 "Plagiarism Re-enactment".

title: Get Undressed
overview: After years without seeing each other, Tsumugi goes camping with her former track and field teammates. Their excitement at the reunion fades when a conflict they were never able to resolve resurfaces. What no one can imagine is that they're sleeping on the site of an ancient execution ground, where centuries ago villagers were crucified naked. At night, their spirits emerge to hunt down the campers. And then Tsumugi discovers the only way to survive: by undressing.

title: TJPW Fall Tour 2026 ~Ray of Hope~ in Yokohama
original_title: TJPW FALL TOUR 2026～Ray of Hope～in YOKOHAMA
overview: Fall Tour 2026 ~Ray of Hope~ in Yokohama was a professional wresting event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW), held on September 5, 2026 at Yokohama Radiant Hall in Yokohama, Kanagawa.

title: Millennial Run
overview: In the year 2078, the Free World has fallen to the Brotherhood, a new world order that forces teenagers to compete in The Tower Run. A gauntlet from which no one has survived. But one woman is special, different from the others...

title: Three Generations, One Christmas
overview: Set in a close-knit American town, Christmas at The Starlight centers on The Starlight, a beloved local supper club and longtime community gathering place where generations have come together to celebrate music, family, and Christmas traditions. Frank (Tony Danza)—a legendary song-and-dance man—prepares to sell the family’s beloved restaurant lounge after 40 years. With the future of The Starlight in question, three generations of family are drawn into an emotional journey that reminds them what is worth preserving — and how faith, family, and home can quietly lead us back to where we belong.

title: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
overview: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.

title: Operation Cronos
overview: Based on real events, chronicles the relentless pursuit of the terrorists responsible for the horrific Barcelona attacks. With a high-stakes countdown, the film dives into the race against time from the perspective of elite state security forces, as they work tirelessly to capture those behind the tragic events in Las Ramblas on August 17, 2017.

title: Hellboy
overview: In the final days of World War II, the Nazis attempt to use black magic to aid their dying cause. The Allies raid the camp where the ceremony is taking place, but not before they summon a baby demon who is rescued by Allied forces and dubbed "Hellboy". Sixty years later, Hellboy serves the cause of good rather than evil as an agent in the Bureau of Paranormal Research & Defense, along with Abe Sapien - a merman with psychic powers, and Liz Sherman - a woman with pyrokinesis, protecting America against dark forces.

title: Cbeebies Panto: Treasure Island
overview: A swashbuckling musical reimagining of Robert Louis Stevenson's classic pirate adventure. The story follows a young boy named Jim and his dad, Bertie, as they set off on a treasure hunt across the high seas. Along the way, they encounter sneaky pirates, a chatty seagull, and a very festive holiday surprise! The lively retelling is packed with original songs and laughs, celebrating the importance of family and listening to the ones you love most.

title: Chronovisor
overview: A French academic is seduced into a world of untold histories in her scholarly quest to uncover the mystery of a history-capturing camera-like machine created by clandestine Benedictine monks. An academic-noir, armchair mystery in the lineage of Jorge Luis Borges and Umberto Eco.

title: Lomu
overview: A Tongan/Kiwi warrior who could run 100 metres in under 11 seconds. He was the youngest All Black to put on the jersey and still holds the record for the most tries scored in World Cup history.

title: Same Sun - Mit dem Fahrrad durch Afrika
original_title: Same Sun - Mit dem Fahrrad durch Afrika
overview: The film SAME SUN tells the story of Wiebke Lühmann's journey from Freiburg to the Cape of Good Hope. Honest, raw, and close to the inner and outer challenges of a 430-day bicycle trip. Her journey takes her through 22 countries, Sahara storms, the rain season, the Congo Basin, and the deserts of Namibia.

title: Act 3
overview: The latest in Christine Molloy and Joe Lawlor’s series of cinematic essays is a rich and thought- provoking journey through aging, legacy and the intersection between artistic and personal relationships. Molloy and Lawlor engage in a witty and moving conversation that explores family history and their latest project, a film about groundbreaking artists Claude Cahun and Marcel Moore. As they analyse this decades-long relationship, they identify parallels between these two artists and their own lives. Act 3 celebrates the power of connection, of artistic exploration and the importance of memory to shape our present and future.

title: Letters This Christmas
overview: A young romance author leaves New York City after her novel is panned, hoping to write a redemption novel from home in Alaska. Finding inspiration in her former lover, and the mysterious Christmas cards left at her keys, newfound success has her making the difficult choice between returning to New York for a career of fictional romance, and her real romance in Alaska.

title: Gandhari
overview: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

title: I'm Game
overview: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down.

title: Tikus!
overview: A group of people are marooned at an isolated wellness retreat because of floods. One by one each of them gets killed as it's slowly revealed there is a murderer among them.

title: Rock Bottom
overview: Gungo is a scrawny, spoiled young caveman who has lived a life of luxury as the son of the tribal chief. In an age where only the strongest survive, he’d rather perform his “Tik-Rocks” dances than hunt or fight. But when he’s falsely accused and exiled after a plot to overthrow his father, Gungo is forced to prove himself in the brutal Caveman Games—an ancient competition where strength and bravery determine who leads. Banished to a dangerous and wild land, Gungo must now train with a group of misfits he once mocked. Together, they’ll face prehistoric perils, uncover the truth behind the conspiracy, and learn that real strength comes not from muscles, but from unity, acceptance, and the courage to lead with heart.

title: Pepita the Gunslinger
overview: Mar del Plata, 1985. Pregnant and working as a sex worker, Margarita Di Tullio defies the mafia and a corrupt power structure to build a clandestine empire that shields women from the horrors of the streets, becoming a legend forged by a shotgun and maternal loyalty… the legend of Pepita, the Gunslinger.

title: Paper Plane
overview: When a defiant young girl stages a silent protest, refusing to return home until the disruptive presence of her father is gone, her mother must decide whether to follow her or let her go.

title: Durmiendo con lobos
overview: For five years, a father and daughter cross the mountains, forests and coasts of Spain and Portugal looking for wolves in the wild. As she learns to follow their tracks and watch them unseen, the search becomes a delicate encounter with a species under threat—and with everything they still have to discover.

title: No Rest for the Wicked
overview: 1862. Baldur lives a fisherman’s life on the isolated Faroe Islands far to the north in the Atlantic Ocean. His world is turned upside down when a stranger arrives: Helge, a rugged whaler, who awakens deep emotions within him. A mutual attraction starts to grow. When tragedy strikes, their forbidden passion unleashes natural forces so disturbing that the villagers rally to keep evil at bay. But Baldur and Helge refuse to let their love be buried. They will fight till the end – and after.

title: Aash khanoom Jan
overview: It centers on the children of a traditional family who decide to travel to Tehran to visit their elderly parents after the pandemic ends. Arriving from various locations, they gather just as the family matriarch—affectionately known as "Khanom-Jan"—is preparing her annual *ash-e nazri* (a traditional ceremonial soup), leading to a series of bittersweet events.

title: Slumber
overview: The story is about Mojtaba, an archive employee who is stuck in the boring routine of life. He suffers from sleep disorders and in his dreams meets a woman who changes his life.

title: Fallen Angels
overview: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.

title: Nowhere to Lay My Eyes
overview: With her brother, Sanghee visits her mother on Jeju Island. It’s been 10 years. Her mother's restaurant has become a hit. Her stepfather is making a film about a "grass tomb". His daughter has just started painting. Previously unknown facts, needless advice and cheap compliments are passed back and forth. On the morning of her departure, the other family members watch one of Sanghee's films.

title: The List of Unpredictable Things
overview: An absurd nightmare experienced by a young artist whose anxieties stem from worrying about unpredictable disasters.

title: The Windy Day
overview: A single kite string ties four kids together through childhood, friendship, and loss. As their bond begins to unravel, they are forced to confront what it means to grow apart and leave the past behind.

title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
overview: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

title: Descent
overview: Iranian Independent film.

title: ¿Me entiendes o te lo explico?
overview: Madrid, Spring 1992. Pepe, owner of a Catalan tavern in Chueca, faces the worst streak of his life: his bar is in ruin, his wife leaves him and the debts drown him. When he thinks all is lost, his friends propose a twist as unexpected as brilliant: turn the tavern into a gay pub! What happens from there is an unstoppable succession of entanglements, crazy situations and endearing characters, in a politically incorrect comedy, current, and absolutely smarty.

title: Winter Lions
overview: Opening with a tragic crime, whose perpetrator attempts to hide his tracks, including his relationship to people in power and organized crime. The father of the victim – his daughter – who thought he had left behind a life marked by violence, decides to seek justice on his own, crossing red lines from which there is no return. If there is anything more dangerous than a father defending his children, is a father who no longer has any children to defend.

title: Oscillations
overview: Oscillations is an experimental animated short constructed from a filmed live oscilloscope performance combining synthesized sampling, live guitar and analog signal imagery. Continuing the tradition of visual music explored by pioneers such as Oskar Fischinger, the work transforms sound into shifting geometric forms and rhythmic electronic landscapes. Utilizing William S. Burroughs’ cut-up method, fragments of text derived from the “Pale Blue Dot” passage in Cosmos are recombined into evolving poetic structures. Through repetition, fragmentation and oscillation, the piece gradually shifts from cosmic reflection toward an inquiry into memory, place and the unstable idea of home.

title: Lucrum
overview: Summoned to the secluded estate of a celebrated pianist, young adoptee June discovers a world of beauty and artistic brilliance sustained by a terrifying covenant. A haunting work of folk horror where refinement masks something far more insatiable.

title: Sheriff Labrador: Save the Mango Festival
original_title: 啦咘啦哆警长之巡逻行动：保卫芒果节启动，全速出发
overview: Sheriff Labrador and his team save the Mango Festival in Mango Village by solving a series of chaotic sabotage incidents and emergencies.

title: Lapland War
overview: Young soldier Heikki fights on the Karelian Isthmus alongside his friend Pauli. Arvo, recently released from prison, joins the company, challenging the others' views on war and duty with his worldview. The ceasefire raises hopes of returning home, but it soon becomes clear that Finland must turn against its former German allies in Lapland. At the same time, Saara, who works as a German interpreter in Rovaniemi, must choose her future: stay in Finland or flee to Germany with her beloved, Major Duisberg.

title: Keepers of Memory: Nature in the Age of Fire
original_title: Custodi della memoria. La Natura al tempo del Fuoco
overview: Focusing on the catastrophic wildfires in British Columbia, this documentary blends Indigenous wisdom, ambient nature soundscapes, and personal testimonies—including survivors of the 2021 Lytton disaster. The film highlights the deep spiritual connection between humanity and nature, calling for environmental stewardship while exposing the ongoing grief of Indigenous communities stripped of their ancestral lands.

title: The Modigliani Affair
overview: Livorno, summer 1984. Three sculpted heads emerge from the water. The art world hails them as authentic works by Modigliani. The only problem is: they are fakes. This is the incredible story of a hoax that spiraled out of control. The story of a fraud. The story of a death under circumstances that were never fully explained. One of the greatest art scandals of all time. One of the most intricate mysteries in the history of art—and, at the same time, a crystal-clear example of how a beautiful lie can always overpower, and be preferred to, any reality.

title: Dead Man Walking
overview: An agent of a nameless corporation embarks on a journey across the Midwest filled with reflection, danger, and echoes of his past to deliver legal documents to a mysterious purchaser. The catch? These seemingly mundane documents just may hold cosmic implications.

title: What Can't Be Mentioned
overview: 14 years after Dan Sallitt’s The Unspeakable Act (2012), we catch up with Jackie, now a married therapist-in-training who attempts to resolve issues of sexual dysfunction with her husband before deciding to visit her brother and newly pregnant sister-in-law.

title: Die andere Seite
overview: Since losing her family, a woman is living alone in the wilderness — far away from society, which is dominated by mistrust and fear after the outbreak of a fatal disease. When she is forced to leave this life behind, she not only experiences a boundless freedom, but also remembers the importance of human closeness and the feeling of belonging.

title: EXP. MASC. AD
overview: An archival short film built from videos recorded in 2011 on a Nokia 5230 during the filmmaker’s high school years, when filming was simply an act of capturing without a defined purpose. Fifteen years later, those images are reinterpreted through editing on a Samsung A26. Through playful and violent fragments, the film explores the adolescent heterosexual masculine experience, while reflecting on the evolution of the mobile phone as a tool that first democratized audiovisual recording and, by 2026, also made editing more accessible.

title: Subscriber
overview: An obnoxious real estate YouTuber takes his crew to a dilapidated farmhouse in Ohio, one of his recent purchases. Once they enter the remote house, they learn there is an entity not of this earth that refuses to let them leave…

title: Miss Representation: Rise Up
overview: MISS REPRESENTATION: RISING dives deep into the cultural backlash against women’s mental health, agency, and political power with technology exacerbating sexism and misogyny towards women and girls.

title: Show me From Behind the Wall
original_title: Show me From Behind the Wall
overview: After several years of distance, Mary Jane agrees to reunite with a group of former friends for a trip meant to offer reconnection and rest. However, the reunion quickly becomes uncomfortable. Old wounds, unresolved conflicts, and buried secrets begin to surface, turning the experience into an increasingly tense and claustrophobic one. Isolated in a house far from the city, the women are forced to confront the past and face the emotional consequences of deep trauma. The film offers a disturbing portrait of the psychological deterioration of a woman pushed to her limits, where sanity dissolves and nothing is exactly as it seems.

title: Nizhalilirundhu Velicham
overview: When life's rejections push a man to his breaking point, an unwavering bond pulls him back into the light.

title: A Statement
overview: At a beachside resort in Florida in 1980, twenty experts gather for a weekend conference on a global issue that is starting to gain traction: the effects of Co2 emissions on the climate. The group of scientists, activists, and policymakers have one simple mandate from Congress — write a statement about what to do. Easier said than done.

title: Doña Ninfa
overview: Jesús, a local young man, turns to Doña Ninfa to undergo a spiritual cleansing. Doña Ninfa is a fraudulent healer who performs rituals in a town that is itself alive a place that metes out justice against those who seek to profit through deception. During the ritual, the scene is terrorized by a light resembling a living entity that attempts to force its way into the house.

title: Gods Girls
overview: During the autumn break, a student named Emma joins her classmate Lauren to visit Lauren’s grandparents in the countryside, where the two form a close friendship away from their strict boarding school.

title: Going for Two
overview: In the fall of 1983, as their beloved college football team vies for the National Championship, a fatherless 12-year-old boy and his tomboy neighbor embark on a quest for his 'manhood'.

title: Udta Teer
overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

title: The Last Treatment
overview: The Last Treatment follows a renowned doctor trapped in a deadly night of crime, fear and impossible choices. As danger closes in, he is forced to fight for survival while facing revenge, sacrifice and painful decisions. Packed with action, suspense and emotional moments, the story explores a father's unstoppable love and the lengths he will go to protect those he cares for.

title: Little Thomas
overview: In early 1990s Goa, seven year old Thomas and his family navigate thr ups and downs in their lives.

title: Forever, This Ring
overview: Maveric Collins, a successful entrepreneur and playboy, has promised to never get married — until he meets the woman of his dreams and changes his mind. But when they get married, he finds out she’s actually not who he thought she was. “Will the woman he once loved go away calmly, or will this end in a deadly divorce?”

title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
original_title: Le Journal d'une femme de chambre
overview: A young Romanian woman living in France works for a French family and joins a theatre company who are adapting Octave Mirbeau's The Diary of a Chambermaid.

title: The Murder of Benjamin
overview: On a cold night in Holmlia, 15-year-old Benjamin is murdered by 19-year-old Joe Erling Jahr in a racially motivated assault. A year later, Benjamin's mother, Marit, faces her son’s killer in court.

title: Fruit & Nut
overview: The untold story of the most famous duo of all time.

title: When you leave, it will be night
overview: Nicolò joins a rehab facility to support his uncle Matteo during his final month there. As they navigate the community's daily routines and their own complex relationship, an unaddressed past guilt resurfaces, forcing them to confront deep family trauma and blurring the line between who is saving whom.

title: Nine Times Fired
overview: The film portrays the journey of Jeong Gyu-ji, who has faced nine layoffs from different jobs, and her growth throughout the experience.

title: A Doctor to Die For: The Sarah Harris Story
original_title: A Doctor to Die For: The Sarah Harris Story
overview: Sarah is drawn into a dangerous relationship with a middle-aged surgeon Dr. James Ryan. As Dr. Ryan secretly supplies her with surgical-grade drugs to keep her compliant and submissive, Sarah's life spirals out of control.

title: The Windy Day
overview: A single kite string ties four kids together through childhood, friendship, and loss. As their bond begins to unravel, they are forced to confront what it means to grow apart and leave the past behind.

The ceasefire raises hopes of returning home, but it soon becomes clear that Finland must turn against its former German allies in Lapland. At the same time, Saara, who works as a German interpreter in Rovaniemi, must choose her future: stay in Finland or flee to Germany with her beloved, Major Duisberg.

title: Keepers of Memory: Nature in the Age of Fire
original_title: Custodi della memoria. La Natura al tempo del Fuoco
overview: Focusing on the catastrophic wildfires in British Columbia, this documentary blends Indigenous wisdom, ambient nature soundscapes, and personal testimonies—including survivors of the 2021 Lytton disaster. The film highlights the deep spiritual connection between humanity and nature, calling for environmental stewardship while exposing the ongoing grief of Indigenous communities stripped of their ancestral lands.

title: The Modigliani Affair
overview: Livorno, summer 1984. Three sculpted heads emerge from the water. The art world hails them as authentic works by Modigliani. The only problem is: they are fakes. This is the incredible story of a hoax that spiraled out of control. The story of a fraud. The story of a death under circumstances that were never fully explained. One of the greatest art scandals of all time. One of the most intricate mysteries in the history of art—and, at the same time, a crystal-clear example of how a beautiful lie can always overpower, and be preferred to, any reality.

title: Dead Man Walking
overview: An agent of a nameless corporation embarks on a journey across the Midwest filled with reflection, danger, and echoes of his past to deliver legal documents to a mysterious purchaser. The catch? These seemingly mundane documents just may hold cosmic implications.

title: What Can't Be Mentioned
overview: 14 years after Dan Sallitt’s The Unspeakable Act (2012), we catch up with Jackie, now a married therapist-in-training who attempts to resolve issues of sexual dysfunction with her husband before deciding to visit her brother and newly pregnant sister-in-law.

title: Die andere Seite
overview: Since losing her family, a woman is living alone in the wilderness — far away from society, which is dominated by mistrust and fear after the outbreak of a fatal disease. When she is forced to leave this life behind, she not only experiences a boundless freedom, but also remembers the importance of human closeness and the feeling of belonging.

title: EXP. MASC. AD
overview: An archival short film built from videos recorded in 2011 on a Nokia 5230 during the filmmaker’s high school years, when filming was simply an act of capturing without a defined purpose. Fifteen years later, those images are reinterpreted through editing on a Samsung A26. Through playful and violent fragments, the film explores the adolescent heterosexual masculine experience, while reflecting on the evolution of the mobile phone as a tool that first democratized audiovisual recording and, by 2026, also made editing more accessible.

title: Subscriber
overview: An obnoxious real estate YouTuber takes his crew to a dilapidated farmhouse in Ohio, one of his recent purchases. Once they enter the remote house, they learn there is an entity not of this earth that refuses to let them leave…

title: Miss Representation: Rise Up
overview: MISS REPRESENTATION: RISING dives deep into the cultural backlash against women’s mental health, agency, and political power with technology exacerbating sexism and misogyny towards women and girls.

title: Show me From Behind the Wall
original_title: Show me From Behind the Wall
overview: After several years of distance, Mary Jane agrees to reunite with a group of former friends for a trip meant to offer reconnection and rest. However, the reunion quickly becomes uncomfortable. Old wounds, unresolved conflicts, and buried secrets begin to surface, turning the experience into an increasingly tense and claustrophobic one. Isolated in a house far from the city, the women are forced to confront the past and face the emotional consequences of deep trauma. The film offers a disturbing portrait of the psychological deterioration of a woman pushed to her limits, where sanity dissolves and nothing is exactly as it seems.

title: Nizhalilirundhu Velicham
overview: When life's rejections push a man to his breaking point, an unwavering bond pulls him back into the light.

title: A Statement
overview: At a beachside resort in Florida in 1980, twenty experts gather for a weekend conference on a global issue that is starting to gain traction: the effects of Co2 emissions on the climate. The group of scientists, activists, and policymakers have one simple mandate from Congress — write a statement about what to do. Easier said than done.

title: Doña Ninfa
overview: Jesús, a local young man, turns to Doña Ninfa to undergo a spiritual cleansing. Doña Ninfa is a fraudulent healer who performs rituals in a town that is itself alive a place that metes out justice against those who seek to profit through deception. During the ritual, the scene is terrorized by a light resembling a living entity that attempts to force its way into the house.

title: Gods Girls
overview: During the autumn break, a student named Emma joins her classmate Lauren to visit Lauren’s grandparents in the countryside, where the two form a close friendship away from their strict boarding school.

title: Going for Two
overview: In the fall of 1983, as their beloved college football team vies for the National Championship, a fatherless 12-year-old boy and his tomboy neighbor embark on a quest for his 'manhood'.

title: Udta Teer
overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

title: The Last Treatment
overview: The Last Treatment follows a renowned doctor trapped in a deadly night of crime, fear and impossible choices. As danger closes in, he is forced to fight for survival while facing revenge, sacrifice and painful decisions. Packed with action, suspense and emotional moments, the story explores a father's unstoppable love and the lengths he will go to protect those he cares for.

title: Little Thomas
overview: In early 1990s Goa, seven year old Thomas and his family navigate thr ups and downs in their lives.

title: Forever, This Ring
overview: Maveric Collins, a successful entrepreneur and playboy, has promised to never get married — until he meets the woman of his dreams and changes his mind. But when they get married, he finds out she’s actually not who he thought she was. “Will the woman he once loved go away calmly, or will this end in a deadly divorce?”

title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
original_title: Le Journal d'une femme de chambre
overview: A young Romanian woman living in France works for a French family and joins a theatre company who are adapting Octave Mirbeau's The Diary of a Chambermaid.

title: The Murder of Benjamin
overview: On a cold night in Holmlia, 15-year-old Benjamin is murdered by 19-year-old Joe Erling Jahr in a racially motivated assault. A year later, Benjamin's mother, Marit, faces her son’s killer in court.

title: Fruit & Nut
overview: The untold story of the most famous duo of all time.

title: When you leave, it will be night
overview: Nicolò joins a rehab facility to support his uncle Matteo during his final month there. As they navigate the community's daily routines and their own complex relationship, an unaddressed past guilt resurfaces, forcing them to confront deep family trauma and blurring the line between who is saving whom.

title: Nine Times Fired
overview: The film portrays the journey of Jeong Gyu-ji, who has faced nine layoffs from different jobs, and her growth throughout the experience.

title: A Doctor to Die For: The Sarah Harris Story
original_title: A Doctor to Die For: The Sarah Harris Story
overview: Sarah is drawn into a dangerous relationship with a middle-aged surgeon Dr. James Ryan. As Dr. Ryan secretly supplies her with surgical-grade drugs to keep her compliant and submissive, Sarah's life spirals out of control.

title: Winter Wonderlanes
overview: Audrey Bell  is a globe-trotting pop-up restaurateur who returns home for Thanksgiving to the news that her late grandfather’s beloved bowling alley, Wonderlanes, will be sold. Audrey agrees to stay for one last festive season at Wonderlanes and decides to revive its iconic Winter Wonderlanes youth bowling tournament. To drum up publicity for the event, she reluctantly teams up with Jason Miller, a local news reporter and her high school boyfriend. Working side by side the embers of their past start flickering, rekindling feelings they thought they left behind. As the tournament draws near, Audrey questions her next move that will take her away from the people and places she loves…and decide if she’s ready to walk away from Wonderlanes – or finally put down roots where her heart truly belongs.

title: A Christmas Prayer Tradition
overview: Natalie prepares for the launch of her debut children’s book, Adeline the Angel, while Wes continues to deepen his faith journey. When Caroline quietly begins a mission to answer the prayers and needs of those around her community, the family discovers that some of God’s greatest works are accomplished through simple acts of kindness. As Christmas approaches, Bellford Falls once again becomes a place where hope is restored, prayers are answered, and hearts are drawn closer to the reason for the season.

title: Superthings: La película
overview: When everyday objects suddenly come to life as superheroes and villains, an ordinary world is transformed into the extraordinary universe of SuperThings! Inspired by the internationally acclaimed Spanish toy brand.

title: Bird in Hand
overview: A bride-to-be with a secret agenda returns to her hometown, using her wedding plans to manipulate everyone in her orbit.

title: Sigma
overview: A daring treasure hunter throws caution to the wind, outwitting deadly traps and treacherous allies with sheer nerve and cunning.

title: Sally
overview: Shortly before her first major stage performance, Sally realizes just how ruthless the music industry can be. She comes under increasing pressure, caught between her manager's expectations and the strains of her personal life.

title: Growth of the Soil
overview: It is late autumn. Isak fights to survive in the wilderness. One day, Inger appears over the mountain. Out of a meeting in need, love grows. In merciless nature, Isak and Inger fight to create a life together. With love as their driving force, they build the farm Sellanraa from nothing. When a dark secret comes to the surface, love is put to the test.

title: Red Crown
overview: Twenty-five contestants compete for a P25 million cash prize at the 25th-anniversary "Queen of the Islands" pageant.

title: Etched In Pavement
overview: In a remote corner of Detroit, where the streets echo with both hardship and hope, two young men turn fighting into a language of survival, purpose and community.  Filmed over four years, Etched In Pavement follows Dwane Taylor and Michael Futrell whose weaving paths move through youth combat sports, professional boxing and their grassroots Guns Down, Gloves Up street-fighting movement. As they navigate fatherhood, loss, and those who came before, the film becomes an intimate portrait of generations caught between violence and purpose, survival and legacy.

title: My Duchess
overview: Telling the story of the final years of the woman who married King Edward VIII and broke up the monarchy.

title: God Laughs
overview: In the heart of the 17th century, Friar Leopoldo da Casamacchia recounts the Gospel with a joy and freedom never seen before. While the Church speaks in Latin, he speaks to the people of a God who is close to them, capable of bringing comfort, hope, and even of laughing alongside them. His voice spreads from village to village, winning over thousands of people and emptying the churches. The echo of his message reaches as far as Rome, where the Pope entrusts the case to Cardinal Maculani, the most influential inquisitor of the time. What begins as a trial turns into an unexpected confrontation, capable of shaking seemingly unshakable convictions. While Leopoldo’s fate seems sealed, doubt begins to change even those who judge him. Because you can silence a voice, but not what that voice has left behind in others.

title: The Evil Inside
overview: Once a showbiz icon in Taiwan, Ho Jen-jen—better known as Golden Phoenix—vanished after reckless gambling left her drowning in debt. She abandoned her young daughter, severing all ties. Years later, she collapses and wakes up in a sinister nursing home. Beneath the facility’s eerie calm lurks "Death Bet,” a twisted game where terminal patients' lifespans are gambled away. Desperate to escape and find her daughter, she soon realizes the true horror has yet to unfold, and the most harrowing secret is still waiting to be revealed.

title: We Are Born Good
overview: A dining mishap caused a rift between Ji and Rui, leading to a cycle of revenge. Their already troubled lives only came together to fall apart.

title: The Awakening
overview: An elite military unit ventures into the South American tropical jungle on a mission to eliminate an enemy target. What begins as a tactical operation quickly turns into a nightmare when they encounter supernatural forces emerging from the depths of the jungle. Five hundred years earlier, a Spanish conquistador expedition was consumed by the same relentless force. Separated by centuries but connected by the same hostile territory, both incursions discover something hidden in the jungle: an ancient presence that cannot be controlled.

title: Despicable Me
overview: Determined to prove he's the world's greatest supervillain, Gru hatches an audacious plan to steal the Moon. To pull it off, he adopts three orphaned girls—Margo, Edith, and Agnes—intending to use them as pawns in his scheme. But the unexpected bond they form forces him to question the criminal life he's always known.

title: Heil Jupiter!
overview: Amidst crashing waves and monumental rocks on a distant coast, two young couples open up a realm of shifting realities. Unbeknownst to them, a mysterious entity watches from high above with Godlike judgment. Between these spaces exists a world balanced on the edge of the modern and the primitive, the high-tech and the rural, the corporeal and the mythic.

title: Medley
overview: Lola (16) is a lonely girl marked by a trauma that has followed her since childhood: the mysterious absence of her father. A talented swimmer with a vast collection of medals, Lola keeps a curious secret, she cannot swim the butterfly stroke. She has a strained relationship with her mother, and after one of their arguments she decides to spend her vacation alone in her uncle's town. There, the teenager's life changes radically she falls in love with Gabriel, makes new friends, and joins the town's struggling swim team. Now, every time Lola is in the water, these new emotions stir memories from her past. On the eve of an important championship, Lola finds herself facing fears and traumas she never expected, including the truth about her father's death.

title: The Sea Speaks His Name
overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia’s New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

title: Frau ohne Namen
overview: A psychologist specializing in microexpression, Dr. Marlene Nielsen is called in to assist on an apparently obvious case of self-defence. She is asked to help establish the identity of a woman who fatally wounded an attacker, but who steadfastly refuses to speak. But in the face of the »woman without a name« Marlene sees evidence of an intentional act. When no-one takes her seriously, she begins to investigate on her own and comes across an unpunished crime from the past.

title: Beat Luke Littler
overview: Amateur darts players hope to make history against world champion Luke Littler in a live match hosted by Gary Lineker, with analysis from Richard Osman.

title: Das Geheimnis der gestohlenen Maske
overview: Does the mask of the Makonde really have magic powers and can it settle the terrible quarrel between Johanna and her best friend? Johanna desperately needs the mask, but before her eyes it is stolen from Leipzig's Grassi Museum and Grandpa Kito is considered the prime suspect! Kito has just appeared from Tanzania and wants the mask, brutally stolen in colonial times, to return to his village. For Johanna, there is more at stake than unmasking the real thief - she must find her own identity.

title: Phoenix Fury
overview: When Ewura-Ama, recently widowed, inherits Utopia Valley, a luxury resort tucked in the quiet hills of Ghana, her search for solitude is disrupted by the arrival of a high-profile guest. Their uneasy encounter stirs tensions that awaken secrets buried decades ago.

title: Brother Save Us
overview: A 12-year-old boy in the Midwest befriends an AI farmworker, creating tension with his brother while their father battles illness.

title: Biermann
overview: Portrait of the German-German singer-songwriter and intellectual Wolf Biermann, whose famous Cologne concert in 1976 made German history.

title: (im)perfect strangers
overview: A group of longtime friends gathers around the dinner table, unaware that this evening will change their relationships forever.

title: DOUEN
overview: Sania, a first-generation Trinidadian American, is haunted by mischievous Douens and must confront the dark secrets and generational trauma buried within her family before the past claims her future.

title: Good Trip
overview: Shan, an art assistant, juggles responsibilities on the film set and at the hospital, where she cares for her father, Kueng, who has cancer. During her time at the hospital, Shan is tasked by the crew to collect a big bowl from the prop-studio. At her father's request, they discreetly leave the hospital together, embarking on an unexpected journey from the studio to Macau, and subsequently to Okinawa, allowing Kueng to address his unfulfilled wishes. Following his peaceful passing, Shan inherits not only memories but also a lasting sense of courage, optimism, and imaginative spirit that sustains her throughout life.

title: Box 3
overview: A young man arrives unconscious at a hospital with a “Do Not Resuscitate” tattoo. With no documents and no time, a medical team must decide whether to save his life—or respect his will.

title: Mother, What Would I Do Without You?
overview: Confronted with the devastating reality of her mother’s terminal diagnosis, a young woman embarks on a compressed emotional journey to fulfill her mother's final, unexpressed desires before her imminent decease, forcing a profound reckoning with grief and filial duty.

title: Deep in the Heart II: Texas Rivers
original_title: Deep in the Heart II: Texas Rivers
overview: Water, wildlife, and land conservation in Texas. Wildlife stories from each of Texas' major river basins, as well as diving into our state's successes and failures when it comes to managing water for both people as well as ecosystems.

title: Aso, Aso, Cuidado con el Payaso
original_title: Aso, Aso, Cuidado con el Payaso

title: My Neighbor Totoro
overview: Two sisters move to the country with their father in order to be closer to their hospitalized mother, and discover the surrounding trees are inhabited by Totoros, magical spirits of the forest. When the youngest runs away from home, the older sister seeks help from the spirits to find her.

title: Aaram
overview: An honest police officer finds himself ensnared in a web of guilt, fear, and moral conflict as institutional pressure and personal integrity collide.

title: Chopin
overview: “Chopin” tells the story of Chopin Wu (played by Liu), who returns home to small-town America where he grew up to amend an estranged relationship with his workaholic father (Dai). With a sudden appearance from his ailing grandmother (Chen), he is confronted by a past he had left behind. In the midst of a health crisis and a broken family, Wu is forced to re-examine old relationships, embrace a heritage he once denied and discover the importance of family and identity.

title: Virtuous Women
overview: A VIP retreat for women seeking their best selves turns into an absurd and dangerous journey.

title: The Whistler
overview: Reeling from their daughter's loss, Nicole and Sebastian come into possession of a secluded Venezuelan farm, unaware of the dark forces they're about to face.

title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

title: Matchmaking 3
overview: Baruch Auerbach, an unlucky-in-love Orthodox matchmaker from Bnei Brak, is finally engaged to struggling pastry chef Ruth but their financial woes make the loved-up pair’s dream wedding impossible.  When American Jewish Orthodox millionaire Michael Gerstel offers a $100,000 to anyone capable of finding a suitable match for his only daughter, Baruch is left with no option but to reunite with his mentor/adversary, Malki, for the matchmaking mission of-a-lifetime.

title: Nuisance Bear
overview: A polar bear is forced to navigate a human world of tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as its ancient migration collides with modern life. When a sacred predator is branded a nuisance, it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.

title: Toba, le volcan qui a failli tuer l'humanité
original_title: Toba, le volcan qui a failli tuer l'humanité

title: Tazza: The Song of Beelzebub
overview: Jang Taeyoung, who believes he has everything after building a successful online casino business, loses it all to his former best friend and namesake, Park Taeyoung. The two reunite on the international poker circuit for a high-stakes battle of revenge.

title: Barbie in the Nutcracker
overview: This 45-minute reimagining brings modern animation and fresh storytelling to the classic tale. In this new adventure, Barbie “Brooklyn” Roberts steps into the role of the Sugarplum Princess and Barbie “Malibu” Roberts stars as Clara, as they journey through a musical, magical dreamworld filled with holiday wonder, courage and friendship.

title: Animol
overview: Behind the walls of a young offender institution, Troy is thrust into a brutal world of gangs, loyalty and violence from the moment he arrives. When an unspoken bond develops with a fellow inmate, it becomes a dangerous vulnerability for them.

title: Ballroom
overview: A devastating accident forces aspiring dancer Violet to relearn life in a wheelchair. Through dance and an unexpected bond, she discovers that dreams don't disappear - they transform.

title: It At Night
overview: After hiding from a man that won't let her go, Jill escapes one threat only to come across another

title: Collision Course
overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

title: Still Water
overview: A girl cannot escape the unease she feels in the swimming pool, until a duck suddenly appears. It seems not to care about anything at all.

title: The In-between
overview: Spirit medium Shih Han traverses the Bardo to guide a wandering soul, discovering a chilling truth: the elder ordered his son Wei to freeze his corpse for pension money, trapping his spirit in a cycle of ascending and descending. In helping the spirit break free from this sacrificial attachment, Shih Han also finds the path to heal his own unresolved past.

title: Lulu Got a New Roommate
overview: A ladybug Ronnie accidentally got stuck in a spider Lulu's web while building its nest. What can it do to escape? This is a story about friendship and Chinese puns about insects.

title: I'M OKAY
overview: Beginning with a conversation with a man. Those conversations may have truly happened, or they may exist only within his own mind. In an attempt to hold on to something, he steals objects from his ex-boyfriend—things that seem useless, insignificant, and easily forgotten. As reality and imagination gradually blur together, he finally comes to understand where a relationship ultimately ends.

title: The Sleepwalker
overview: A college student, Niu Lang, turns his camera toward his roommate, Zhu Xing, who has a habit of sleepwalking, for a class project. In an attempt to capture his roommate's nocturnal behavior on film, he pursues what he believes to be a "true documentary." But one late night, an accident occurs.

title: Butterfly Stroke
overview: Ruth is an eccentric, determined woman who wants control over everything. Even death. So, she goes to Zurich for a tidy, orderly exit. But her chaotic granddaughter Lori gatecrashes, and will not go back home without her. They have an unexpected holiday together.

title: The Lost Children of Tuam
overview: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

title: O'Slaughter Day
overview: The day before Christmas, the Veterinary Board receives a positive A test result from a wild boar shot by a hunter. The young veterinary officer has a disposal machine ready and starts touring the farms in his former home village. The very first farm in Kiuma village is home to the elderly and childless Ants and Minna. For the couple, their domestic animals are a substitute for their missing children and loved ones. At the same time, Ants' nephews arrive with their wives and children. The goal is to quickly deliver the gifts and drive back home to the city. But the farmer Ants announces the situation he is in with his animals, and now he needs the help of his relatives to slaughter the pigs.

title: Las hijas del mar
overview: On opposite sides of the world, communities separated by thousands of kilometres share the same way of living with the sea. From the legendary women divers of Jeju island, the haenyeo, to professions such as net-making or the rowing of boats by women on the Basque coast, the documentary builds a sociocultural bridge between territories which may seem different, but which are in fact deeply connected by common values, pace of life and their relationship with the natural environment.
