original_title: เธอในภาพนั้น
overview: Inspired by the love story of King Bhumibol Adulyadej and Queen Sirikit, the movie follows a young photographer and a textile museum curator who connect through a mysterious vintage photograph.

title: Royal Puppies for Christmas
overview: When dog trainer Grace Walker is called to a European palace to tame mischievous royal corgis, she clashes with Prince William — but puppy chaos and Christmas magic lead to unexpected romance.

title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
overview: The Grinch decides to rob Whoville of Christmas - but a dash of kindness from little Cindy Lou Who and her family may be enough to melt his heart...

title: Sex Drive
overview: Sheltered Sasha joins her uninhibited best friend Kelly on a getaway, but rescuing an amnesiac man turns their sexy escape into a deadly game of truth and deception.

title: Алмаз «Сердце Персии»
overview: The Cyrus the Great Diamond is stolen from an excavation site in Iran and falls into the hands of a Russian boy vacationing at the seaside with his family.

title: Hive
overview: A strict, anxious teenager loses the child she’s babysitting and must brave a sinister force hiding in plain sight among the children in the playground. As her world unravels and her grip on reality starts to slip, she must outwit a world where nothing is as it seems to make it out alive.

title: The King of Cannabis
overview: Inspired by true events, this crime drama follows the rise of Terrence "Tee" Jackson as he builds a drug empire.

title: The Most Wonderful Secret
overview: Every Christmas, a small town honors the memory of a beloved teacher — who once spread joy through her "Secret Norma" gifts — by creating a whimsical and heartfelt scavenger hunt for one worthy recipient. When burned-out art teacher Vanessa visits her widowed brother and niece Esther for the holidays, she is surprised to be chosen as the next "Secret Norma" recipient. Hoping to bring Esther some Christmas magic, Vanessa decides to help revive the town's holiday block party. Her handsome electrician neighbor Spencer offers help with the preparations if Vanessa will help him sell his mother Norma's house. As Vanessa solves the riddles of "Secret Norma" and plans the block party, her passion for teaching art begins to spark along with her feelings for the charming electrician next door.

title: Barreda
overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

title: Midnight Incense
original_title: ธูป เที่ยงคืน วิญญาณ
overview: A company promises free accommodation. But nothing in this world comes without a price. Because this house collects its rent - in souls.

title: Poltergeist
overview: The Freelings' suburban home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a portal to the 'other side'. With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

title: Nervous
overview: A woman spirals into a seductive nightmare beyond her control as she navigates a troubled marriage and disorientating cultural terrain in the Korean countryside.

overview: When a forbidden Indonesian exorcism is broadcast live online, it unleashes a legendary demonic entity across Asia, forcing the grieving son of a Taiwanese victim to trace the curse back to its ancient, blood-soaked roots in rural Indonesia before it consumes everyone in its digital wake.

title: God Is Shy
overview: During a train ride, Ariel and Paul pass the time sketching their deepest fears. Their game takes an unexpected turn when Gilda, a mysterious passenger, intrudes on their exchange. Yet, her relationship with fear seems far less innocent than their playful drawings.

title: April X
overview: When his twin sister April (Lilly Krug) goes missing, Bax (Connor Storrie) searches every corner of their futuristic, post-Soviet cityscape to find her. Ultimately descending into a violent criminal underworld and madness, Bax is forced to confront the cost of identity, love, and survival.

title: Filipiñana
overview: While working at an elite country club outside Manila, a 17-year-old Ilocana worker uncovers the violent truths of her workplace, her country, and her own past after attempting to return a lost golf club to the club's president.

title: Dracula
overview: Experience on stage the story of Jonathan Harker, a young solicitor sent to finalize a deal with a reclusive earl. As he ventures deeper into the mysterious count’s world, terrifying secrets begin to unfold…

title: Miles to Christmas
overview: When an early snowstorm sweeps through the Midwest, punctual, straight-laced "suit" Cassidy Fields is forced to hitch a ride with free spirited, music loving Johanna "Jo" Woods in her bother Chase's 18-wheeler to the nearest airport to catch another flight. However, when Jo's flight successfully takes off and Cassidy's is cancelled again at the last minute, she joins Chase on the road back to Tennessee from Chicago to make it home in time to spend Christmas with her father. Quickly, Cassidy and Chase's connection begins to spark. Through losing the car keys, stopping to partake in a Mrs. Claus parade and a surprise run-in with Jo, whose plane got grounded mid-flight due to weather, Cassidy builds bonds with both siblings as they all challenge one another's life philosophies. As the trio pushes past every obstacle, they work to embrace their differences and find that the fastest way home is when they lean on one another for help.

title: Eight Nights for Love
overview: Hannah, who works for a large auction house in New York City, is excited for her best friend Ethan to return home for a visit during Hanukkah and is looking forward to some time off from work That plan is short-lived when Ethan shares the news that he's convinced the daughter of his wealthy boss to use Hannah's auction house to sell their family's collection of Judaica with the condition that Hannah handles the sale. Complicating her holiday further, she meets the mysterious Pearl, who gifts her with an antique menorah that is anything but ordinary as it takes her back to a different times of her life each night of Hanukkah, with Pearl as her guide. This front row seat to past moments leads Hannah to reflect, break out of her comfort zone and overcome her fear of failure. Thanks to her trips through the past, and as she and Ethan spend time together in the present, Hannah realizes she has feelings for him she never acknowledged.

title: The Meltdown

overview: A team of explorers discover a clue to the origins of mankind on Earth, leading them on a journey to the darkest corners of the universe. There, they must fight a terrifying battle to save the future of the human race.

overview: Basil, a working-studying Fine Arts student, falls in love with Elma after meeting her at a Persib soccer match. He creates a t-shirt featuring her image that goes viral, leading to their acquaintance and eventual dating. However, their relationship faces opposition from Elma's father, forcing Basil to fight for his love amidst various obstacles.

title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

title: Doctor Strange
overview: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.

title: An Angel in My Stocking
overview: Three years after a disastrous marriage, Amanda unexpectedly gets stranded with her ex-husband Jack in a remote Vermont town, where a mysterious traveler claiming to be her guardian angel pushes them to confront their past.

title: V
overview: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once a land of opportunity, was plagued by rampant crime and a breakdown of order. Man Tsz-keung, a working-class man desperate to change his fate, meets flight attendant Lok Ka-yuen, and the two team up to rob a large sum of money. This success fuels Man Tsz-keung's madness, pushing him into a deeper power struggle with wealthy businessman Chan Fai-yin. Meanwhile, mainland police officer Qi Honggang and Hong Kong police officer Guan Suchen continue their investigation of Wan Ziqiang, leading to a joint operation between the two police forces, setting the stage for a clash between good and evil. This film is fictional.

title: The Woman When
overview: Media personality Dina El Kordi runs a women’s empowerment center and launches a large social media campaign aimed at supporting women and addressing stubbornness or lack of understanding in married life. The campaign sparks widespread controversy in society between supporters and opponents.

title: Green Concrete
overview: Should the trees in the city always disappear whenever reconstruction takes place? The project, which began with memories and records, leads to meeting various people from different fields to explore practical ways to preserve trees. The film follows the whereabouts of the trees that once lived on a green island in a ruin of concrete until they eventually vanished.

title: Gone Girl
overview: With his wife's disappearance having become the focus of an intense media circus, a man sees the spotlight turned on him when it's suspected that he may not be innocent.

title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
overview: Through five portraits of relatives and mentors, five expressions of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protests footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history. From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.

title: Shiawase wa Tabete Nete Mate: Soshun no Yojo Hen
original_title: しあわせは食べて寝て待て～早春の養生編～
overview: Mugimaki Satoko, who has developed an illness she will have to live with for the rest of her life, commutes from an apartment complex where the rent is 50,000 yen to her part-time job four days a week. Having given up on moving to the countryside, she has been feeling somewhat depressed.  One winter day, Tsukasa, who is staying next door, invites her to go for an early-morning walk, but she turns him down. Satoko, who feels self-conscious because everything requires physical strength, is hesitant and says, "Someone like me..." even as her landlady, Suzu, and neighbor Koma get excited talking about romance. Suzu then invites Satoko to her home.  Amid her usual daily life with her coworkers and friends from the apartment complex, surrounded by medicinal cuisine, Satoko gradually finds small moments of happiness. This is a special episode about those ordinary yet quietly wonderful days.

title: The Summer You Kissed Me
overview: Still carrying the wounds of a past relationship, Didi travels to Lijiang, where he meets the bright and straightforward Gao Ran. A meeting that begins in the height of summer and a kiss that changes everything become the most unforgettable memories of first love.

title: The Kingdom of Rexmonte
overview: When a Sudden Invasion threatens their kingdom, a fractured royal family must face their long-avoided differences in order to protect their denizens, restore the peace, and secure their domain.

title: Frank & Louis
overview: Frank, serving a life sentence, takes a prison job caring for aging incarcerated men with Alzheimer’s and dementia. What begins as a self-interested bid for parole becomes a profound, transformative bond with fellow prisoner Louis, offering Frank a glimpse of redemption in an unforgiving place.

title: Skintown
overview: 1994. As Northern Ireland takes its first steps towards peace, best friends Vinny and Jonty are about to jump start their futures with the most reckless trip of their lives.

title: Aussie at Heart
overview: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

title: The Canary's Lullaby
overview: In a storm-scared village, 70-year-old Tae lives a quiet life until she rescues Haru, a mysterious mountain creature. As she feeds and nurtures him with her wanzi, she finds a renewed sense of purpose. However, when rumors of a monster spread, fear turns the villagers against them. Tae is forcibly hospitalized, and Haru is hunted as a harbinger of disaster. To protect him, she stages a fake funeral. When a new storm strikes, Tae must learn that love is not possession but letting go.

title: God Is Shy
overview: During a train ride, Ariel and Paul pass the time sketching their deepest fears. Their game takes an unexpected turn when Gilda, a mysterious passenger, intrudes on their exchange. Yet, her relationship with fear seems far less innocent than their playful drawings.

title: April X
overview: When his twin sister April (Lilly Krug) goes missing, Bax (Connor Storrie) searches every corner of their futuristic, post-Soviet cityscape to find her. Ultimately descending into a violent criminal underworld and madness, Bax is forced to confront the cost of identity, love, and survival.

title: Filipiñana
overview: While working at an elite country club outside Manila, a 17-year-old Ilocana worker uncovers the violent truths of her workplace, her country, and her own past after attempting to return a lost golf club to the club's president.

title: Dracula
overview: Experience on stage the story of Jonathan Harker, a young solicitor sent to finalize a deal with a reclusive earl. As he ventures deeper into the mysterious count’s world, terrifying secrets begin to unfold…

title: Miles to Christmas
overview: When an early snowstorm sweeps through the Midwest, punctual, straight-laced "suit" Cassidy Fields is forced to hitch a ride with free spirited, music loving Johanna "Jo" Woods in her bother Chase's 18-wheeler to the nearest airport to catch another flight. However, when Jo's flight successfully takes off and Cassidy's is cancelled again at the last minute, she joins Chase on the road back to Tennessee from Chicago to make it home in time to spend Christmas with her father. Quickly, Cassidy and Chase's connection begins to spark. Through losing the car keys, stopping to partake in a Mrs. Claus parade and a surprise run-in with Jo, whose plane got grounded mid-flight due to weather, Cassidy builds bonds with both siblings as they all challenge one another's life philosophies. As the trio pushes past every obstacle, they work to embrace their differences and find that the fastest way home is when they lean on one another for help.

title: Eight Nights for Love
overview: Hannah, who works for a large auction house in New York City, is excited for her best friend Ethan to return home for a visit during Hanukkah and is looking forward to some time off from work That plan is short-lived when Ethan shares the news that he's convinced the daughter of his wealthy boss to use Hannah's auction house to sell their family's collection of Judaica with the condition that Hannah handles the sale. Complicating her holiday further, she meets the mysterious Pearl, who gifts her with an antique menorah that is anything but ordinary as it takes her back to a different times of her life each night of Hanukkah, with Pearl as her guide. This front row seat to past moments leads Hannah to reflect, break out of her comfort zone and overcome her fear of failure. Thanks to her trips through the past, and as she and Ethan spend time together in the present, Hannah realizes she has feelings for him she never acknowledged.

title: The Meltdown
overview: 1992, Chile. Nine-year-old Inés' parents are away on business, leaving her in the care of her grandparents, who own a hotel at the foot of a ski resort. Inés befriends Hanna, a teenage European skier who has come to train in Chile. One night, Hanna disappears. The process of her search will unveil a series of hidden situations.

title: Peter and the Goblin Arrow
overview: When a mighty Dwarven warrior falls victim to a goblin's poisoned arrow, his weakling son must embark on a perilous quest to gather three ingredients needed to save his father's life before dawn breaks and all hope is lost.
At the height of the First World War, two young British soldiers must cross enemy territory and deliver a message that will stop a deadly attack on hundreds of soldiers.

title: Pay to Die
overview: While putting together a horror movie, a group of filmmakers are terrorized by a killer after hiring the wrong person for the job.

title: One Minute to Midnight
overview: As he is about to separate from his partner, with whom he lives in Eastern France, 49-year-old Léo learns of the death of his biological father whom he never knew. Before traveling to Italy to deal with the inheritance, he spends a few days in Paris to take stock of his life. Between conversations with his activist daughter and encounters with ghosts from his past, he begins to question his very existence, and, above all, his relationships with women.

title: 剑来院线剧场版 十三之争
original_title: 剑来院线剧场版 十三之争

title: Overlooked
overview: Overlooked follows Matt Iman as he returns home from a two-year LDS mission and begins navigating adulthood while living with Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH), a rare genetic condition that leaves his body unable to produce cortisol. Though he appears healthy, every day is shaped by medication, emergency preparedness, and the constant risk of a life threatening adrenal crisis. Through intimate observational storytelling, the film offers a deeply personal look at life with an invisible illness while exploring resilience, family, and the invisible realities of living with a rare disease.

title: Skin of Foam
overview: On a quiet night in the biggest city of Southern China, a small-town migrant carwash worker encounters a strange customer who forces him into a decision that might change his life.

title: Above the Below
overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

title: Cattle Run
overview: Brothers living like strangers for over 30 years, Man-su and Byung-su raise cattle separately but get caught up in an unexpected crisis together.

title: 3726 mdpl
overview: Adapted from a novel named “3726 mdpl”

title: Love on the Needle Tip
overview: Teacher Lee suddenly dies during a sex party, and the toxicology reports reveal multiple illicit substances in his system, leading police to suspect a fatal overdose. But with countless partygoers entering and leaving his room that night—including a hookup arranged through an app, the drug dealer who supplied the substances, a famous adult influencer, and even his husband, who stayed by his side throughout the night—everyone becomes a suspect. Who is actually responsible for his death?

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
overview: Just when his time under house arrest is about to end, Scott Lang once again puts his freedom at risk to help Hope van Dyne and Dr. Hank Pym dive into the quantum realm and try to accomplish, against time and any chance of success, a very dangerous rescue mission.

title: 2 Aile Arasında
overview: Sequel to 'In the Family' (2017). Plot TBA.

title: Bokshi
overview: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

title: The Ferry Man: Butterfly Dream
overview: The tranquility of a remote mountain village was suddenly shattered when children began to disappear one by one. The villagers blamed the mysterious Mountain God for the children's disappearances.

title: It Will Happen Tonight
overview: In Oslo, Thea and Matteo are awaiting the birth of their child. Meanwhile, in Mumbai, Charles asks Greta to marry him in public. Seven years later, in Rome, Matteo is playing tennis when Greta shows up for a match, dressed as a bride. For him it's love at first sight, but she's just married. Life goes on, yet Matteo cannot forget Greta. Seven years later, they meet again by chance; both are married and have children with other people. Love always brings them together at the wrong time. Loosely based on the short story collection "Legami" by Eshkol Nevo.

title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
overview: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

title: Her in Frame
original_title: เธอในภาพนั้น
overview: Inspired by the love story of King Bhumibol Adulyadej and Queen Sirikit, the movie follows a young photographer and a textile museum curator who connect through a mysterious vintage photograph.

title: Royal Puppies for Christmas
overview: When dog trainer Grace Walker is called to a European palace to tame mischievous royal corgis, she clashes with Prince William — but puppy chaos and Christmas magic lead to unexpected romance.

title: TV Land
overview: After being diagnosed with a terminal illness, Will is given a second chance at life when a disturbed doctor forces him into an experimental procedure. He awakens in a strange world hidden behind a television screen, where reality and fantasy blur together. As he searches for a way back home, Will is forced to confront his past and discover what truly gives life meaning.

title: The Babysitter’s Double Life
overview: A College Student begins an affair with a wealthy man who inspires her to create a babysitting-adjacent service for lonely, divorced fathers. However, things soon get dangerous as the operation grows into a full prostitution ring under her name.

title: Will You Care If I Die?
original_title: Blir du ledsen om jag dör?
overview: When youth worker Nic crosses paths with Elijah, a troubled teenager with undeniable basketball talent, he sees more than just a boy in need of help. Determined to steer him away from a destructive path, Nic takes Elijah under his wing, risking personal and professional boundaries to help him realize his potential both on and off the court. Against all rules and without anyone else's knowledge, Nic offers Elijah to move in with him. This marks the beginning of a close relationship, and the encounter with Elijah also helps Nic gain a deeper understanding of himself.

title: 80 BPM
overview: Zhenya is haunted by the same recurring dream: a mysterious man who makes her heart race. She believed him to be a figment of her imagination—until she spotted his photo in a colleague's playlist. It turns out that Pyotr is a successful musician. Zhenya resolves to track down the stranger from her dream.

title: Two Still
overview: Hao Hao and Xi Xi each said goodbye to their exes and fell in love with each other. Like most couples, they argued during their relationship, but the storm would pass and things would clear up... When it came time to get married, they began to seriously consider whether they were suitable for each other. After all, like socks, they needed to be in pairs to go on together. Could mismatched socks be suitable to be together...?

title: The Snowflake Effect
overview: When driven corporate attorney Tanya rushes into a charming gift shop searching for a last-minute White Elephant gift, she crosses paths with Jason, a handsome, laid-back clerk. Their brief encounter leads Tanya to purchase a beautiful antique glass snowflake which, unbeknownst to her or Jason, is a good luck charm that carries a generations-old Christmas tradition. However, since the ornament is entered into a holiday gift exchange rather than gifted with proper intention, Tanya suddenly finds herself on the receiving end of everyone else's misfortune. After Jason's Aunt Coco explains the snowflake's magical lore, Tanya reluctantly teams up with Jason to track down the snowflake as it makes its way from one recipient to the next across Chicago before Christmas Day or she'll be stuck with bad luck until next Christmas.

title: Learning to Fly
overview: Aisha McAdams, a former competitive runner turned photographer, embarks on a journey to document the triumphs and struggles of famed ultra trailrunners, including Jim Walmsley and Eszter Csillag. Traveling to mythical races—the Western States Endurance Run in the mountains of eastern California, the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc in the French Alps—the film marvels at athletes who maintain their intensity as they run 100 miles of mountain trails while climbing thousands of vertical feet.

title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
overview: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

title: Zhalin
overview: A female university student arrives late at night at her dormitory and finds herself locked out. She is forced to make her way across the city to her aunt's house, where she encounters a mysterious man along the way.

title: Never Stop Chasing
overview: A documentary portrait of storm chaser Reed Timmer, who was an inspiration for Glen Powell’s character in Twisters.

title: A Grand Biltmore Christmas
overview: In 1895, Elizabeth meets Michael, a teen trespasser at Biltmore House who vanishes. When he returns 20 years later, a magic hourglass pulls her to the present. She must return home before being found and before love alters her destiny.

title: Hiddensee
overview: Hiddensee in the Baltic Sea has always been a place where people have sought freedom. This film takes us on a journey through an entire century, starting in the golden 1920s, as it assembles the island’s scenery, history, and personal stories into a fascinating portrait. Then as now, the political upheavals that have swept across Germany have left their mark.

title: Christmas by the Spoonful
overview: When a food critic with no culinary abilities of her own is tasked with preparing her family's first Christmas dinner since the passing of their beloved matriarch, she is forced to enlist the help of a local French food truck owner whom she nearly put out of business with a bad review.

title: Crossing A Dawn
overview: During a date, Xu Qiu and Chen Yuzhou's serendipitous encounter leads to repeatedly thwarted attempts at intimacy, yet a night of urban wonders gradually unveils their guarded emotions, culminating in an unforgettable love.

title: El Salvador: O Dia em que o Medo Mudou de Lado
original_title: El Salvador: O Dia em que o Medo Mudou de Lado

title: Wanda Sykes: Legacy
overview: Wanda Sykes returns to her alma mater with a fearlessly funny takedown of everything from the state of the world to the cultural clash over washcloths.

title: Diamond
overview: Joe Diamond is out of time with a traumatic past and an uncanny ability to solve crimes, using wit and observation to peel back hidden truths.

title: Tin Castle
overview: Along a long-forgotten road, the O’Reillys live in a rundown trailer stranded in the middle of the fields. Pa’, Lisa, and their ten children weather the seasons in their tin castle, heirs to a way of life on borrowed time. Under threat of eviction, their tenuous balance falters, yet – steadfast in their tradition – they resist. The children laugh, the dogs bark, the trailer holds on – but for how long?

title: La Perra
overview: On a remote, wind-lashed island off the Chilean coast, Silvia earns her living harvesting  seaweed and shares a quiet life with her partner. When she adopts a stray puppy, Yuri, her days fill with joy, love, and a tenderness that stirs a long-suppressed longing for motherhood. But Yuri’s sudden disappearance reawakens a haunting childhood trauma, forcing Silvia to confront a past she has never truly left behind.

title: Jônetsu Tairiku : Iyo Sky
overview: WWE, the world's largest professional wrestling organization, is said to be watched by over 1 billion people in more than 150 countries through television and streaming. The annual "WrestleMania" event attracts nearly 60,000 spectators, creating an excitement comparable to the American football "Super Bowl. "Only top wrestlers from around the world step into the ring. In 2018, a Japanese woman professional wrestler joined WWE. A former gymnast, she captivated audiences with her acrobatic moves, utilizing her flexibility and agility. And last year, she rose to become the WWE Women's World Champion. That's Iyo Sky. When Iyo appears in front of the venue, a huge cheer erupts. "IYO! IYO!". Autographs, high-fives, hugs, two-shot photos... Her popularity is soaring across America.

title: Avedon
overview: Richard Avedon’s photographs didn’t just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon’s archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

title: STRAIGHT EDGE
overview: Desperate to escape his dead-end life, Matt (Chris Lovejoy) recruits his derelict friends to rob the neighborhood mob's card game. With his crew's reputation on the line, Denicio (Joe Graziano) is tasked with hunting down the trio and finding the money. Matt is forced to choose between his past or a life with the woman he loves.

title: Corpse Bride
overview: In a 19th-century European village, a young man about to be married is whisked away to the underworld and wed to a mysterious corpse bride, while his real bride waits bereft in the land of the living.

title: Ocean's Eleven
overview: Less than 24 hours into his parole, charismatic thief Danny Ocean is already rolling out his next plan: In one night, Danny's hand-picked crew of specialists will attempt to steal more than $150 million from three Las Vegas casinos. But to score the cash, Danny risks his chances of reconciling with ex-wife, Tess.

title: The Dark Knight Rises
overview: Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the late attorney's reputation and is subsequently hunted by the Gotham City Police Department. Eight years later, Batman encounters the mysterious Selina Kyle and the villainous Bane, a new terrorist leader who overwhelms Gotham's finest. The Dark Knight resurfaces to protect a city that has branded him an enemy.

title: Fast X
overview: Over many missions and against impossible odds, Dom Toretto and his family have outsmarted, out-nerved and outdriven every foe in their path. Now, they confront the most lethal opponent they've ever faced: A terrifying threat emerging from the shadows of the past who's fueled by blood revenge, and who is determined to shatter this family and destroy everything—and everyone—that Dom loves, forever.

title: Kartavya
overview: With his family's safety at stake and menacing threats closing in, a police officer must decide how far he'll go to uphold his duty.

title: Hayok
overview: A feisty thriller about a fiercely independent woman who becomes the obsession of a contractor desperate to possess her. But when betrayal turns violent, she strikes back with a revenge that destroys his pride and control.

title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
overview: Bilbo Baggins, a hobbit enjoying his quiet life, is swept into an epic quest by Gandalf the Grey and thirteen dwarves who seek to reclaim their mountain home from Smaug, the dragon.

title: The Notebook: The Musical
overview: Allie and Noah, both from different worlds, share a lifetime of love despite the forces that threaten to pull them apart, in a deeply moving portrait of the enduring power of love.

title: Shera
overview: A high-energy action drama centered on strength, loyalty, and confrontation. The story unfolds through intense moments and gripping action as the protagonist faces powerful forces and personal challenges.

title: Bride of the Year
overview: When Lienkie's dream of budding a family of her own come crashing down, she hatches a devious plan to win "Bride of the Year" and get back at her ex.

title: Frank & Louis
overview: Frank, serving a life sentence, takes a prison job caring for aging incarcerated men with Alzheimer’s and dementia. What begins as a self-interested bid for parole becomes a profound, transformative bond with fellow prisoner Louis, offering Frank a glimpse of redemption in an unforgiving place.

title: Skintown
overview: 1994. As Northern Ireland takes its first steps towards peace, best friends Vinny and Jonty are about to jump start their futures with the most reckless trip of their lives.

title: Aussie at Heart
overview: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

As she feeds and nurtures him with her wanzi, she finds a renewed sense of purpose. However, when rumors of a monster spread, fear turns the villagers against them. Tae is forcibly hospitalized, and Haru is hunted as a harbinger of disaster. To protect him, she stages a fake funeral. When a new storm strikes, Tae must learn that love is not possession but letting go.

title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
original_title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
overview: In 1926, Newt Scamander arrives at the Magical Congress of the United States of America with a magically expanded briefcase, which houses a number of dangerous creatures and their habitats. When the creatures escape from the briefcase, it sends the American wizarding authorities after Newt, and threatens to strain even further the state of magical and non-magical relations.

title: Clarissa
overview: A modern reimagining of the Virginia Woolf novel Mrs. Dalloway. Follows society woman Clarissa as she prepares to host a party at her home in Lagos, Nigeria, where she will unexpectedly encounter once-intimate friends from her youth. As the group reflects on their shared past over the course of a single night, memories of their intricate relationships, passionate love, hidden desires, and lost aspirations give rise to bittersweet reckoning.

title: Sisters
overview: After her elder sister Isidora attempts suicide following an argument between the two of them, eleven-year-old Petra spends the day in the hospital, hiding from a social worker. Unable to deal with the situation that has befallen her, she wanders through the corridors for hours, thinking about her relationship with her sister and about their family.

title: Of Womb
overview: Evading the hard truth of their religious matriarch’s death, three sisters gestate dark ecstasies of faith and folk horror. Blessed be Mother.

title: Keu Bole Biplobi, Keu Bole Dakat
original_title: কেউ বলে বিপ্লবী, কেউ বলে ডাকাত
overview: A biopic of Ananta Singha. Some calls him dacoit, some calls him a rebellion. This adaptation gives the viewer a chance to know him as a whole, a person and as a revolutionary communist leader.

title: The Airport Chaplain
overview: At a bustling international airport, lost people seek missed connections, while others carry heavy personal baggage. Tobias Wallace shepherds them all. Scruffy and benevolent in his hi-vis “Chaplain”-printed vest and always on call, he’ll bend rules to help passengers and workers alike – that includes Asha, a young woman hiding in the prayer room whose murky history stirs Tobias’s own deeply buried traumas. Not everybody is a fan of his methods, however: ambitious new terminal manager Mira has liability nightmare Tobias marked for redundancy. But as crises appear everywhere – overworked baggage handlers, security breaches, families torn apart and grief-stricken relatives – maybe this infuriating chaplain could be Mira’s salvation.

title: Christmas in Canterbury
overview: A festive romance film

title: Meeting Marsha
overview: An aspiring actress must put her marriage proposal on pause to her comedian girlfriend, when her biological mother and infamous TV star, Marsha Davis, wants to finally meet. What should be a lovely and unforgettable weekend, turns more nightmarish than anyone could have ever expected.

title: Good Sport
overview: A divorced youth basketball coach must lead his son's team through a chaotic game while battling helicopter parents, an unhinged opposing coach, and his own sense of failure.

title: Mad Rush
overview: A young woman gets caught in an elaborate phone scam which sends her on a twisted odyssey through the Melbourne CBD.

title: Snow Globe Town
overview: Emily Church joins her sister Zoe and Zoe’s longtime boyfriend on a Christmas getaway to Pine Grove, a town famous for its romantic holiday traditions. While helping with Zoe’s proposal plans, Emily is paired with skeptical journalist Bert Baxter. As they are drawn into the town’s festive celebrations, unexpected feelings begin to challenge what they both thought they knew about love, family and Christmas.

title: A Very Evergreen Christmas
overview: Abby inherits her aunt's tree farm under the condition she spends two weeks working there. With the help from Ethan, the farm's longtime caretaker and Abby's best childhood friend, Abby learns that the farm is much more than just a place.

title: Agadha
overview: A solitary girl encounters a towering twelve-handed mystical idol in a torch lit shadowy cave, creating an atmosphere of spirituality and dark intrigue.

title: Honestino
overview: Arrested five times for his activism, student leader Honestino Guimarães was kidnapped in 1973 at the age of 26 and is one of the hundreds of people who disappeared during the Brazilian military dictatorship.

title: Magic Atlas
overview: A magician arrives in the reclusive coal empire of Luocha, triggering widespread panic in a society already simmering beneath a fragile peace.

title: User Not Found
overview: Two men and women with unknown identities, a live online trial in a confined space, and an extreme escape between death and truth

title: This, That, and Everything in Between
overview: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the  complexities of their dysfunctional family.

title: Noelle Nomads
overview: Before they can embark on their luxurious Hawaiian holiday, uptight sports medicine physician Joseph and his daughter Annie must first begrudgingly make a pit stop at a remote campground and deliver a package from his late father to a mysterious person named Birdie. Their plans are derailed when Joseph accidentally crashes into free-spirited Nora's RV at a rest stop. Things go from bad to worse when they not only fail to find the elusive Birdie, but their ancient Winnebago breaks down as well. Forced to spend the next few days at the campground while they wait for replacement parts, Nora introduces Joseph and Annie to the eccentric campers who lovingly dub themselves the Nomads. The embers of romance begin to glow as Nora shows Joseph how to embrace the freedom of camp life. When the mystery of who Birdie is becomes clearer and the much-awaited parts arrive, allowing Joseph and Annie to finally make their Hawaiian getaway,

title: Arte Alter
overview: "Destiny sets the tempo. You make the move."  Dance is not merely movement, it is the raw, rhythmic pulse of destiny itself—an unyielding current shaping everything in its path. Parallel to this elemental force, a soul wanders through the shadowy corridors of the self, locked in a quiet struggle between resistance and acceptance. Through a tapestry of cross-cutting imagery, the film explores the human inner labyrinth: the friction of confronting one’s dark side, the weight of hidden identities, and the quiet beauty of finally yielding to the rhythm that was guiding us all along.

title: Dave Waite: On The Loose
overview: Cincinnati native Dave Waite’s eclectic style is on full dispaly in this special filmed in his hometown. With hilarious takes on AirBNBs, fast food apps and other comedy specials, Dave showcases his unique voice mixed with the poise of a comedy veteran in his debut special.

title: Un grand raccourci
overview: When their family restaurant is on the verge of closing, two cousins release rats in an attempt to set themselves up as pest control experts. That same summer, two young women rig the local beauty contest to promote their jewelry. Caught up in their chaotic schemes, these four resourceful young people searching for a better future eventually cross paths.

title: Curse of the Shark
overview: When a marine biology team explore unusual shark activity in Central America, they discover the horrifying truth behind an island legend.

title: Fast
overview: For Sterling, a sort of present-day Alice, the graveyard Lotus she redeems becomes a totem, a saturated phenomenon permitting her to move freely in time on a phantom road. It is a sort of Ford but never a DeLorean. A Southern woman with a fair deal of historical baggage and deep secrets, Sterling journeys back to her rural home, the Lotus takes her through the shadow of the valley into the adjoining worlds of the living and the dead. Desiring to become an F1 driver, Sterling must go fast/hard, against/through all tunnels imagined or concrete.

title: Exiles of Earth
overview: Five stories follow humanity beyond Earth, where explorers and survivors face alien worlds, impossible choices and the struggle to find a new place to call home.

title: RIZIN 54
overview: RIZIN 54 takes place on August 11, 2026, at the Toyota Arena Tokyo. The main event features veteran former champion Kleber Koike facing the surging young prospect Kyoma Akimoto. The card also features a heavyweight tournament opening round.

title: Fast X
overview: Over many missions and against impossible odds, Dom Toretto and his family have outsmarted, out-nerved and outdriven every foe in their path. Now, they confront the most lethal opponent they've ever faced: A terrifying threat emerging from the shadows of the past who's fueled by blood revenge, and who is determined to shatter this family and destroy everything—and everyone—that Dom loves, forever.

title: ANGGATEGATEL
overview: It began with the question, “Do ants get ants on them, too?” And if they do, do they itch as well? A red ant tries to pinpoint the source of the itch it feels—wondering if it stems from superstition or from the negative connotations forcibly attached to it.

title: Viva Carmen
overview: 1845, Seville, a pulsating town of sailors and small-time crooks. Teenage Salvador, assistant to the gifted knife grinder Antonio, encounters a captivating young gypsy woman, Carmen. Her stunning beauty and independent spirit set the town abuzz, but Antonio's mystical ability to glimpse the future in sharpened blades foretells a tragic fate for Carmen at the hands of a soldier, José. With unwavering resolve, Salvador musters an eclectic band of misfit street kids, led by the spirited Belén, to challenge the unyielding threads of destiny and protect Carmen from inevitable doom.

title: Buddy's Mom
overview: 20-year-old Kyeong-soo is a man who's full of assumptions. He learned about sex from Internet porn, but nothing about the real thing. He's only had crushes and has never even kissed before. He got embarrassed when he confessed his feelings to Ji-yeon, his crush. He comforted himself from the shame with Japanese girls in his room with his right hand. Out of curiosity, she and her friends power it on. Soon afterward, strange videos featuring the children themselves begin appearing on their phones. At first, the clips seem like harmless jokes and are consumed much like viral internet memes. What the children do not realize, however, is that these videos are foretelling a horrifying future that awaits them.
