title: Almost Us
overview: A passionate one-night stand between a carefree community organizer and a closeted real estate developer ignites a battle over a Phoenix cultural center-and forces them to confront love, identity, and legacy.

title: My Dearest Señorita
overview: A young woman from a traditional family learns she's intersex, sparking a journey of self-discovery, gender identity and love found in unexpected places.

title: Palimpsest: The Story of a Name
original_title: Palimpsest: The Story of a Name
overview: Veteran filmmaker Mary Stephen digs into her own family past to uncover the long-hidden origins of her Western surname, revealing a story of culture shock, colonialism, and contested remembrance.

title: Hellboy: Devastation
overview: B.P.R.D. sends Hellboy on a mission to save a woman kidnapped by Beleth and his legions of demons.

title: Yiya Murano: Death at Tea Time
original_title: Yiya Murano: Muerte a la hora del té
overview: Yiya Murano poisoned her friends to cover up scams in 1970s Argentina and became a dark figure in popular culture. Freed in the 1990s, she reappeared as a pop icon. Today, her son Martín seeks to reveal her true face.

title: The Guest Who Wouldn't Leave
overview: Tom and his daughter Cora decide to open their guest house to short term renters, however when their first renter Elise begins to overstay her welcome, Tom is faced with the reality that he may never be able to get her to leave.

title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
original_title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
overview: In 1926, Newt Scamander arrives at the Magical Congress of the United States of America with a magically expanded briefcase, which houses a number of dangerous creatures and their habitats. When the creatures escape from the briefcase, it sends the American wizarding authorities after Newt, and threatens to strain even further the state of magical and non-magical relations.

title: The Poet and the Spy
overview: In 1919 Fiume, Russian spy Beatrice navigates political turmoil while protecting poet Gabriele D’Annunzio, entangling with an intelligence chief and a WWI deserter amid Italy’s revolutionary unrest.

title: A Quiet Place Part II
overview: Following the events at home, the Abbott family now face the terrors of the outside world. Forced to venture into the unknown, they realize that the creatures that hunt by sound are not the only threats that lurk beyond the sand path.

title: Compliance
overview: On the eve of a landmark deal for a major tech startup, they're faced with a sexual assault controversy that threatens to become a PR disaster. As new hire Sam works to contain the fallout, it becomes clear that not all is as it seems, and she quickly finds herself in a game of cat and mouse with a criminal organization taking aim at the company and their investors.

title: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough
original_title: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough
overview: Veteran naturalist Sir David Attenborough tells the story of a remarkable group of gorillas, from his first encounter in the '70s to the present day.

title: Just an Illusion
overview: In 1985 suburban Paris, 12-year-old Vincent lives with his distant older brother and quarrelling parents. Amid laughter and unease, he navigates friendship and first love, while beginning to confront the adult world.

title: Scarface
overview: After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fueled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.

title: Oru Durooha Saahacharyathil
overview: Humble health care worker Sethu lives a quiet life caring for his sick brother — until a mysterious armed fugitive seeks refuge in his home.

title: 12 Angry Men
overview: A juror attempts to convince the other 11 jurors to question the guilt of a 16 year old boy accused of killing his father.

title: The Highest Stakes
overview: Five strangers are invited to a luxurious hotel for a high-stakes poker game. What begins as a contest for fortune quickly spirals into something far more dangerous. As tensions rise and secrets surface, the players realize the stakes aren’t just about money—they’re about survival. In a night of escalating peril, trust becomes a weapon, and every choice could seal their fate.

title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
overview: When single mom Callie and her two kids Trevor and Phoebe arrive in a small Oklahoma town, they begin to discover their connection to the original Ghostbusters and the secret legacy their grandfather left behind.

title: Once Upon A Time
overview: After failing in the big city, Chen Tao returns home and unexpectedly reunites with his deceased father through an old book, leading to whimsical adventures that heal their rift and inspire him to start anew.

title: Magma
overview: After setting fire to his own house, Ju-young’s father vanished without a trace. When she receives news that fragments of his bones have been discovered, Ju-young returns to her hometown village — and to see her Deaf younger brother, Se-hyung. The village and the mountains are unnaturally quiet. So quiet, it feels as though something beneath them is beginning to boil. Drawn deeper into that silence, Ju-young must slowly dig up what has long been buried there. Within that unknowable silence, something is seething.

title: The Keris
overview: A battle over the Keris Tempa Melaka, a legendary blade linked to warrior Hang Tuah, drawing in a Muay Thai practitioner and a Russian mafia syndicate.

title: Miss Mermaid
overview: Freshly divorced, Fanny, a thirty-something from Fécamp, has nothing left of her marriage but a sky-blue sofa, debts she refuses to pay, and an absolute determination never to 'start her life' with a man again. Despite her burning need for freedom, this cleaning lady finds herself stuck back at her parents' house.  That is, until the day she crosses paths with Anemone, a professional mermaid passing through the region. She decides to take the plunge and dive into the world of mermaiding.

title: Flies
overview: Olga lives a strictly regulated life without attachments in a vast apartment block. When out of financial necessity she rents a room in her apartment to a man who also sneaks-in his nine-year-old son, an unlikely bond forms. Her carefully controlled world begins to shift, and their lives become intertwined against her will.

title: Snatch
overview: Unscrupulous boxing promoters, violent bookies, a Russian gangster, incompetent amateur robbers, and supposedly Jewish jewellers fight to track down a priceless stolen diamond.

title: Doctor Sleep
overview: Still scarred by the trauma he endured as a child at the Overlook Hotel, Dan Torrance faces the ghosts of the past when he meets Abra, a courageous teen who desperately needs his help -- and who possesses a powerful extrasensory ability called the "shine".

title: Django Unchained
overview: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.

title: Dear Future Self
overview: Nico, a filmmaker, returns to her hometown to lead a storytelling workshop with her childhood friend Lori, a schoolteacher there. Lori’s pupils are asked to imagine their future selves. The children’s thoughts prompt Nico and Lori to reexamine their own decisions in life — as well as their friendship.

title: Revelation
overview: A post-apocalyptic survivor seeks the answer to why this is happening to him and to humanity.

title: Super 8
overview: In late 1970s Ohio, a group of friends filming a homemade zombie movie witness a devastating train derailment. Soon after, their quiet town is gripped by unexplained disappearances, strange phenomena, and a growing sense of fear, as they uncover that something terrifying has been set loose.

title: Blackbird
overview: Autumn 1979: 15-year-old Motte’s world is turned upside down when his best friend Bogi falls seriously ill, his parents separate, and he falls in love with Jacqueline, the most beautiful girl in the world. Torn between lovesickness and guilt toward his friend, he experiences an emotional rollercoaster. Yet all Motte really wants to do is listen to David Bowie, play soccer, and finally work up the courage to jump from the ten-meter diving board — his sanctuary whenever things get to be too much. Steffi, a self-confident chimney sweep, also throws his world into disarray with her zest for life. Many years later, Motte — now a structural engineer — is commissioned to demolish the ten-meter diving tower at the weather-beaten outdoor pool. But this place, which holds such deep significance, is filled with memories of the events from that year that changed his life.

title: Bluefish
overview: Fresh out of prison, Gwang-su, a physically impaired ex-thug, returns to his quiet seaside hometown of Yeongdeok. Hardened by years of violence, he drifts through the harbor town doing odd jobs for a small-time gang involved in a shady redevelopment project. After mistakenly assaulting Yeon-jeon, a mute single mother, Gwang-su is confronted with guilt and the fragile humanity he thought he had lost. As an unlikely bond forms between them, he learns that the redevelopment scheme will force her and her son from their home. Caught between loyalty to the gang and the chance for redemption, Gwang-su must decide whether to remain part of the violence—or risk everything to protect the only people who have shown him kindness.

title: A Turkish Case
overview: Mathieu distanced himself from his Turkish community to climb the social ladder. A determined lawyer, he works hard to become a partner at an influential Parisian law firm. When a young Turkish man in a precarious situation who needs help bursts into his life, Mathieu is drawn into a corruption scandal that threatens to destroy everything he has built.

title: Karoshi
overview: Described as a corporate thriller with a samurai twist. Set in a Japanese-influenced New York City and features a revenge element. Plot TBA.

title: Pitico: Hermes Ayres Azevedo (1881-1959) - Local Historian
original_title: Pitico - Hermes Ayres Azevedo (1881-1959) - Historiador da Província

title: The Truman Show
overview: In a picture-perfect seaside town, an insurance salesman begins to realize that his entire existence may be staged and observed by a vast unseen audience as part of a long-running real-time reality TV show.

title: The Shadows
overview: Writers Glenn, Lena, and Denny work on a screenplay about Charlie, a paranormal investigator. As they develop the story, eerie and supernatural events start to manifest in their reality, blurring the lines between fiction and real life.

title: Strawberries
overview: Hasna leaves her native Morocco to work as a seasonal laborer picking strawberries in Huelva, Andalucia.

title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
overview: Five years after uniting the dragons and Vikings of Berk, Hiccup and Toothless soar beyond their homeland, charting the vast unknown. During one of their adventures, the pair discover a secret cave that houses hundreds of wild dragons—and a mysterious dragon rider with a startling connection to Hiccup. And as the ruthless conqueror Drago Bludvist rises to seize control of both dragons and people alike, Hiccup must step into his role as a true leader and, alongside his friends and Toothless, protect Berk from a devastating war.

title: MALWARE
overview: Led by a cybernetic soldier a group of exterminators in a fading zombie apocalypse have been sent to clear out an old infected zone long believed to be empty ... Or is it ?

title: The Whale and the Musician
overview: An electronic composer sets out to sea, where his music evokes a deep, poetic resonance in a humpback whale. Can we communicate with animals through music?

title: William Basinski - The Disintegration Loops
overview: William Basinski - The Disintegration Loops (Official Documentary Short Film)

title: Making Monsters
overview: SFX and make-up designers Dave and Lou Elsey talk candidly about their inspirations, the joy of their work and their hopes for the future

title: Venom
overview: Investigative journalist Eddie Brock attempts a comeback following a scandal, but accidentally becomes the host of Venom, a violent, super powerful alien symbiote. Soon, he must rely on his newfound powers to protect the world from a shadowy organization looking for a symbiote of their own.

title: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
original_title: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
overview: Following an assassination attempt on Senator Padmé Amidala, Jedi Knights Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi investigate a mysterious plot into the heart of the Separatist movement and the beginning of the Clone Wars.

title: Fantomas: The New World
overview: Paris, 1914: Fantomas, a master of deception and chaos, is being chased by Lieutenant Juve as he investigates a series of violent crimes that have put the city on edge. In an era of violence and political tensions, Lieutenant Juve finds himself hunting for a man with no motive, no agenda, no pattern or identity.

title: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
overview: Amber Haque reveals how OnlyFans models suffer widespread exploitation and coercion at the hands of their managers.

title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
original_title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
overview: Shang-Chi must confront the past he thought he left behind when he is drawn into the web of the mysterious Ten Rings organization.

title: As The Train Passes
overview: Tracing the heritage of Indian railways, this documentary explores the evolution of train travel and its lasting impact on people, culture, memory and cinema. A personal documentary short film made entirely on a smartphone.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
original_title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
overview: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a mysterious house-elf comes to warn Harry Potter at the start of his second year at Hogwarts. Adventure and danger await when bloody writing on a wall announces: The Chamber Of Secrets Has Been Opened. To save Hogwarts will require all of Harry, Ron and Hermione's magical abilities and courage.

title: Symon: Le pinceau des cimes
overview: Symon Welfringer charts his course like others draw a line of paint. A mountaineer and meteorologist, he is in perpetual conversation with the elements: light, wind, rock, cold, and night. The film unfolds as a visual poem, poised between metaphor and introspection.

title: Mruthyudevate
overview: According to Hindu mythology, the God of Death is Lord Dharmaraya, the one who delivers justice and punishment for a person's deeds after their lifetime ends. But the "Goddess of Death" in this film is not about fate or the end of life.

title: Governor
overview: Set against Indias 1990 economic crisis, Governor follows Raman, a reluctant bureaucrat unexpectedly appointed as the Governor of the RBI when the nation stands on the brink of bankruptcy. As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.

title: Godzilla: King of the Monsters
overview: Follows the heroic efforts of the crypto-zoological agency Monarch as its members face off against a battery of god-sized monsters, including the mighty Godzilla, who collides with Mothra, Rodan, and his ultimate nemesis, the three-headed King Ghidorah. When these ancient super-species, thought to be mere myths, rise again, they all vie for supremacy, leaving humanity's very existence hanging in the balance.

title: Habeebi
overview: Follows a boy and girl in a Muslim neighbourhood in southern Tamil Nadu whose romance divides their community.

title: Ratatouille
overview: In one of Paris's finest restaurants, Remy, a determined young rat, dreams of becoming a renowned French chef. Torn between his family's wishes and his true calling, Remy and his pal Linguini set in motion a hilarious chain of events that turns the City of Lights upside down.

title: Muyi
original_title: Muyi, la légende du village des femmes
overview: Muyi, 14, lives on a Chinese secluded mountain, forbidden to men. With her two friends, she encounters an opera troupe renowned for The Handsome General play. As she invites them to perform in her village, an angry Spirit awakens. To restore balance, Muyi embarks on a life-changing journey through old China, uncovering the secrets of love, courage and self-made destiny.

title: Heart in Your Throat
overview: Marina is thirteen and alone. After her grandfather's suicide, she wants to disappear, wishing her imagination could be real.

title: A Trip to the Ear
overview: A woman, living in a house that drifts like cosmic debris, wakes to find her right ear and her husband gone. To recover what was lost, she embarks on a surreal journey through the void.

title: Somnambule
overview: Adam is a sleepwalker: as soon as he falls asleep, his personality completely changes... and he does crazy things. One morning, upon waking up, he sees Estelle, his boss's daughter, tied up in his bathroom. He has no memory of what happened. Pursued by the police, he must solve this mystery to avoid ending up in prison.

title: The Comeback King
overview: A country western star experiences a dramatic downfall and must navigate their career in free fall.

title: S/H/V
overview: Four students, who make money by putting stolen school items online, are hired to steal a VHS tape from their Physical Education Teacher’s Office. However, things take a turn for the worse, when they find dozens of tapes, and being kids, they dare each other to partake in watching them.

title: Remain
overview: When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

title: The Strangers
overview: After a 4 a.m. knock at the door and haunting voices, Kristen McKay and James Hoyt’s remote getaway becomes a psychological night of terror as three masked strangers invade. Now they must go far beyond what they thought themselves capable of if they hope to survive.

title: Casper
overview: Casper is a kind young ghost who peacefully haunts a mansion in Maine. When specialist James Harvey arrives to communicate with Casper and his fellow spirits, he brings along his teenage daughter, Kat. Casper quickly falls in love with Kat, but their budding relationship is complicated not only by his transparent state, but also by his troublemaking apparition uncles and their mischievous antics.

title: Krux
overview: In a German village near war's end, women struggle to maintain normalcy as corpses appear along the river. When ordered to leave no Germans alive for arriving Russians, villagers face brutal choices about survival and humanity.

title: Twenty One Pilots @ Southside Festival 2026
original_title: Twenty One Pilots - Live at Southside Music Festival 2026
overview: Twenty One Pilots embody an alternative pop sound from Ohio. At the Southside Festival 2026, their emotionally charged sound meets the wide-open spaces of Neuhausen ob Eck: rap, rock and electronic music blend together to create a performance that focuses not only on spectacle, but also on movement, intensity and a close connection with the audience.

title: Monsters, Inc.
overview: Lovable Sulley and his wisecracking sidekick Mike Wazowski are the top scare team at Monsters, Inc., the scream-processing factory in Monstropolis. When a little girl named Boo wanders into their world, it's the monsters who are scared silly, and it's up to Sulley and Mike to keep her out of sight and get her back home.

title: Ball Face
overview: Life throws curveballs, how you react decides if you make it through. We follow an elementary schoolgirl terrified of sports who survives a chaotic ball game by bouncing a ball off her face. By the end of the game, she’s completely transformed.

title: Slap
overview: The story unfolds through three slaps, tracing the divergent values of a daughter and her father and the contradictions of the society reflected between them.

title: Oasis
overview: When a viral video of a student threatening his classmates surfaces online, the school spirals into escalating violence. Crushed by the pressure of teachers and parents, three outcasts take refuge in a nearby forest. There, play hardens into ritual and pain becomes an escape, until old wounds surface and the boundaries between them are redrawn.

title: Corpos Santos
overview: In a delirious vision, the figure of Saint Sebastian appears to explore the boundaries between bodies, sin, and redemption through rituals that blend pain and ecstasy, where faith and desire become indistinguishable and penance is transformed into celebration. Saint Sebastian, pray for us!

title: The Mummy
overview: Dashing legionnaire Rick O'Connell stumbles upon the hidden ruins of Hamunaptra while in the midst of a battle to claim the area in 1920s Egypt. It has been over three thousand years since former High Priest Imhotep suffered a fate worse than death as a punishment for a forbidden love—along with a curse that guarantees eternal doom upon the world if he is ever awoken.

title: I Know Who You Are
overview: On 1949 October 1, the day of the founding ceremony of the People's Republic of China, Xiao Dali enters the city and is reorganized as the director of the public security police station. He finds that primary school teacher Feng Jingbo is full of doubts. With the high vigilance of a soldier and the sense of responsibility of a public security official, Dali insists on partnering with Feng and becomes his neighbor. He then spends his whole life carrying out a nearly four-decade pursuit without regrets.

title: Red Rabbit Lodge
overview: In an attempt to put her traumatic past behind her Abigail Mason moves to Red Rabbit Lodge, a sanctuary for foreign students. Unbeknownst to her, he house has a history of blood, mayhem and a sadistic killer residing within the walls.

title: Refuge
overview: Four estranged friends reunite on a fishing trip, but a missing child and a desperate father's accusation turn reunion into a deadly reckoning

title: Maid's Obsession
overview: Martha, a longtime helper, fears losing her job when a new maid arrives. Rivalry turns to closeness as secrets and desire blur boundaries, forcing both to choose between security and temptation.

title: Revelations of Divine Love
overview: Between pandemics, people’s revolts and male institutions, this period film cheekily combines fantastic psychedelia and handmade sets. Inspired by the life story of Julian of Norwich, a 14th-century mystic and the first woman to write a book in English.

title: Kalyanamaram
overview: In a quiet hill village, young Mallika shares a deep bond with a tree she calls her friend. When her family plans to cut it down for her sisters wedding, she fights tirelessly to save it ultimately inspiring change and being honoured for her courage.

title: i’m stuck in a time loop
original_title: i’m stuck in a time loop
overview: A man struggles with the repetition of his life, and is convinced he is stuck in a time loop. Seeking an escape from the dread, he turns to a friend for advice and attempts to break the cycle using drastic measures, changing his daily life and confronting his fears.

title: Flamingos: Life After the Meteorite
original_title: Flamingos: La vida después del meteorito
overview: The search for the right partner, place, and moment to start a family is one of nature's most crucial journeys. This breathtaking story of love, survival, and perseverance follows Caribbean flamingos through one of the most fragile stages of their lives. With Julieta Venegas’ voice and Bryce Dessner’s music setting the tone, this film offers a unique and immersive cinematic experience, capturing the beauty and struggles of these extraordinary birds.

title: Last Routine
overview: A feature film depicting the critical 24 hours in the life of the famous Slovak figure skater Ondrej Nepela; intense and intimate personal drama of a young man, who, after years of dutiful representation of his totalitarian homeland longs to leave the golden cage of Czechoslovakia and become free. He wants to live and love without fear, that the revelation of his sexual orientation will make him a deviant and destroy everything he dedicated his life to. However, the regime strengthens its pressure on him in the moment of his highest vulnerability, using the dirtiest methods to make Ondrej conform to its cruel ultimatum.

title: No Ordinary Heist
overview: Inspired by the true 2004 Northern Bank robbery, two feuding bank employees are forced to execute Ireland’s biggest heist after criminals kidnap their families and threaten to kill them.

title: 53 Sundays
overview: When three siblings agree to meet and discuss their aging father's future, their reunion spirals into bickering, bantering and reliving old grudges.

title: Musical the Bath Fairy
overview: A live-recorded family musical film based on the bestselling picture book by Baek Heena, following Deok-ji's magical encounter with a bath fairy at an old bathhouse.
At the height of the First World War, two young British soldiers must cross enemy territory and deliver a message that will stop a deadly attack on hundreds of soldiers.

title: The God of Love
overview: Love Divine is a choral journey into romantic relationships, exploring the emotional destinies of interconnected lives. With an ironic, light tone tinged with bitterness, it portrays a humanity caught in the chaos of love. Each character is a knot in an intricate weave shaped by the capricious God of Love, while Ovid, the eternal poet, guides us from ancient Rome into the present.

title: Whatever It Takes
overview: Rose and Jean have nothing in common. Rose is a force of nature who faces all her problems with a disarming joie de vivre. She lives with her 3 children upstairs in the family hotel that no longer belongs to her. They're not poor, they're broke... but only temporarily. Jean is a solitary, taciturn man who has buried his big heart under layers of modesty and resignation. When he arrives in this unusual family, however, he quickly becomes indispensable. What did they expect before they met? Probably nothing. He soon becomes indispensable.

title: never been there, never.
overview: A street vendor races to sell his last sherbet before Christmas ends, chasing the simple chance to finally go home and rest.

title: Horst Schlämmer sucht das Glück
overview: Horst Schlämmer is back—and he's fed up. People all over Germany are in a bad mood. So he leaves Grevenbroich and sets off in search of happiness. It must be somewhere!

title: Legend of Ling Jing
overview: "Legend of Ling Jing" is inspired by the tale of the White Snake, reimagining Bai Su’s past and present lives. In her previous life, she was the adopted daughter of a general, separated in life and death from her childhood sweetheart due to the constraints of society. In this life, she is reborn in a demon’s body, wandering the mortal world with her companion Jing Gu. By chance, she meets and falls in love with Xu Xuan, the son of someone from her past. As fate cycles anew and old grudges resurface, what ending awaits this forbidden love that transcends the boundaries between human and demon?

title: Invisibles
overview: Elizabeth, a burlesque performer and sex worker in Montreal, is passionate about her jobs. But after years of keeping her life as an escort a secret, Elizabeth wonders if she can continue living like this. As she prepares to move on, she accepts one last client, a man with a disability. Their unexpected encounter overturns her certainties and leads her on an intimate and transformative journey.

title: Zodiac
overview: Police conduct a manhunt for the Zodiac Killer, a serial killer who terrorized the San Francisco Bay Area during the late 1960s and early 1970s, taunting police with letters, bloodstained clothing, and ciphers mailed to newspapers.

title: Destination
overview: Fueled by his obsession with the past, Frank instigates a manhunt to find his former henchman Rob.

title: The Flesh People
overview: Two roommates, desperate to feel successful in the milieu of New York City, turn to macabre money-making schemes by performing underground surgeries and serving human meat to unsuspecting customers.

title: Anything but Ghosts
overview: When a group of fame-seeking wannabe "ghosthunters" find themselves in over their heads, things spiral wildly and terrifyingly out of control.

title: The Male Gaze: Naughty Boys
overview: Bad behavior travels from the bedroom to the classroom to the beach in these six short films from Spain, France, Germany, Australia and Afghanistan that follow wayward boys and men for whom mischief and sexuality go hand in hand.

title: Lady Puritan
overview: As dream life bleeds into waking reality, a woman haunted by her Puritan ancestor must confront the terror buried deep within her bloodline.

title: The Resurrection of the Christ: Part One
original_title: The Resurrection of the Christ: Part One
overview: The first part of a two-part sequel to The Passion of the Christ. Plot TBA.

title: Shirley MacLaine, comme un torrent
overview: With her short red hair, expressive face, vitality, and playful acting style, Shirley MacLaine stands out in the Hollywood pantheon. Driven by a volcanic personality and iron discipline inherited from classical dance, she has constantly reinvented herself, from the girl next door to the eccentric old lady she plays on screen today, proving at 91 that there is a place for actresses of all ages. A refreshing portrait featuring film clips and archival footage, particularly those in which this talk show regular exercises her sharp wit.

title: Franzens Weltpanorama - A Ferry Radax Bricolage
original_title: Franzens Weltpanorama – Eine Ferry Radax Bricolage
overview: Using a range of cinematic forms, such as animation, split screen, and fisheye lens, Wolfgang Liemberger and Georg Vogt create an associative portrait of avant-garde filmmaker Ferry Radax who died in 2021. Filmed mainly on the beach at Monterosso, the setting of Radax’s major work Sonne halt!

title: Two for Tee
overview: Tee is a Chinese American pottery artist who meets new community center handyman Will. As she learns about her family's traditions through art, can she and Will save the center from closure?

title: Family Business
overview: A poor family struggles to survive through petty theft, but the father decides to abandon crime after an incident that nearly lands him in prison. He devises a different plan: each family member gets a job working for a wealthy family, concealing their familial ties. They constantly confront the stark contrast between their own world and that of their employers.

title: Virgin Fandango
overview: A short musical film that uses an innovative technique of animated tiles, featuring a rebellious Mary joining her voice to those of celebrated women throughout history in the fight for equality.

title: IVE THE 4TH FAN CONCERT 〈DIVE into IVE〉
original_title: IVE THE 4TH FAN CONCERT 〈DIVE into IVE〉
overview: This is the fourth fan concert by IVE. It was held at Inspire Arena in Incheon, South Korea on March 21–22, 2026.

title: No Other Love
overview: The Pandora's box opened in the name of love has already been unlocked. When love is consumed by obsession, just how many uncrossable boundaries will one break just to hold onto what they call "love"?

title: Pressure Cooker
overview: Four women are pushed to their breaking point in Dhaka’s underbelly, where the only way to survive systemic exploitation is to stop being the prey and start being the threat.

title: This Is Not Happening
overview: Bartek learns that his teenage son is the perpetrator of a murder at school. The distraught boy runs to his dad, so the man hides out with him in his fiancée's flat. As he tries to get everything under control, he grows up to confront the truth about his son and himself as a father.

title: I Live Here Now
overview: Struggling actress Rose finds her life upended by unexpected news. Things spiral further when her casual boyfriend, Travis, brings his overbearing mother into the fold, pushing Rose to the brink. She flees to The Crown Inn—a crumbling motel at the edge of nowhere—where time fractures and reality bends.

title: The Other Guys
overview: Unlike their heroic counterparts on the force, desk-bound NYPD detectives Gamble and Hoitz garner no headlines as they work day to day. When a seemingly minor case turns out to be a big deal, the two cops get the opportunity to finally prove to their comrades that they have the right stuff.

title: Alice in Wonderland
overview: On a golden afternoon, wildly curious young Alice tumbles into the burrow and enters the merry, madcap world of Wonderland full of whimsical escapades.

title: Casper
overview: Casper is a kind young ghost who peacefully haunts a mansion in Maine. When specialist James Harvey arrives to communicate with Casper and his fellow spirits, he brings along his teenage daughter, Kat. Casper quickly falls in love with Kat, but their budding relationship is complicated not only by his transparent state, but also by his troublemaking apparition uncles and their mischievous antics.

title: The Last Song You Left Behind
overview: Haruto Mizushima secretly loves writing poetry. One day, his classmate Ayane Toosaka discovers his hidden hobby. Ayane has developmental dyslexia, which makes reading and writing extremely difficult for her, yet she possesses remarkable talent in singing and composing music. At Ayane's request, Haruto begins writing lyrics for her music. As they spend time creating songs together, they gradually develop feelings for each other. Their talents both clash and draw them closer, making them cherish one another even more—this is a love story spanning ten years that will move you to tears.

title: Black Hawk Down
overview: When U.S. Rangers and an elite Delta Force team attempt to kidnap two underlings of a Somali warlord, their Black Hawk helicopters are shot down, and the Americans suffer heavy casualties, facing intense fighting from the militia on the ground.

title: The Chattanooga Syndrome - NOCLIP 3
overview: In this meta found-footage / documentary escapade, Gavin and Alex head to Tennessee to document the premiere of their previous film, and to follow a tip that will lead them to the most liminal spaces in Chattanooga...

title: You Are the Film
overview: Madoka writes plays. Kazuma composes music. One day, they decide to go to the cinema. But once there, they realise they can interact through the screen itself, sending fiction into joyful freefall in an absurd and inventive adventure.

title: The Wandering Earth III
overview: The sun is about to be destroyed, and humans have built huge thrusters on the surface of the earth to find a new home. However, the road to the universe is full of dangers. In order to save the earth, young people from the wandering earth era stepped forward for the third time and started a life-and-death battle against time.

title: Psalms & Lamentations
overview: 'Psalms & Lamentations' is a short film depicting the depth of pain and grief that we so often find in life caused by the struggle of sin, along with, how that relates to our walk with God.  This VRChat Short Film is heavily inspired by filmmaker Terrence Malick and loosely inspired by Marcus's testimony and a children's book called "Home Is Right Where You Are" by Ruth Chou Simons. Much of the script is derived from the books, Psalms, Lamentations, Job, Jonah, and other books of the Bible. It is unlike most films in that it exists to relate to the pain and not to the joy in our lives. This provides a very unique viewing experience. Some people find this film extremely deep and moving while others can see the depth but don't feel it as much. Much of how deep it is for someone is heavily determined by what someone's self-talk sounds like.

title: The Grinch
overview: The Grinch hatches a scheme to ruin Christmas when the residents of Whoville plan their annual holiday celebration. But a certain little who might change things.

title: The Imitation Game
overview: Based on the real life story of legendary cryptanalyst Alan Turing, the film portrays the nail-biting race against time by Turing and his brilliant team of code-breakers at Britain's top-secret Government Code and Cypher School at Bletchley Park, during the darkest days of World War II.

title: Cocktail 2
overview: A vacation in Sicily forces longtime partners Diya and Kunal to question their love and commitment after they reunite with Diya's old friend Ally.

title: Transfer Trimurthulu
overview: Fearless cop Trimurthulu's chance find drags him into a web of conspiracy. Standing alone against influential enemies who will stop at nothing, he risks everything to expose the truth and deliver justice.

title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
overview: The Fantastic Mr. Fox, bored with his current life, plans a heist against the three local farmers. The farmers, tired of sharing their chickens with the sly fox, seek revenge against him and his family.

title: In Search of Stolen Time
original_title: Auf der Suche nach der gestohlenen Zeit
overview: «Time is money» is an oft-repeated expression in our modern performance-oriented society. But how does it affect us as individuals, and influence our society? Director Konrad Wakolbinger deconstructs this common and unquestioned concept, and shows, with subtle humor, how our understanding of time, work, and their interdependence has changed over the centuries.

title: Dawn of the Dead
overview: A group of survivors take refuge in a shopping mall after the world is taken over by aggressive, flesh-eating zombies.

title: Unraveled
overview: Maria is a former elite swimmer and famous sports commentator whose life unravels when her beloved husband Mikael, her former coach and father of their daughter, is suddenly suspected of sexual abuse. Sparking the scandal and media interest is the revelation in an upcoming book, of a young girl’s misguided infatuation for her swimming coach, with rumors suggesting that Mikael is the man in question.

title: Second Chances
overview: A burnt-out manager returns to his childhood summer camp for a few days to temporarily take over from his ailing father. Instead of peace and quiet, however, he finds a crumbling facility, a wacky camp crew, and the return of his first love—who turns his life upside down.

title: Pacific Rim
overview: Using massive piloted robots to combat the alien threat, Earth's survivors take the fight to the invading alien force lurking in the depths of the Pacific Ocean. Nearly defenseless in the face of the relentless enemy, the forces of mankind have no choice but to turn to two unlikely heroes who now stand as Earth's final hope against the mounting apocalypse.

title: Extreme Makeover: Homer Edition
overview: Homer and Marge's fun couples' date night goes off the rails when Marge learns Homer left the kids unsupervised with only the doorbell camera as a babysitter. Frustrated with her imperfect husband, a tipsy Marge stirs up a trilogy of fantasies of a different Homer.

title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
overview: Five years after uniting the dragons and Vikings of Berk, Hiccup and Toothless soar beyond their homeland, charting the vast unknown. During one of their adventures, the pair discover a secret cave that houses hundreds of wild dragons—and a mysterious dragon rider with a startling connection to Hiccup. And as the ruthless conqueror Drago Bludvist rises to seize control of both dragons and people alike, Hiccup must step into his role as a true leader and, alongside his friends and Toothless, protect Berk from a devastating war.

title: MALWARE
overview: Led by a cybernetic soldier a group of exterminators in a fading zombie apocalypse have been sent to clear out an old infected zone long believed to be empty ... Or is it ?

title: The Whale and the Musician
overview: An electronic composer sets out to sea, where his music evokes a deep, poetic resonance in a humpback whale. Can we communicate with animals through music?

title: William Basinski - The Disintegration Loops
overview: William Basinski - The Disintegration Loops (Official Documentary Short Film)

title: A Nightmare on Elm Street Part 2: Freddy's Revenge
original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street Part 2: Freddy's Revenge
overview: A teenage boy is haunted in his dreams by deceased child murderer Freddy Krueger, who is out to possess him in order to continue his reign of terror in the real world.

title: Snatch
overview: Unscrupulous boxing promoters, violent bookies, a Russian gangster, incompetent amateur robbers, and supposedly Jewish jewellers fight to track down a priceless stolen diamond.

title: F.A.S.T.
overview: A former special forces commando, down on his luck after returning Stateside, is recruited by the DEA to lead a covert black ops team to take down CIA-protected drug dealers.

title: The 13th Annual On Cinema Oscar Special
original_title: The 13th Annual On Cinema Oscar Special
overview: Host and HEI Network CEO New Heidecker has sworn his departure from On Cinema at the Cinema, but frequent Guest Expert Gregg Turkington wants the show to go on... Will this be the last Oscar Special ever? Only one way to find out!

title: Imposters
overview: After a couple's baby is taken, the desperate mother learns of a way to "get their baby back." However, the husband begins to suspect that what she brought back isn't their son.

title: Dawn of the Dead
overview: A group of survivors take refuge in a shopping mall after the world is taken over by aggressive, flesh-eating zombies.

title: Jailer
overview: Muthuvel Pandian, a retired, stern yet compassionate jailer lives a peaceful life with his family, but trouble knocks his door when his cop son’s tryst with an antique mafia gang goes awry and forces Muthu to step back into a dark world he had voluntarily took a break from.

title: Wonka
overview: Willy Wonka – chock-full of ideas and determined to change the world one delectable bite at a time – is proof that the best things in life begin with a dream, and if you’re lucky enough to meet Willy Wonka, anything is possible.

title: BABYMETAL - Live at Intuit Dome
overview: BABYMETAL - Live at Intuit Dome was a special headline show by BABYMETAL held at the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles on November 1st 2025. Celebrating their 15th anniversary, and as part of their 2025/2026 world tour, BABYMETAL made history as the first Japanese group to hold a one-man live show and sell out said show at the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles!

title: Pacific Rim
overview: Using massive piloted robots to combat the alien threat, Earth's survivors take the fight to the invading alien force lurking in the depths of the Pacific Ocean. Nearly defenseless in the face of the relentless enemy, the forces of mankind have no choice but to turn to two unlikely heroes who now stand as Earth's final hope against the mounting apocalypse.

title: Mulholland Drive
overview: Blonde Betty Elms has only just arrived in Hollywood to become a movie star when she meets an enigmatic brunette with amnesia. Meanwhile, as the two set off to solve the second woman's identity, filmmaker Adam Kesher runs into ominous trouble while casting his latest project.

title: Chili Finger
overview: When a small town lawyer discovers a severed finger in her chili, she blackmails the restaurant for a cash payout in an effort to regain control over her mundane life. The situation quickly spirals out of control, and her life descends into chaos.

title: Manhood
overview: "Manhood" follows Dallas entrepreneur Bill Moore as he attempts to make penis enlargement as commonplace as Botox. Along the way, an OnlyFans star and a father of five put their bodies—and their insecurities—on the line. Blending dark humor with unexpected empathy, "Manhood" examines shame, addiction, and the fragile myths of American masculinity.

title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
overview: Five years after uniting the dragons and Vikings of Berk, Hiccup and Toothless soar beyond their homeland, charting the vast unknown. During one of their adventures, the pair discover a secret cave that houses hundreds of wild dragons—and a mysterious dragon rider with a startling connection to Hiccup. And as the ruthless conqueror Drago Bludvist rises to seize control of both dragons and people alike, Hiccup must step into his role as a true leader and, alongside his friends and Toothless, protect Berk from a devastating war.

title: Mexicali
overview: A former special forces contractor is forced out of retirement as an avocado farmer in Mexico when local gangsters try to force him and his family off their farm.

title: When Pigs Fly
overview: Hearts are being grown in pigs to save human lives—blurring the boundaries between the two species. Could this be the impetus for a fundamental change in the relationship between humans and pigs?

title: The Boy with My Son's Face
original_title: The Boy with My Son's Face
overview: Susan's baby dies, and she is convicted for a crime she doesn’t even remember committing. Years later, out on parole and fighting to start over, Susan sees a photograph that stops her cold.

title: The Scarecrows' Wedding
overview: Devoted scarecrows Betty O'Barley and Harry O'Hay are planning a wedding to remember. When Harry insists on leaving the farm to collect one last thing for their big day, smooth-talking Reginald Rake swoops in with plans of his own. Chaos follows, and soon Betty's in danger and everything's at risk. Can Harry get back in time and save the day?

title: A Safe Place
overview: Lucia has everything a woman could want. A loving husband and son. The opportunity to devote herself entirely to her family. A lifelong friendship with Cristina, which began during their university days. Yet, amid the intoxicating idyllic summer holiday, Lucia can feel nothing but longing for the person she once was. Lucia and Cristina, accompanied by their husbands, spend the summer in a small beach village whose charm has faded over time. Behind a façade of peace and security, Lucia finds herself drawn to everything that is not handed to her on a silver platter. An unattainable man from her past emerges in their holiday group, giving her a reason to hunt. Because life should not be without a bite.

title: Everybody to Kenmure Street
overview: In May 2021, a UK Home Office dawn raid triggers one of the most spontaneous and successful acts of civil resistance in recent memory. In Pollokshields, Scotland’s most diverse neighbourhood, hundreds of residents rush to the streets to stop the deportation of their neighbours.

title: Dua Ji
overview: In rural Taiwan, during her mother’s funeral, A-Hsien, the eldest daughter, grapples with grief, resentment, and the quiet burden of tradition. As patriarchal rituals unfold, a silent resistance emerges, unsettling the roles she was expected to fulfill.

title: She Was Here
overview: A reflective tale about love, loss, and the invisible ways the people we cherish continue to shape our lives.

title: Perfect Soul
overview: Guided by mysterious entities who claim to be family, Nikki is shown the haunting secrets of her town, her parents and friends. Her faith is put to the test and sends her spiraling down a path of insanity, for which there may be no escape.

title: Samurai Ballerina -L'étoile de Paris en fleur-
original_title: パリに咲くエトワール
overview: Paris in the early 20th century. Fujiko dreams of becoming a painter despite expectations of marriage, while Chizuru, born into a samurai family, longs to study ballet. Reunited in Paris after meeting as children, they support each other and move toward their dreams.

title: Menopause Mystery
overview: A personal and investigative documentary about a phase of life that half the world's population goes through, yet we know surprisingly little about.

title: Sinner Supper Club
overview: An NYC friend group reunites to throw an "eviction funeral" for Genevieve; as the night progresses and a heatwave traps them together, their long-ignored problems boil over.  An improvised gay mumblecore ghost story shot on an iPhone in six days.

title: The Tingbjerg Experiment
overview: What happens when a group of hand-picked idealistic families from the middle class settle in a so-called “hard ghetto” with the desire to change the neighborhood for the better?

title: Daughters of the Forest
overview: Deep in Mexico’s mushroom-rich forests, two women from indigenous communities have become mycologists. This immersive sci-fi documentary follows their unusual, fungi-driven paths as they seek to reconcile the past and present while reimagining the future for themselves and the changing world they inhabit.

title: Crash Land
overview: Lance, Clay, and Darby have spent their childhoods drinking, wreaking havoc, and filming crude stunts in their small town. Everyone hates them. Wanting to finally prove their lives have meaning, the boys set out to make a “real movie” and in the process are forced to confront emotions and experiences they’ve never considered: love, loss, and ultimately, what it means to grow up.

title: King of Dope
overview: Dawid is an ordinary boy who builds a legal drug empire and becomes an overnight millionaire. Sudden fame, beautiful women, fast cars, endless partying, confrontations with gangsters, and dealings at the highest levels of power—this is his new world, where the line between legal and illegal is as thin as the line in a mirror. When an ethical cop arrives, everything is at stake. Will Dawid be able to stop him before it's too late? Will love save him from ultimate collapse?

title: Lily's Ritual
overview: Four friends travel to an isolated house to perform a witchcraft ritual.

title: Bugboy
overview: George, a shy teenager with misaligned eyes, struggles to connect with others after his parents’ divorce. Finding refuge in the world of insects, he bonds with a cricket named Isabella.

title: A Nightmare on Elm Street Part 2: Freddy's Revenge
original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street Part 2: Freddy's Revenge
overview: A teenage boy is haunted in his dreams by deceased child murderer Freddy Krueger, who is out to possess him in order to continue his reign of terror in the real world.

title: Lulk
overview: In a desperate attempt to pay off his family's debts, a metalworker stages a bank robbery that spirals into a hostage standoff.

title: Gamer Girls
overview: Youth is always full of confusion, electronic gaming may be a way to achieve hero's dream. This is a story of six passionate girls fighting hard in the gaming world, hoping to break the social stereotype. Yet this is more difficult than it seems, with all the unknown challenges ahead.

title: Bodycam
overview: A call to a quiet suburban home unleashes unthinkable carnage when two officers mistakenly shoot a man and his infant child, spiraling the tragedy into a fierce, unrelenting fall into the unknown.

title: Dream of Another Summer
overview: A woman's collapse amid urban ruins sparks an exploration of humanity's connection to physical spaces and a city's resilience in the face of mortality.

title: Stages
overview: After the tumultuous breakup of his band, Ben Garza embarks on his first-ever solo tour. Life on the road feels different now, and Ben must find his footing alongside Rita, his steadfast tour manager, and Jessie Ramos, his charismatic, spotlight-stealing opening act.

title: Healthy as a Fish
overview: In a seemingly quiet Sicilian island, an unexpected fact triggers an irresistible chain of events. It will be up to the local Carabinieri, investigators a little careless, to solve the mystery. Amid exhilarating situations and unlikely suspicions, the country will wake up from a long daily numbness.

title: Pride & Prejudice
overview: A story of love and life among the landed English gentry during the Georgian era. Mr. Bennet is a gentleman living in Hertfordshire with his overbearing wife and five daughters, but if he dies their house will be inherited by a distant cousin whom they have never met, so the family's future happiness and security is dependent on the daughters making good marriages.

title: Humpty Dumpty X
overview: Follows filmmaker Tony Kaye's creative journey after directing 1998's "American History X".

title: The Gate of Murder
overview: Kazuyuki Tajima strikes up a friendship with his elementary school classmate, Osamu Kuramochi. From that moment on, a dark shadow begins to fall over his life. Following his grandmother's death, his parents divorce, and a rumor drives him out of his hometown. Each time he attempts to start over, Kuramochi reappears in his life.

title: Happy Hours
overview: A freshly divorced photographer finds herself unexpectedly reconnecting with her high school boyfriend, who is now a successful travel writer. The pair of former lovers pick back up where they left off, rekindling their spark, confiding in one another and working through old wounds.

title: 9/11: Reclaiming Ground Zero
overview: After the 9/11 attacks, after the smoke was gone, after the rubble cleared away, New Yorkers had a city to rebuild. In response to fast-tracked redevelopment plans, more than 5,000 people gathered in the largest town hall in American history. They came to vote on the city’s six proposals for rebuilding Ground Zero. But instead, the people rejected the top down approach and successfully charted a new path forward. Their work determined what is at Ground Zero today. And their story is an example of what democracy can look like.

title: Detective Chen 2
overview: In 1930s Shanghai, a wrongly accused hero escapes death row and unravels a deadly conspiracy, battling enemies and uncovering a foreign plot that threatens his nation.

title: Confessions II – The Film
overview: Follows a chaotic night out involving ambushing, worshipping, and pursuit that ultimately leads back to the dance floor.

title: She's the He!
overview: To protect their reputations before graduation, two friends pretend to be trans women—only for a comedic stunt to turn into a profound journey of self-discovery when one of them realizes her truth.

title: The Passenger
overview: Hassan, a Somali-American airport shuttle driver in Minneapolis, is struggling to make ends meet. When Lloyd, a stranded twenty-something at the airport, offers to pay Hassan to take him overland to Chicago, it seems worth the risk. But as the realization grows that his passenger is not what he seems, Hassan finds himself trapped in a terrifying ride that he can’t escape, knowing that saving himself might put countless others in danger.

title: The Missing Piece
overview: After her grandmother’s passing, Alma travels to Greece in order to find the missing piece of a jewel, given to her by her relative before her death. During this initiatory journey in her grandma’s footsteps, Alma shall go not only through the grieving process, but eventually find another missing piece: the one tied to her desire for life.

title: Child of the Rouge
overview: The recounting of a tale about a young girl who had a traumatic coming into this world on April 17th 1975 when the Khmer Rouge entered Phnom Penh.

title: Maa Behen
overview: In this dark comedy, a woman calls her estranged daughters in the middle of the night with chilling news — there's a dead body in her kitchen.

title: Operation Playground: Zero
overview: After the death of his mother, Ricky, a twelve-year-old non-verbal boy, is left to care for his infant sister on his own while struggling to survive in a collapsing Western Europe overrun by the living dead

title: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai
original_title: है जवानी तो इश्क होना है
overview: When Jass leaves his marriage over conflicting priorities, a new romance abroad is upended by shocking revelations, forcing him to confront love, loyalty, and the true meaning of commitment.

title: Labyrinth of Lost Boys
overview: A kid from the country gets lost in the big city looking for love, going on a series of increasingly bizarre dates while a serial killer is on the loose targeting boys his age.

title: Shrek the Third
overview: After the King of Far Far Away dies, Shrek and Fiona are to succede. However, Shrek wants to return to his cozy swamp and live in peace and quiet, so when he finds out there is another heir to the throne, he and Donkey set off to bring him back to rule the kingdom.

title: Find Your Friends
overview: A sinister spin on twenty-something party culture, revealing the darkness beneath the carefree facade. What starts as a wild girls trip turns dangerous when hostile locals escalate tensions and Amber's past trauma surfaces. As the group fractures under toxic dynamics, their fun getaway transforms into a revenge-fueled nightmare.

title: The Wedding Entertainer (or the Tale of Moishe Badhan)
overview: Jerusalem's greatest badchan (Hasidic wedding comedian), wrecked his career because of liquor and a big mouth, gets a second chance as the sidekick of the famous American Badchan Meshulam. At the wedding, everything spins out of control.

title: The Suburbs
overview: A man lives the same life everyday. One day, he decides to break the cycle.

title: So He Grabbed The Knife
original_title: そしてナイフを手にした
overview: The boy takes the knife his father once gave him. Did what followed make him a “man”?

title: The Murder of Rachel Nickell
overview: A young mother is killed in broad daylight on London's Wimbledon Common — in front of her toddler. This documentary examines the yearslong murder case.

title: Alien³
overview: After escaping with Newt and Hicks from the alien planet, Ripley crash lands on Fiorina 161, a prison planet and host to a correctional facility. Unfortunately, although Newt and Hicks do not survive the crash, a more unwelcome visitor does. The prison does not allow weapons of any kind, and with aid being a long time away, the prisoners must simply survive in any way they can.

title: Alltag in der Ukraine #dontlookaway
overview: We sent cameras to Ukraine and asked people, “What would you like to tell us about your daily lives?” “What should we see?” This is what they want to show us. This is what their daily lives look like. This is their life. Please don’t look away!

title: Kill him now
overview: In July 2017, Juan Martínez is found severely stabbed in a residential area of Almansa (Albacete). His 15-year-old stepdaughter and an 18-year-old man claim it was an accident after he was run over, but the Civil Guard discovers that nothing adds up. The investigation uncovers a web of lies and incriminating messages.

title: Smart Working
overview: The story follows Giuliano, whose life has improved thanks to his working from home, but his colleagues’ poor performance threatens to force everyone back to the office. Meanwhile, he and his wife, Laura, are expecting a second child and are looking for a bigger home. As Laura makes up her mind about a controversial job offer, Giuliano’s co-workers turn their flat into a makeshift office, rekindling their efficiency and organisation. Amid intrusive co-workers and domestic chaos, Giuliano will have to find creative solutions to save his job, his family and the dream of a new home.

title: Paralysis
overview: During a terrifying episode of sleep paralysis, Natasha finds herself trapped in a world where time stops, her body betrays her, and a grotesque entity crawls closer, turning her struggle to wake into a desperate fight for spiritual survival.

title: Howl
overview: Misfit Molly lives in a tent in her suburban backyard—but when she spots a wolf and no one believes her, she becomes obsessed with proving it's real.

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
overview: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic, but things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people.

title: Hope
overview: On the last day of college, three lives quietly collide with memories, choices, and unspoken feelings. Hope is a poetic reflection on timing, love, and the moments that could have changed everything.  Hope follows three hearts bound by silence, longing, and what remains unsaid. A gentle story about love, timing, and the fragile beauty of unanswered emotions.

title: It Was Just an Accident
overview: After a night of drinking, three privileged college friends accidentally kill a man with their luxury car.

title: I Rarely Wake Up Dreaming
overview: The love of Olya and Oleh, a young queer Ukrainian couple, is put to the test when one partner’s gender transition collides with Russia’s full-scale invasion. As war narrows and challenges the boundaries of masculinity and femininity, they struggle to preserve their bond and sense of self. What does it mean to be a man in a country that is fighting for its identity and survival?

title: Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
original_title: Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
overview: After the insane General Jack D. Ripper initiates a nuclear strike on the Soviet Union, a war room full of politicians, generals and a Russian diplomat all frantically try to stop it.

title: Night of the Living Dead
overview: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.

title: WITH LOVE, MAE
overview: “With Love, Mae” is an animated thesis film directed by Hazelmapel in 2024. The film centers around Mae, an eccentric and impulsive girl, who loves to stir up trouble. She is willing to do anything for her best friend, Lola- even if it means getting rid of said best friend’s boyfriend, Joey.

title: The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It
original_title: The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It
overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren encounter what would become one of the most sensational cases from their files. The fight for the soul of a young boy takes them beyond anything they'd ever seen before, to mark the first time in U.S. history that a murder suspect would claim demonic possession as a defense.

title: How To Wash Clothes You Love
overview: Haesang, who lingers in what has been lost, carries his past in a treasure box. An old dog that has died, cherished belongings, traces of people he can no longer meet—he keeps everything, unable to throw anything away, and struggles to accept that everything must come to an end. After a breakup with his partner, the box grows too heavy to carry. As the world moves too quickly around him, Haesang clutches the shattered fragments of his memories and finally puts them into the washing machine.

title: Go to Sleep
overview: A recently separated man newly living alone discovers that he is sleepwalking at night, and as he records his activities, he discovers questionable behaviors and the presence of another mysterious figure.

title: Vampyr
overview: A struggling author, obsessed with Edvard Munch, finds himself on the verge of madness when he's dragged into a dangerous murder mystery surrounding the world-famous painter.

title: Live Like That
overview: Based on an inspiring story about a family whose faith is tested by an unimaginable loss, and what they choose to do next, in the midst of grief, they make a surprising decision. Instead of responding with anger, they choose forgiveness and set out to help heal a divided community. What begins as private heartbreak becomes a broader movement of hope and connection, showing how faith, love, and unity can bring light even to the darkest moments.

title: Ghostbusters
overview: After losing their university jobs, three parapsychologists start a ghost-catching business in New York City and uncover a supernatural threat that could destroy the world.

title: Mallorca confidencial
overview: Mallorca, 2007. La Chusa, the matriarch of a shantytown, runs the drug market with the support of neighbors, traffickers, and police. But when she suffers a massive robbery, she sees her power and her family shaken.

title: Constantine the Great: Emperor of New Rome
original_title: Konstantin der Große - Auf Entdeckungsreise in Europa
overview: Constantine the Great, son of General Constantius Chlorus, rose to power during the Tetrarchy, a division of the Roman Empire among four emperors. After succeeding his father in 306 and being acknowledged as the sole Emperor of the West in 310, he enacted significant military, economic, and religious reforms that unified the empire. This documentary explores his life and reign, highlighting his role in ending the persecution of Christians and the transition from polytheistic beliefs. It also touches on his personal intrigues, including the murder of his concubine Fausta, showcasing his complex legacy of power and grandeur.

title: 2:30 Minutes for 5 Shekels
overview: An observational documentary set in the Sderot lookout on the Israel-Gaza border, a charged memorial site. Today, a coin-operated telescope aimed directly at Gaza has been installed there. Visitors: children, soldiers, Birthright groups, foreign tourists, families, take turns swiping their credit cards to activate a telescope aimed directly at Gaza. Through their immediate reactions, the film captures a cross-section of Israeli and Jewish society encountering destruction in real time. The film becomes an observation of how we observe the suffering of others, inviting the viewer to confront a complex reality and the darker layers of the human soul.

title: Creature of the Pines
overview: Creature of the Pines is a found footage horror movie set in the legendary New Jersey Pine Barrens, one of the most mysterious and unsettling stretches of wilderness in America. Locals have whispered about strange sightings and disappearances for generations, but few people are willing to talk about what they’ve seen, and even fewer dare to go looking.

title: River
overview: After her mother's death, a sixteen-year-old girl forms an unexpected bond with a troubled outcast, guiding her through the quiet depths of grief.

title: Unconnected
overview: Sylvia Vanguard is a woman who seems to have it all: Money, success, and a good man. But now that she has reached her pinnacle, she's ready to take on the one thing that she has sacrificed to achieve her goals- motherhood. After being denied by her longtime boyfriend, she decides to move forward alone with using unconventional methods to have a child, and ends up getting way more than she bargained for.

title: Primal Darkness
overview: Cole Harrington, the host of a popular outdoor series, sets out to track down the predator responsible for a series of cattle attacks in rural Nevada. The mystery deepens when he uncovers footage depicting the final moments of two missing university employees.

title: Miss You, Love You
overview: Forced to plan her late husband's funeral with her estranged gay son's assistant, a blunt, grieving widow forms an unlikely bond with the total stranger as confronting their shared grief surfaces deep family secrets and long-held resentments.

title: Waking a Brutal Beast
overview: A feature-length documentary on the making of Tobe Hooper's THE MANGLER.

title: Best Boy
overview: After the death of their abusive and tyrannic father, three children – now adults – and their aging mother return to their long-abandoned summer cottage. They will have to partake in a strange competition that tore their family apart 30 years prior – a nightmarish return to the past for the family's children.

title: Alien Disclosure Day
overview: A deep space mining ship returns to Earth carrying deadly alien stowaways. The aliens immediately launch a brutal attack on Earth. Now humanity must fight back, board the vessel, and destroy it before the planet is lost forever.

title: Bastards: Where´s Majer?
overview: Teacher Majer is lured by his friend to an old farmhouse, where a hitman hired by the last surviving member of the Dostál family is waiting for him. Meanwhile, everyone is waiting for Majer at the newly opened school, which he is supposed to manage. All of his former students wait in vain for Majer; he never arrives. No one understands what has happened, and above all, where the man is on whom they are now completely dependent, each for a different reason. They begin to fear that something has happened to Majer, and so the four “bravest” among them decide to find him.

title: The Abyss
overview: Dasha and Sasha are a happy newlywed. A honeymoon and a parachute jump over the foothills of Mount Elbrus are supposed to be the beginning of their new life. But fate intervenes. The pilot turns out to be Artyom - Dasha's ex, a man she didn't even want to remember. When the plane crashes, the three are forced to jump without training. The lines get tangled. They miraculously survive - but find themselves suspended over a mountain abyss amid raging forest fires. Dasha finds herself between two men, each of whom is tied to her life. One is the present. The other is an unhealed past.

title: Sekawan Limo 2: Gunung Klawih
overview: Three years after climbing Mount Madyopuro, the five friends' friendship has grown stronger. When they reunite for Andrew's daughter's birthday, they witness the family threatened with becoming a sacrifice for a black magic ritual! They set off to accompany Andrew to Mount Klawih. However, Juna has disappeared into the realm of demons!

title: Susana and Elvira: No Plan B
original_title: Susana y Elvira: Sin plan B
overview: Susana and Elvira, two former best friends, reunite after two years apart to organize the celebrity wedding of the year.

title: Cycles of Resilience: A Journey Through Austin's Black History
original_title: Cycles of Resilience: A Journey Through Austin's Black History
overview: On Black History Bike Ride’s 6th annual Juneteenth Ride, led by Talib Abdullahi, hundreds of cyclists bike together to learn under-told stories of Black history. From the State Capitol to Austin’s only HBCU to iconic venues like Victory Grill, this journey through history explores the transition from plantation sites to freedom communities, highlights the impact of the 1928 City Plan’s “Negro District” in east Austin, and celebrates the contributions of leaders of the Black community like Jacob Fontaine and Barbara Jordan. Through interviews with local Austinites and thought-leaders like Peniel Joseph and Tara Dudley, an inspirational story of resilience and Black excellence unfolds.

title: The Incredibles
overview: Bob Parr has given up his superhero days to log in time as an insurance adjuster and raise his three children with his formerly heroic wife in suburbia. But when he receives a mysterious assignment, it's time to get back into costume.

title: Trikala: Script of God
overview: Trikala is a heroic story, one of the many mysteries hidden in Indian Sanatana Dharma.When darkness descends on the world, the light comes to save it, trikala is one of the Illuminator..

title: It’s All Good
overview: After taking care of his intrusive mother for years, Elie is relieved: she is cured. He can finally focus on his own life and falls in love… until his mom’s relapse. Now he has to take care of both the women in his life!

title: Cold War in Philly
overview: In 1976 with the Cold War raging, the Philadelphia Flyers took to the ice to play the unbeaten Russian Red Army team. What happened that day went down in sports history.

title: Me in a Nutshell

overview: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.

title: Shocktopus
overview: An alien amoeba crashes to Earth and mutates aquatic life along the shores of North Carolina, unleashing an electrified octopus that terrorizes a seaside resort. Two special operatives try to stop the shock wave of cosmic carnage.

title: Blood Covenant
overview: A horror writer, drowning in debt and on the verge of collapse, desperately performs a ritual to summon a demon who promises to deliver the stories he can no longer write. The pact works, but at a terrible price.

title: Badinter
overview: Biopic about the famous French lawyer and politician, Robert Badinter.

title: À la poursuite de Claude Lelouch
original_title: À la poursuite de Claude Lelouch
overview: Life is paused. ACTION. Camera rolling. As Claude Lelouch's voice imparts the wisdom that comes with a life lived to the fullest, we leave that voice behind and join his camera. It will take us on a journey through his filmography, where actors perform the ballet of life and love.

title: Jailer
overview: Muthuvel Pandian, a retired, stern yet compassionate jailer lives a peaceful life with his family, but trouble knocks his door when his cop son’s tryst with an antique mafia gang goes awry and forces Muthu to step back into a dark world he had voluntarily took a break from.

title: Se Não Eu, Quem Vai Fazer Você Feliz?
original_title: Se Não Eu, Quem Vai Fazer Você Feliz?
overview: The plot is based on the book "Se Não Eu, Quem Vai Fazer Você Feliz? – Minha História de Amor com Chorão" (If Not Me, Who Will Make You Happy? – My Love Story with Chorão). The film explores the rise of Charlie Brown Jr. and Chorão’s journey in Santos—spanning the worlds of skateboarding and the stage—while focusing intimately on the intense, nearly 20-year romance between the musician and Graziela, revealing the man behind the idol and the creative process behind the band's greatest hits.

title: The Thomas Crown Affair
overview: A debonair, adventuresome man believes he has pulled off the perfect multi-million dollar heist, only to match wits with an insurance investigator who will do anything to get her man.

title: Mulholland Drive
overview: Blonde Betty Elms has only just arrived in Hollywood to become a movie star when she meets an enigmatic brunette with amnesia. Meanwhile, as the two set off to solve the second woman's identity, filmmaker Adam Kesher runs into ominous trouble while casting his latest project.

title: Josh Johnson: Symphony
overview: In his first HBO comedy special, comedian Josh Johnson debuts original material about our shared experiences as humans – tackling topics like family, religion, and relationships through his unique point of view and signature creativity.

title: Jason Bourne
overview: The most dangerous former operative of the CIA is drawn out of hiding to uncover hidden truths about his past.

title: Dose
overview: Bodies begin to pile up in a hospital meant to save lives, forcing a doctor with a troubled past to confront buried secrets when a woman from his past returns. As the investigation deepens, each revelation becomes more dangerous than the last.

title: Corporate Retreat
overview: Blending the dread of survival horror with dark laughs and shocking twists, "Corporate Retreat" centers around a group of young executives whose luxury team-building trip descends into a bloody fight for survival against a vengeful retreat leader.

title: Sick Puppy
overview: When Charlie's serial killer husband decides to finally quit for her, she's thrilled, but soon finds herself committing violent acts to protect the man she loves, even from himself.

title: The Lost Cache
overview: History, science and exploration converged in a quest to find the lost camera of one of climbing’s most iconic photographers and cartographers, Bradford Washburn. Set against the backdrop of the pioneering lensmen’s storied 1937 Mount Lucania expedition, this film blurs the lines between adventure documentary, treasure hunt and meditation on why we risk everything to chase the improbable.

overview: Over many missions and against impossible odds, Dom Toretto and his family have outsmarted, out-nerved and outdriven every foe in their path. Now, they confront the most lethal opponent they've ever faced: A terrifying threat emerging from the shadows of the past who's fueled by blood revenge, and who is determined to shatter this family and destroy everything—and everyone—that Dom loves, forever.

title: Kidnapped in Her Own Home: The Martha Carelli Story
original_title: Kidnapped in Her Own Home: The Martha Carelli Story

overview: A controversial writer living off-grid in the Australian bush finds his quiet new life destroyed after a grim discovery surfaces in a nearby waterhole.

overview: When Janek, a straight Polish guy watches gay porn for the first time, his world is turned upside down. Battling with unsettling new thoughts, he is put into a journey of self-discovery.

overview: On May 27, 1980—the last day of the Gwangju Uprising—students at Sinheung High School in Jeonju defied martial law. Their teacher disciplined them to protect them, but this act of love left forty years of misunderstanding. overview: Heejin tries to restore old footage of her mother. With her father, she sells her mother's books and transplants a tree. Amid their quiet, persistent labor, life goes on.

overview: High schoolers Mitsuha and Taki are complete strangers living separate lives. But one night, they suddenly switch places. Mitsuha wakes up in Taki’s body, and he in hers. This bizarre occurrence continues to happen randomly, and the two must adjust their lives around each other.

overview: In 1994, a tycoon's kidnapping shook Hong Kong, threatening its financial standing. Police pursued personal gain while OCID Superintendent Li Wenbin risked everything to navigate conflicting interests and expose the truth.
